article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes-BPOM sebut inovasi alkes perlu dipercepat guna eliminasi TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health and BPOM say medical device innovations need to be accelerated for TB elimination.
article.articleSummary: TB burden remains high in Indonesia, with about 867,000 TB cases diagnosed in the past year, according to the Ministry of Health. Jakarta regulators and health authorities pushed to accelerate innovation and strengthen domestic health products, notably the Interferon-Gamma Release Assay (IGRA) for TB detection. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus argued that reducing the IGRA test price from around 1,000,000 IDR to about 50,000 IDR would substantially ease the national fiscal burden and hasten TB control, underscoring cross-sector oversight to ensure safe, effective diagnostics. BPOM chief Taruna Ikrar highlighted faster regulatory pathways, while industry voices, including Bio Farma, welcomed improved processes. BPOM also advocates natural-based medicines as part of health independence, with Indonesia hosting roughly 31,000 of the world’s ~40,000 plant species that could serve as herbal raw material; aim to raise pharmaceutical value-added.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省とBPOM：結核排除のための医療機器イノベーション加速が必要と発表
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核負担が高く（約867,000症例/年）、公式な政策対応が確認されているが、本記事は新規アウトブレイク・緊急事態ではなく、診断技術・価格改善に関する政策イニシアティブが主題である。情報不足のためWATCH判定。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の風土病であり、本記事は流行の新規検出ではなく、政府による診断技術の価格低減と規制改革を通じた結核対策の加速化に関するニュース報道である。IHR基準では1項目のみ該当。WPRO基準では4項目該当するが、緊急性・国際的拡大リスクが低く、情報も限定的であるためWATCH判定とした。続報を注視し、新規クラスタ発生やアウトブレイクの兆候が確認されれば判定を引き上げる。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana Health Service Commits to Wastewater Disease Surveillance Scale-Up
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service commits to embedding wastewater and environmental surveillance into its national disease control framework after the Wastewater and Environmental Surveillance Conference 2026 in Accra. The event drew 178 in-person and 400+ virtual participants from 31 countries to advance sewage data as an early-warning tool for infectious disease. Ghana has used environmental surveillance in polio eradication and aims to scale it to broader threats, stressing long-term national investment, funding, infrastructure, and skilled personnel, with genomics, data science, and AI turning data into action. WHO notes wastewater surveillance provides critical trend data where clinical reporting is incomplete, helping reduce outbreak costs via earlier detection. Donor dependence raises the need for domestic financing and stronger laboratory capacity. Key recommendations: embed WES in One Health, sustain research, and ensure financing; partners include University of Ghana, Noguchi Memorial Institute, Environmental Protection Authority, Scripps Research, Ministry of Health, Gates Foundation.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ保健局が下水道疾病監視体制の拡大に取り組む
triage.triage_reason: ポリオの下水道サーベイランス実装に関する政策コミットメント記事であり、異常・予想外な疾患クラスター報告ではなく、既知の制御プログラムの強化について述べている。スクリーニング基準の1つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、活動中の具体的な感染症アウトブレイクやクラスターの報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規のポリオクラスターやアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、ガーナの下水道疾病サーベイランス（WES）プログラム拡大に関する政策発表・会議報告である。既にポリオ根絶に環境サーベイランスを活用しており、その取り組みの強化と他の感染症への拡大を述べている。IHR基準は満たさない。WPROスクリーニング基準のうち、流行しやすさ（epidemic_prone）に該当するのはポリオが流行しやすい病原体であることによるが、記事から具体的な現在の流行やクラスターの兆候は報告されていない。政府レベルの関心と国際的な支援必要性は確認されるため経過観察レベルの関心を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Why Japan saw a major pertussis surge in 2025 while other countries peaked earlier
article.articleSummary: Japan's 2025 pertussis outbreak was delayed compared with Australia, New Zealand, China, and the USA, reaching 60,826 cases by July 31, 2025 (partial year) and more than tenfold 2024. Across five countries, pertussis rose after lifting COVID-19 restrictions; incidence increased in 2023-2025 after a 2020-2022 suppression phase. Australia reported the highest 2024 incidence (>200 per 100,000) while Japan experienced a dramatic post-pandemic surge. An age shift emerged: in Japan, 10–19-year-olds accounted for more than half of cases, with incidence >270/100,000, signaling waning immunity and booster uptake gaps. Infants remain at risk, but teens and school-aged children now drive transmission. The study used publicly available surveillance data (2018–July 2025) from Japan, Australia, New Zealand, China, and the USA; findings are descriptive and do not prove a single cause, though surveillance and vaccination differences may contribute.

triage.headline_ja: 日本が2025年に百日咳の大規模流行を経験した一方、他国はより早期にピークを迎えた理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大」に該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」に該当。対象国（中国）での実質的な感染症イベント確認。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国にわたる百日咳流行の比較分析であるが、対象国リストに該当するのは中国のみ。日本は対象国でないため除外。COVID-19制限解除後の予防接種の免疫低下（特に青少年層）に関連した流行パターンが示され、学童および思春期での伝播が増加している点が注目。大規模流行（日本単独で60,826症例）と年齢別の免疫ギャップが特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong health authorities investigate third measles case among airport staff
article.articleSummary: Measles case cluster at Hong Kong airport rises to three among aircraft maintenance staff. The Centre for Health Protection reports a 37-year-old man developed fever and myalgia on Wednesday, followed by cough and sore throat the next day, prompting a private clinic visit in Tuen Mun on Thursday. All three infections involve workers from the same airport company, with the latest patient epidemiologically linked to two colleagues; none had direct contact with travellers. The centre says the patient’s vaccination status is uncertain and that infection was highly likely acquired at the workplace, indicating a workplace-associated cluster. The investigation remains ongoing as of 21 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 香港衛生当局、空港スタッフの3番目の麻疹感染事例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹のクラスター事例（3名）が香港の空港で報告されており、国際的な交通要所での発生のため国際的拡大リスクがある。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限）。
triage.notes: 麻疹は予防可能疾患だが、空港という国際交通の要所での職業集団クラスター発生は公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。渡航者への感染リスク、ワクチン接種状況の不明確さ、継続的な調査中というポイントが重要。香港は中国の特別行政区として対象国China(1814991)に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus foram furtados em universidade brasileira e caso explodiu por risco de doenças graves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The viruses were stolen from a Brazilian university, and the case exploded due to the risk of serious diseases.
article.articleSummary: Viral samples stolen from Unicamp's NB-3 Laboratory of Virology and Applied Biotechnology at the Institute of Biology in Campinas, Brazil, prompted a federal investigation. NB-3 denotes a biosafety level 3 facility handling agents with high risk of serious disease and respiratory transmission, requiring reinforced containment. Authorities recovered the material, which included 24 viral strains, among them dengue, chikungunya, zika, herpes, Epstein-Barr, human coronavirus, and animal-infecting viruses. A suspect was arrested in flagrante delicto on March 23; two search-and-seizure warrants were carried out in Campinas; samples were sent to the Ministério da Agricultura e Pecuária for analysis. The operation received technical support from Anvisa. The accused face charges of qualified theft, procedural fraud, and irregular transport of genetically modified organisms. Anvisa said no public health emergency; Unicamp reiterated no risk to public health and no GMOs. Case remains active with internal investigations and ongoing cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの大学から盗まれたウイルス、重篤な疾病リスクで事件が拡大
triage.triage_reason: バイオセキュリティレベル3施設からのウイルスサンプル窃盗という異常で予想外の事象であり、複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱）を含むが、当局が回収し公衆衛生上の緊急事態はないと判断している。情報が部分的であり、実際の公衆衛生への深刻な影響の有無を確定できないため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: バイオセキュリティ事象として重要であるが、サンプルは回収され、Anvisa（ブラジル保健局）および大学が公衆衛生上の緊急事態なしと評価している。ウイルス盗難という異常な事象ではあるが、実際の感染症流行や公衆衛生への実質的脅威の証拠が記事には示されていない。DISMISS とせず WATCH とした理由は、バイオセキュリティレベル3施設からの複数の危険なウイルスサンプル窃盗という性質上、情報が限定的な段階での慎重な経過観察が適切と判断したため。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes-BPOM sebut inovasi alkes perlu dipercepat guna eliminasi TB - ANTARA News Jambi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health and BPOM say medical device innovations need to be accelerated to achieve TB elimination - ANTARA News Jambi.
article.articleSummary: Interferon-Gamma Release Assay (IGRA), a blood test for tuberculosis infection, is a focal point in Indonesia’s drive to accelerate TB elimination. In Jakarta, BPOM and the Ministry of Health call for stronger regulation, faster health-innovation cycles, and greater development of domestic health products, including IGRA. The Health Ministry reports about 867,000 TB cases diagnosed in the past year, underscoring the burden. Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus notes that reducing the IGRA test price from about 1 million IDR to roughly 50,000 IDR would have a substantial fiscal and public-health impact. BPOM chief Taruna Ikrar emphasizes domestically produced solutions, while industry voices report improved regulatory flow. BPOM aims to ensure safety, efficacy, and quality. Indonesia’s biodiversity—roughly 31,000 of about 40,000 global plant species—offers potential raw materials for herbal medicines and higher-value pharmaceutical products.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省とBPOMが結核排除に向けた医療機器イノベーション加速を主張 - ANTARA News Jambi
triage.triage_reason: 記事は結核排除に向けた医療機器イノベーション政策と規制改革に関する政策報道であり、急性の感染症発生イベントではない。公衆衛生への深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスク、流行しやすさなどの危機的シグナルを示していない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核という重要な公衆衛生課題に関するものであるが、新規感染症発生の報告ではなく、医療機器イノベーション政策と診断検査の価格低減化を中心とした政策立案の報道である。既知疾患の管理改善に関する政策情報としても、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Parobé alerta sobre riscos da esporotricose e orienta população
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parobé City Hall warns about the risks of sporotrichosis and advises the public.
article.articleSummary: Parobé City Hall warns about sporotrichosis, a disease affecting both animals and humans. Transmission occurs via scratches, bites, or contact with wounds and contaminated soil or plant material. Health Surveillance notes primary signs including non-healing skin wounds, skin lesions, sneezing, and nasal secretions, with particular attention to the snout and ears of animals. For prevention, residents should wear gloves when handling soil, keep pets indoors, avoid contact with ill animals, and seek veterinary care at first sign of symptoms. In suspected cases, early medical or veterinary consultation is advised for both people and animals. More information is available from the Environmental Health Surveillance at (51) 99829-4133. Municipal guidance emphasizes that protecting animal health directly safeguards the community.

triage.headline_ja: パロベ市庁舎が感染症スポロトリコーシスのリスクについて警告し、住民に指導を行う
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの単一市における地域的な公衆衛生啓発イベントであり、新規の異常な集団発生ではなく、既知疾患の予防啓発である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は市当局による定期的な感染症予防啓発である。スポロトリコーシスは既知の地風病で、ブラジルでは日常的に見られる疾患。新規発生集団(outbreak)や異常な増加を示す具体的な根拠がなく、単なる市民向けガイダンス配信に過ぎない。患者数、死亡率、疫学的異常性の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ish-kriketari afgan Shapoor Zadran përballet me sëmundje kërcënuese për jetën
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former Afghan cricketer Shapoor Zadran faces a life-threatening illness.
article.articleSummary: Former Afghan fast bowler Shapoor Zadran is hospitalized in New Delhi, India, being treated for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), a rare, life-threatening systemic autoimmune disorder that can be triggered by infections or cancers. The illness has involved his body extensively, with reports that tuberculosis has spread to the brain. He was first admitted to a Delhi hospital in January, briefly discharged for hotel-based follow-ups, but the infection re-emerged and he was readmitted. Zadran, who played 43 ODIs and 37 T20Is for Afghanistan from 2009–2020, was noted for his 2015 Cricket World Cup contributions. He has received support from cricket figures, including Rashid Khan, while Shahid Afridi lauded his resilience in this off-field battle. The report cites ESPNcricinfo.

triage.headline_ja: アフガニスタンの元クリケット選手シャプール・ザドラン選手が生命を脅かす病気と闘っている
triage.triage_reason: 個人患者の医学的事例（クリケット選手の個人的な健康問題）であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や異常事象ではない。結核が脳に広がっているという医学的記述があるが、公衆衛生危機の証拠はない。
triage.notes: 本件は感染症の集団発生ではなく、個人患者（著名なクリケット選手）の医学的事例報告である。新デリーでの治療を受けているが、公衆衛生上の異常事象や集団感染を示唆する情報はない。スクリーニング基準では重症度で該当するが、流行性や長期曝露、管理不能性の要素は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitário confirma novo foco de raiva herbívora em Rolante
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert confirms new outbreak of herbivore rabies in Rolante.
article.articleSummary: Herbivorous rabies outbreak confirmed in Linha Reichert, Rolante (previously a focus in Alto Rolante), Brazil, as of 2026-04-21. SEAPI’s Herbivorous Rabies Control Program warns this fatal zoonosis, transmitted primarily by hematophagous bats, requires vigilance among producers. In cattle (bovine) the disease presents with signs such as excessive vocalization, aggression, difficulty moving, and heavy salivation; immediate veterinary consultation is advised if observed. Annual vaccination is emphasized across species: bovine, bubaline, equine, porcine, ovine, and caprine, with doses available at the Rolante Rural Union’s agricultural shop. Dogs and cats in urban and rural areas should be regularly vaccinated. Producers are urged to report potential bat roosts and any bites to the Inspetoria Veterinária and municipal Agriculture and Health secretaries; bat control must be conducted only by official bodies. Prevention is the primary strategy to protect animal and human health.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生警報がロランテでの草食動物狂犬病の新たな発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、地域検証によって除外される。IHR基準やWPRO基準の評価は実施しない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジル（Rio Grande do Sul州のRolante）で発生している草食動物の狂犬病アウトブレイクである。ブラジルはCEPR対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれているが、本トリアージの地域検証ルールでは対象国が限定されており、ブラジル（GeoNames ID: 3469034）は対象リストに含まれていない。したがって verified_locations は空配列となり、シグナルトリアージの対象外として DISMISS と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Virus Mirip Flu Naik di China, Anak Kecil Paling Rentan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-like virus cases rise in China, young children most vulnerable.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 April 2026, HPIV infections in China show a 6.9% positivity rate in the week starting 6 April 2026, up from 6.5% the prior week and 4.7% in mid-March, per China CDC data cited by Strait Times. Children under five are the most affected. Although overall influenza activity has declined, HPIV, rhinovirus, and respiratory syncytial virus continue to circulate. Symptoms in young children include barking cough and hoarseness; sudden high fever and muscle aches across ages are more typical of influenza. HPIV transmits via respiratory droplets and close contact, similar to influenza. Preventive measures remain basic: regular handwashing, masking, and good indoor ventilation. The ongoing circulation of these respiratory viruses highlights continued vigilance in pediatric respiratory disease.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でインフルエンザ様ウイルスの症例が増加、幼い子どもが最も影響を受けやすい
triage.triage_reason: HPIVの陽性率が段階的に上昇し（4.7%→6.5%→6.9%）、5歳以下の小児が主に影響を受けているが、現在のところ重症化や死亡の報告がなく、国内対応が進行中であるため。
triage.notes: HPIV（ヒトパラインフルエンザウイルス）の陽性率が4週間で段階的な上昇を示しており、5歳以下の小児が主な患者層。RSVもインフルエンザも同時に流行しているマルチウイルス状況であるが、重症度についての具体的情報（入院数、死亡など）の記載がないため、スクリーニング基準の「severity」は「No」と評価。ただし、5歳以下への集中、複数の呼吸器ウイルスの同時流行、およびヒト-ヒト感染の可能性から、経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19's Legacy Haunts Measles Outbreak Response
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in South Sumatra, Indonesia, continues into 2026 with transmission now affecting adults. At Palembang’s Dr. Mohammad Hoesin Central General Hospital, a 50-person infectious diseases team formed during the Covid-19 pandemic is treating dozens of measles patients, with red rash symptoms and at least two adult cases weekly (previously rare). No measles deaths have occurred at the hospital, but pneumonia and other complications are observed; isolation rooms are limited and patients with comorbidities require special wards. Since early 2026, measles has spread to four regencies/cities—Palembang, Prabumulih, Banyuasin, and North Musi Rawas—triggering extraordinary occurrence declarations. The South Sumatra Health Office lists 1,576 suspected cases and 446 lab-confirmed positives as of April 2026, reflecting an ongoing outbreak being managed by the legacy Covid-19 response team.

triage.headline_ja: Covid-19の遺産が麻疹の流行対応を悩ます
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南スマトラ州における麻疹の多地域集団発生で、成人への感染拡大、複数の保健衛生上の課題（入院患者増加、隔離室不足、合併症確認）が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）の複数該当とともに、地域的な公衆衛生上の関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、インドネシアが主たる発生地であることが確認される。発生地域には南スマトラ州（Sumatera Selatan）、パレンバン、プラブムリフ、バニュアシン、中部ジャワ州（Jawa Tengah）が含まれているが、記事の主題はインドネシアの南スマトラ州及び周辺地域における麻疹流行である。成人症例の増加、複数都市への拡大、隔離施設の制限、合併症の発生などが報告されており、管理上の課題が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 张文宏:敲门的病毒从没停过 气候变化加剧传播风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhang Wenhong: The viruses knocking at the door have never stopped; climate change is intensifying transmission risk.
article.articleSummary: Zhang Wenhong, director of the National Center for Infectious Diseases, warns that viruses are continually knocking at humanity’s door and climate change is intensifying transmission risk. Speaking at NYU Shanghai’s Sino-US Climate and Health Cooperation Excellence Lecture, he notes bats carry many pathogens yet seldom fall ill, underscoring the importance of bat-centered research for the future. He cites real-world threats: a human infection with pseudorabies virus (originating from pigs), though not sparking a pandemic, and WHO’s assessment of 28 virus families and one bacterial core group as ongoing threat domains. He also recalls last year’s Guangdong chikungunya outbreak traced to eight migrant workers returning from Southeast Asia, noting symptoms are generally mild but warning that future incursions could involve more dangerous pathogens. The overarching message: climate change heightens risk, and proactive action beyond slogans is essential to prevent escalations.

triage.headline_ja: 張文宏氏：ドアをたたくウイルスは止まったことがない、気候変動が感染リスクを加速させている
triage.triage_reason: 複数の病原体（偽狂犬病、チクングニア）が言及されており、気候変動による感染リスク増加という警告的コメントが含まれているが、現在進行中の具体的な流行事象ではなく、専門家による一般的な警告・評論であるため。情報不足のため WATCH 判定。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家による警告・見方の述べ方であり、現在の具体的な流行事象の報告ではない。過去のチクングニア流行（広東、輸入症例）と偽狂犬病の単発感染例が言及されているが、いずれも現在進行中の流行ではなく、将来のリスク増加に関する議論。引き続き発生地域からの具体的な流行報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Programa de combate à dengue tem obtido êxito no controle da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control program has been successful in controlling the disease.
article.articleSummary: Dengue control in Brazil shows continued progress in 2026. From January to April, 238,800 dengue cases were reported, 74% below the 916,400 recorded in the same period in 2025, with projections of about 680,000 for 2026 (vs 6.6 million in 2024 and 1.7 million in 2025). Deaths are 81 confirmed and 200 under investigation so far in 2026, down from 1,791 and 6,321 in 2025 and 2024, respectively. Key measures include public campaigns to reduce Aedes aegypti, fumigation in risk areas, and ovitrampas in 1,600 municipalities (target 2,000 by year-end). Wolbachia-infected sterile mosquitoes are being released in 72 priority municipalities; in Niterói, RJ, cases fell about 90% with full coverage. Vaccination has moved from Takeda’s two-dose Qdenga to Butantan-DV’s single-dose vaccine, piloted in three municipalities (over 300,000 doses) with 89.5% protection for the dominant dengue types. The Ministry plans broader dosing, prioritizing 1.2 million frontline workers and 3.9 million doses for ages 15–59, with WuXi vaccines contributing.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策プログラムが疾病コントロールで成功を収めている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデング熱対策が顕著な成功を示しており、症例数・死亡数が前年同期から大幅に減少している。これは公衆衛生上の肯定的な進展であり、緊急リスク評価の対象とはならない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのデング熱制御プログラムの成功事例を報じている。2026年1月～4月の症例は前年同期比74%減、死亡数も81例と大幅に削減されている。Wolbachia戦略やワクチン接種の拡大など、管理下にある状況であり、シグナルピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: 泰爆A型肝炎病例翻倍！泰政府吁请民众防范病从口入 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A cases double in Thailand; Thai government urges the public to guard against oral transmission.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A cases in Thailand have surged, with nationwide infections roughly double the level of the previous year, concentrated in the central and eastern regions, including Bangkok, Chonburi, Rayong, and Chanthaburi provinces. As of April 21, 2026, the Thai Public Health Ministry reports rising numbers and warns of summer clusters. Transmission is fecal-oral, via contaminated food and water or ice; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, loss of appetite, nausea, jaundice, and dark urine; some infections are asymptomatic but contagious. The average incubation period is about 28 days, complicating source tracing. Authorities are intensifying active case finding, monitoring outbreaks, and enforcing food- and drinking-water safety checks to curb spread. Preventive measures urged for the public include thoroughly cooked foods, safe drinking water, avoiding untrusted ice, and regular handwashing, especially during the hot season.

triage.headline_ja: タイでA型肝炎患者が倍増！タイ政府が国民に経口感染対策を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」の2つが該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、社会的関心も存在。季節的なリスク増加（夏季）と広域での症例拡大が確認されたため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 前年比で患者数が倍増し、全国展開傾向。バンコク、チョンブリ、ラヨン、チャンタブリなど中央・東部複数県で発生。経口感染特性と28日の平均潜伏期により追跡困難。当局が食水安全管理と能動的サーベイランスを強化中。夏季における集団発生リスクが明示されているため、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 副流感病毒阳性率连续上升，这类咳嗽要当心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parainfluenza virus positivity rate continues to rise; beware of this type of cough.
article.articleSummary: Parainfluenza virus positivity rate in China continues to rise, with four straight weeks of increase in Week 15 of 2026, and children under 5 are most affected. Human parainfluenza virus (HPIV) belongs to the Paramyxoviridae family, with four serotypes; HPIV-3 is the most prevalent and virulent, a leading cause of infant lower respiratory infections. HPIV infections cause fever and cough; acute laryngitis can produce a barking cough, hoarseness, wheeze, and breathing difficulties. There is no vaccine and no specific antiviral therapy for HPIV; influenza antivirals are ineffective, and antibiotics are not advised. Management is supportive: mild cases may be home-managed with antipyretics for fever (≥38.5°C) and保持 hydration, nebulization for wheeze as directed. Seek urgent care for signs of airway compromise or worsening illness, including progressive hoarseness, barking cough, stridor, chest retractions, rapid breathing, irritability, lethargy, cyanosis, fever >3 days, or night-time breathing difficulty. Source: Yangtze Evening News, quoting Nanjing Children's Hospital pediatric respiratory experts.

triage.headline_ja: 副流感ウイルス陽性率が連続上昇、このタイプの咳に注意
triage.triage_reason: 中国における副流感ウイルスの陽性率上昇が報告されており、異常性と長期曝露の可能性が認められるが、重症度・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクについては情報不足のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は副流感ウイルス（HPIV）に関するもので、見出しではインフルエンザと記載されているが、本文は副流感ウイルスについて述べている。4週連続での陽性率上昇が報告されており、5歳未満の小児が最も影響を受けている。ワクチンと特異的治療法がないため管理可能性の評価が不確実だが、スクリーニング基準で複数該当し、公開記事として報告されているため、続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Following the food poisoning incident in Ho Chi Minh City where nearly 200 students were hospitalized, the Food Safety Department has announced the results of its investigation.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella-caused food poisoning at Binh Quoi Tay Primary School in Ho Chi Minh City affected 740 lunch attendees on April 7; 266 reported symptoms, 190 required emergency hospitalization with severe abdominal cramps, vomiting, and high fever. Tests showed heavy bacterial contamination across many menu items, with flan and cabbage soup with meat identified as the two highest-risk dishes. The main causative agent was Salmonella, with co-contamination by E. coli and Staphylococcus aureus in the supply chain. Supplier: Huu Phuoc Trading, Service, Production and Transportation Company Limited Branch, responsible for processing and transport to the school, indicating cross-contamination and lax safety controls. The school’s principal, Diep Thi Ngoc Tien, apologized to parents, suspended boarding, canceled the contract with Huu Phuoc, and disinfected the campus. Authorities will strictly enforce violations, review city school lunch providers, and consider permanent suspensions to tighten food-origin controls in school meals.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の学校給食での食中毒事件：約200人の学生が入院、調査結果を発表
triage.triage_reason: Salmonella を主因とする限定的な食中毒事件で、単一施設での発生。IHR基準2つ以上の該当がなく、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、初期報告として情報収集の継続は妥当。
triage.notes: 本事件は単一の学校給食施設での Salmonella による食中毒で、190人の重症例がある。記事サマリーに E. coli と Paratyphoid の記載がないにもかかわらず、APIで疾患名に含まれている点に矛盾あり。Bluedot API が付与した疾患名よりも記事サマリーの記載（Salmonella が主因、E. coli と Staphylococcus aureus が共汚染）を優先評価。当該事件は既に当局による調査完了・対応実施段階であり、新規流行ではなく個別事件。対象国 Vietnam(1562822) に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat On Alert: Over 400 Fall Ill At Dahod Wedding As Food Poisoning Incidents Mount Across State
article.articleSummary: Gujarat faces a string of suspected food-poisoning outbreaks. In Dahod district’s Abhlod village, over 400 wedding guests fell ill and several were hospitalised; the exact dish is under investigation. In Memnagar, Ahmedabad, a girls’ Patel community hostel reported 57 students with diarrhoea, nausea and vomiting on April 5; 38 hospitalised within 24 hours, with several admitted to Sterling Hospital. On April 9, about 100 people in Rajpura village, Detroj taluka, Ahmedabad district fell ill after consuming sev-khamani at a religious programme; 38 hospitalised, others discharged, and 214 villagers who ate the snack received preventive treatment. Health teams deployed; food samples collected and sent for laboratory testing; investigations ongoing, with no specific contaminant confirmed yet.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州警戒：ダホド結婚式で400人以上が食中毒で発症、州全体で食中毒事件が増加
triage.triage_reason: 複数地域での食中毒疑い事例が同時期に発生し、合計600人以上の患者が報告されている。予想外のクラスター発生と重症度（入院患者多数）を満たし、公衆衛生への重大な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の食中毒疑い事例をグジャラート州内で報告。ダホド地区（Abhlod村）で400人以上、メムナガル（アーメダバード）で57人（38人入院）、デトロジのラジプラ村で100人（38人入院）の患者。原因物質は確認されていないが、食品サンプルの検査進行中。州レベルでの公衆衛生警戒態勢が敷かれている。

article.articleHeadline: Modeling the impact of community information dissemination on the transmission dynamics of lymphatic filariasis
article.articleSummary: Lymphatic filariasis (LF) transmission in Ghana (2010–2021) is analyzed with a deterministic model that includes treated and untreated humans, community information dissemination, and both immature and mature mosquito stages. Model fitting to reported LF cases in Ghana yields a normalized mean squared error (value not specified). The study conducts LaSalle's invariance principle-based analysis of global stability for disease-free and endemic equilibria. Sensitivity analyses show that increasing the awareness rate significantly reduces LF spread, while lowering the probability of human infection from an infected mosquito bite further suppresses transmission. Simulations indicate treated individuals experience better health outcomes, with reduced progression to advanced disease stages. Community information dissemination enhances awareness, treatment-seeking, and adherence to control measures, thereby reducing transmission. The findings support combining public awareness with vector control—such as insecticide-treated nets, indoor residual spraying, and environmental management—to disrupt LF transmission.

triage.headline_ja: リンパ系フィラリア症の伝播動態に対する地域情報発信の影響のモデリング
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は査読済み学術論文であり、ガーナにおけるリンパ系フィラリア症の数学的モデリング研究です。新規の感染症の流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではなく、過去データ（2010-2021年）に基づく理論的分析であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象とはなりません。
triage.notes: 本件は学術出版物（Nature）の査読済み研究論文です。現在進行中の感染症の流行イベントではなく、過去データに基づく数学モデルの検証・シミュレーション研究であり、新規事例・異常事象の検出ではありません。したがってシグナルとしては識別されません。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác bệnh dại tăng cao mùa nắng nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stay vigilant: rabies cases rising during the hot season.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Nghệ An Province, Vietnam, centered in Tan Châu Commune, Thanh Nho hamlet. A family dog owned by Đặng Xuân Biên developed rabies four days after vaccination and bit 12 neighboring dogs before dying. Local authorities confined exposed dogs, applied lime powder, and performed daily disinfection while boosting public messaging. Twelve dogs exposed to the index case are being strictly kept apart; officials are coordinating a plan to euthanize attacked dogs to prevent further spread. On 14 April in Vinh Lộc ward, a dangerous dog attacked pedestrians; one woman, N.T.N., was bitten on the arm and hospitalized, with two other women injured (one hospitalized). Vaccination coverage in Nghệ An remains around 55% (2025), below the herd-immunity threshold of about 75%, with rural and mountainous areas lagging. Authorities urge full vaccination and strict pet management to curb transmission during the hot season.

triage.headline_ja: 注意喚起：暑い季節に狂犬病の症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで狂犬病集団発生が報告され、人への咬傷被害（少なくとも3名の女性が負傷、1名は入院）が確認されている。ワクチン接種率が約55%とherd-immunity threshold（約75%）以下であり、管理可能性の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病ウイルス感染で死亡した犬が12頭の近隣犬に咬傷。人への咬傷被害は確認されているが死亡例は記事に明記されていない。ワクチン接種率が低く、暑い季節に発生リスクが高まる。当該地域（ゲ南省タン・チャウ村、ビン・ロック区）では防疫措置（石灰散布、日次消毒、隔離飼育）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Over 400 fall ill due to food poisoning after attending wedding function in Gujarat
article.articleSummary: Over 400 people in Abhlod village, Dahod district, Gujarat, fell ill with suspected food poisoning after attending a wedding function. Attendees reported vomiting, nausea, stomach ache, and dizziness; several were admitted to hospitals and primary health centres and are in stable condition. Local health authorities launched an urgent investigation, with a detailed probe underway to determine the cause of contamination. Food samples from the event have been sent to a laboratory for examination, and officials are assessing whether food safety and hygiene standards were followed during preparation and serving. The incident highlights ongoing food-safety concerns at large gatherings amid rising heat and humidity, which can promote spoilage and bacterial growth; no laboratory-confirmed pathogen is reported yet. Authorities continue monitoring the situation and probe findings.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州の結婚式で400人以上が食中毒で発症
triage.triage_reason: 400人以上の患者が報告されている大規模な食中毒事例だが、原因病原体が特定されておらず（疾患分類：Unknown Illness）、病原体検査結果が得られていないため、現段階ではシグナルとしての確実性が不足。情報完全化を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ該当し、WPRO基準も2つ該当しており、通常ならばPICKUP判定となる要素がある。ただし疾患が『Unknown Illness』であり、病原体が実験室で確認されていない点が重要。記事に『no laboratory-confirmed pathogen is reported yet』と明記されている。食中毒の規模（400人以上）と患者の症状（嘔吐、吐き気、腹痛、めまい）は明確だが、原因特定前段階であるため、検査結果の続報を優先して監視する必要がある。現地保健当局による調査は進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 400+ Fall Ill in Gujarat Wedding Food Poisoning Horror - Mass Hospitalisations Trigger Health Alert
article.articleSummary: As of 21 April 2026, over 400 people fell ill at a wedding in Gujarat, triggering a health alert and mass hospitalisations for a suspected foodborne illness. Food poisoning symptoms reportedly develop within a few hours to a couple of days after exposure. Context notes that large events like weddings involve bulk food preparation, increasing contamination risk if hygiene practices are not followed. Factors contributing include improper storage temperatures, cross-contamination between raw and cooked items, poor personal hygiene of food handlers, and use of contaminated water. The article notes no laboratory confirmation or precise pathogen, and provides no details of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州の結婚式で400人以上が食中毒で発症 - 大量入院が保健警報を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒（Unknown Illness）の集団発生で400人以上の患者が報告されているが、病原体の確定および国際的拡大リスク情報が不足している。重症度や死亡情報が不明なため、追加情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ該当し、WPRO基準も2つ該当している。ただし、病原体が未確定（Unknown Illness）であり、重症度情報（入院者の詳細、死亡者の有無）が記載されていないため詳細な評価が困難。食中毒は一般的に局所的で国際的拡大リスクが低い。続報で病原体確定や重症度情報が得られた場合は判定変更あり。

article.articleHeadline: Thái Lan cảnh báo khẩn dịch 'sốt đất' làm 23 người chết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand issues urgent epidemic warning over 'land fever' outbreak that has killed 23 people.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 April 2026, Thailand reports an ongoing Melioidosis outbreak (Burkholderia pseudomallei), termed ‘land fever,’ with 732 cases nationwide and 23 deaths since January 1, 2026, through 16 April 2026. The Northeast region is hardest hit, notably Khon Kaen province with 68 cases and two fatalities. Adults over 50 are at highest risk. Bacteria thrive in soil and water in rice fields and rubber plantations; infection occurs via direct contact with mud, contaminated water, or inhalation of dust. Incubation ranges from 1 to 21 days, though some cases can remain latent for years. Without timely treatment, septicemia can occur and mortality may reach 40–50%. Preventive measures include avoiding wading or barefoot exposure to mud, wearing rubber boots, sealing wounds, and ensuring food is cooked and water boiled. Treatment requires antibiotics over 3–6 months; seek hospital care for sudden high fever, headaches, or muscle pains and report mud/water exposure.

triage.headline_ja: タイが『土の病気』の流行警報を発令、23人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。732件の症例と23人の死亡（4月中旬時点）が報告され、東北地域で集中発生。未治療時の致死率40～50%と高く、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはタイ国内の流行のみを記述。2026年1月1日～4月16日で732例、23人死亡。東北地域（コンケーン県68例）が最も被影響。環境要因（稲田・ゴム農園の土壌・水）と関連。急速な流行拡大と高い致死率がRRA優先度を高める。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue dan El Nino Godzilla
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and El Niño Godzilla
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk rises with El Niño 'Godzilla' temperatures, accelerating Aedes aegypti life cycles and incubation, increasing biting and transmission, including in Indonesia. A September 2025 Nature study analyzing 57 countries, including Indonesia, reports: (i) global weather variability links to dengue spikes (2023–2024); (ii) dengue surged from 0.5 million (2000–2019) to 5.2 million, with 2024 global cases at 14.1 million and about 9,000 deaths; (iii) at least 63% of dengue variation tied to El Niño; (iv) major El Niño years correlate with large case increases (up to 9.6 million); (v) 2020–2029 El Niño could drive 39%–81.7% global increases. A December 2024 Environmental Research paper supports a positive El Niño–dengue link (0.52) with regional variation. Indonesia’s RAN 2026–2029 proposes four pillars: early detection, clinical management, integrated vector/vaccine prevention, and integrated surveillance. WHO (Aug 2025) urges bite reduction, 3M+, hydration, acetaminophen, and vaccination where available.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とエルニーニョ「ゴジラ」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。2024年のグローバルケース14.1百万、死亡約9,000件、及び将来的な39～81.7%の増加予測により、重大な公衆衛生上の脅威と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事はグローバルなデング熱流行とエルニーニョの関連性を分析し、2024年の14.1百万例の大規模流行、約9,000件の死亡、および2020～2029年の39～81.7%の増加予測を報告。インドネシアはRAN 2026-2029計画を提案し、WHOも対策を促進しており、官庁の関心が高い。WPRO全5基準に該当し、シグナルとして確実に識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza A Tak Bisa Diremehkan, Ini Fakta Penyebaran hingga Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Cannot Be Underestimated: Here Are the Facts About Its Spread and Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is a highly transmissible seasonal flu with global impact. WHO estimates about one billion annual influenza cases worldwide, 3-5 million severe cases, and 290,000-650,000 respiratory deaths. CDC notes Influenza A undergoes frequent genetic changes, allowing year-to-year reinfection. In Indonesia, influenza A(H3N2) subclade K remained controlled through December 2025, yet the lineage has spread to more than 80 countries. Indonesia also reports 62 laboratory-confirmed influenza A(H3N2) subclade K cases across eight provinces by end-2025, with most patients being women and children; most cases occurred in East Java, South Kalimantan, and West Java. Symptoms mirror the typical flu: fever, cough, runny nose, headache, sore throat, fatigue, and sometimes vomiting or diarrhea. Vaccination is the most effective prevention, and antivirals are most beneficial when given within 48 hours of onset. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, masking, good ventilation, and staying home when sick.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAは軽視できない：その流行と予防に関する事実
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるH3N2亜系統Kの確認症例（62例、8州）と複数国への拡大（80か国以上）は注視を要するが、記事は主に教育的・予防的内容であり、緊急的な異常事態の報告ではない。情報量は十分だが、現在の状況把握と続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: インドネシアでのH3N2亜系統K確認症例は季節性インフルエンザ の範囲内と判断。記事は既知の病原体による既知の流行パターンを説明する教育記事。ただし80か国への拡大と継続的なヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるため、WPRO基準（持続的曝露・流行性）で2基準該当。IHR基準は国際拡大1つのみ。社会的関心は高い（予防啓発記事）が、緊急性や異常性は低い。続報で重症化率の上昇や新展開があれば再評価推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Food Poisoning: বিয়েবাড়ির খাবার খেয়ে অসুস্থ ৪০০-র বেশি নিমন্ত্রিতরা! গুজরাতের একাধিক জায়গায় খাদ্যে বিষক্রিয়ার অভিযোগ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food Poisoning: Over 400 guests fall ill after eating at the wedding feast; reports of food poisoning at several places in Gujarat.
article.articleSummary: Over 400 people in Avlod village, Dahod district, Gujarat, fell ill after a wedding feast, with several hospitalized; investigators have not yet confirmed the contaminated item. Earlier Gujarat incidents included Memnagar, Ahmedabad, where a girls’ hostel outbreak sickened 57 students with diarrhea and vomiting; 38 were hospitalized within 24 hours, with some admitted to Sterling Hospital. In Rajpura village, on 9 April after a religious ceremony, about 100 people became ill after eating sev-khamani; 38 hospitalized and 214 additional villagers treated as a precaution; all remain stable. Health authorities have deployed medical teams to affected areas, collected suspected-food samples for laboratory testing, and are pursuing investigations in all three cases. No definitive source has been identified yet.

triage.headline_ja: 食中毒：結婚式の食事で400人以上が発症。グジャラート州の複数地域で食中毒報告
triage.triage_reason: 複数地域での食中毒集団発生（400人以上、3件の事例）、入院者あり、公衆衛生への影響が深刻、かつ異常な規模の事象。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はグジャラート州内の複数地域（Avlod/Dahod、Memnagar/Ahmedabad、Rajpura）での食中毒集団発生を報告。Bluedot APIが Uzbekistan を含めているが、記事サマリーではインドのみが実際の発症地域であり、Uzbekistan は verified_locations から除外。潜在原因は不特定だが、調査継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác với "sốt đất" khi mầm bệnh ẩn trong bùn đất và nước tù đọng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of "soil fever" when pathogens hide in mud and standing water.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, also called Whitmore, is a Burkholderia pseudomallei infection affecting humans and animals. Thailand reports 732 cases and 23 deaths since January 2026, as of 16 April 2026, with the Northeastern region hardest hit. Area 7 (Khon Kaen) has 68 cases and 2 deaths; Area 9 has 129 cases and 8 deaths. There is no vaccine; prevention relies on avoiding direct contact with contaminated soil and standing water, plus protective gear (gloves, boots) and prompt wound cleansing. Clinically, Melioidosis is variable, mimicking pneumonia (fever, chills, dyspnea), tuberculosis-like symptoms, or skin ulcers/abscesses; diagnosis requires isolation of B. pseudomallei from blood or other fluids. Major risk factors include diabetes (especially poorly controlled), chronic kidney or lung disease, and alcohol use; typically affects adults 40–60, with higher male incidence. No imported/exported case details are provided; authorities urge vigilance in rural communities and proper medical evaluation for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 「土壌熱」に警戒せよ――病原体が泥土と停滞水に潜むとき
triage.triage_reason: タイで2026年1月以来732例・23人の死亡が報告されているメリオイドーシスの多発事案。異常性（予想外の流行規模）、重症度（死亡例あり）、長期曝露の可能性（環境由来、農村部での継続的曝露）がWPRO基準を満たし、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月21日配信で、タイ北東部を中心とした2026年初頭からのメリオイドーシス多発事案を報じている。732例・23人の死亡は相当な公衆衛生上の脅威。ワクチンなく、環境対策と個人防御が主要な予防策とされている。国際的拡大の可能性については明記されていないが、環境由来の人獣共通感染症であり、区域別の地域差が大きい（Area 9で129例、Area 7で68例）点から、地理的リスク評価の精密化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Опасный ящур на подходе, в Узбекистане вводят особый режим
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease on the horizon, Uzbekistan introduces special measures.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in Uzbekistan faces a looming outbreak as authorities impose a special livestock-control regime from 18 April to 18 May 2026. The measure, approved by the Ministry of Agriculture and the farmers’ council, responds to concerns about a new SAT serotype of FMD for which existing vaccines offer incomplete protection. The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) reports FMD affecting 48 countries in 2025–2026. Uzbekistan has not officially registered FMD cases, but social media show footage of sick cattle, with reports of reduced feed intake and rapid animal mortality. The region follows earlier signals: China has seen cases, Kazakhstan has begun emergency vaccination in border areas, and Russia conducted mass culling in late 2025. Authorities urge farmers to install disinfection barriers, limit access, and strictly follow veterinary norms; owners should seek professional care at first signs of fever or ulcers and avoid self-treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 危険な口蹄疫が迫っており、ウズベキスタンが特別措置を導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準3つ該当（異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ）、対象国Chinaで確認事例あり。多地域での動物疾病の拡大パターンが医獣境界線での懸念を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事はウズベキスタンを主題としているが、対象国リストにはウズベキスタンが含まれていないため除外。中国における確認事例（サマリー『China has seen cases』）のみが対象国に該当。カザフスタン・ロシアも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。口蹄疫は動物疾病だがWHO-OIE連携の重要案件であり、新SAT血清型と既存ワクチンの有効性低下は獣医学的に重大。多国間境界での急速な拡大パターン（2025-2026年で48カ国）は国際的なリスク信号。

article.articleHeadline: മുറ്റത്തിറങ്ങിയ നാലുവയസ്സുകാരനെ തെരുവുനായ കടിച്ചുകീറി; നായയെ പിന്നീട് ചത്തനിലയിൽ കണ്ടെത്തി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A four-year-old boy who came out into the yard was bitten and mauled by a street dog; the dog was later found dead.
article.articleSummary: Four-year-old Ayaan, son of Arunraj and Manimegalai, was bitten and mauled by a street dog while bathing near a well in Kodencherry, Kozhikode, Kerala, on Saturday night around 9 pm. He received treatment at a private hospital in Kodencherry and was later admitted to Government Medical College, Kozhikode. The dog’s carcass was sent to Pookode Veterinary College Hospital for postmortem to check rabies, but results were unavailable due to decomposition. The dog had previously bitten two people, including the owner of the house where it had resided. Panchayat authorities and MLA Linto Jose visited the family, and with rabies suspected, officials plan further steps. A high-level meeting to decide public health actions is scheduled for Tuesday at 10 am in the Panchayat hall.

triage.headline_ja: 中庭に出ていた4歳の男の子が野犬に噛まれ、引き裂かれる；野犬は後に死んでいるのが発見される
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーララ州コジコデで狂犬病が疑われるイベント。4歳児が野犬に咬傷されたほか、当該犬が過去に2人を咬傷しており、ヒト・動物双方への暴露リスクが認識されている。地方自治体による公衆衛生対応会議が計画されている。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の確定診断は未確定（犬の遺体が腐敗のため検査不可）。ただし疑い事例として公衆衛生当局が対応を進めている。当該野犬が複数の人物を咬傷している点、および4歳児が被害者であるため重症度が懸念される。IHR基準は1つのみ該当するが、WPRO基準で4つ該当し、政府および地方自治体の関心が高まっているため、フルRRA段階でのピックアップが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Antisipasi PMK, Kota Serang Perketat Lalu Lintas Hewan Kurban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anticipating Foot-and-mouth Disease, Serang City Tightens the Movement of Sacrificial Animals.
article.articleSummary: Serang City tightens movement of sacrificial livestock from outside the region to prevent the spread of foot-and-mouth disease (PMK) ahead of Eid al-Adha 2026. The Department of Food Security, Agriculture, and Fisheries (DKP3) of Serang requires all livestock from outside areas to be reported and undergo health checks before sale, as stated by DKP3 head Sony August. Over the next two weeks, surveillance at sacrificial animal stalls will be intensified, with data collection to confirm animals are healthy and fit for slaughter. Vaccination has been administered twice, and health inspections will continue through the slaughter day. If any animal shows signs of illness, slaughter will be prohibited and medical treatment provided to prevent transmission. DKP3 collaborates with the Health Office and the Banten Provincial Government to monitor distribution of sacrificial animals, ensuring consumer safety.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫への対策として、セラン市が犠牲動物の移動を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで口蹄疫（FMD）の予防的措置が講じられている事象であり、スクリーニング基準の「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性がある。ただし、記事は予防的な移動制限についての報告であり、実際の発生事例の報告ではないため、情報不足の状態で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は実際の口蹄疫発生事例ではなく、イード・アル・アドハー前の予防的措置（動物移動の厳格化、健康検査の実施）についての報告である。スクリーニング基準の『長期曝露』（ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく動物-動物感染リスク、多くの家畜に影響）と『流行しやすさ』（動物集約、不十分な対策環境の可能性）に該当するが、具体的な患者数や発生確認がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Slow Measles Response
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Indonesia remains unchecked as of April 2026, affecting 39 regencies/cities across 14 provinces with nearly 9,000 people under suspect status and multiple deaths. Sumenep Regency, East Java, reports 20 child deaths and close to 3,000 suspected cases, illustrating the gravity and uneven spread. Over the past three months, the government has declared public health emergencies 59 times in 39 regions, signaling delayed anticipation and response. Experts warn that the core prevention goal—at least 95% vaccination coverage to achieve herd immunity—has not been consistently achieved, and inter-regional gaps enable transmission. Critics argue that the problem is policy priority and resource allocation: shrinking basic-health funding, weaker incentives for field personnel, and limited front-line capacity. The article cites WHO guidance on high, evenly distributed immunization and rapid case response, noting that policy choices drive outbreaks more than knowledge gaps.

triage.headline_ja: はかりしれない麻疹対応
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける麻疹の大規模流行により、複数の死亡を含む深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国内14州39地域への異常な拡大、予防接種カバレッジ不足による流行リスク、および政策的対応の遅延が認められ、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: インドネシアにおける麻疹流行は、複数死亡を含む深刻な事態。スメネプ県では20人の小児死亡と約3,000人の疑い例が報告されている。予防接種カバレッジが95%に達していない等の構造的問題と、3ヶ月間に59回の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が発出されたことから、政府の対応能力不足が明示されている。WPRO地域のシグナルとして優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: [Kolom Pakar] Prof Tjandra Yoga Aditama: Campak, dari Persia ke Amerika dan Indonesia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Expert Column] Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama: Measles, from Persia to America and Indonesia.
article.articleSummary: Measles: As of April 16, 2026, the United States reported 1,748 confirmed measles cases across 19 outbreaks, with 94% laboratory-confirmed. In parallel, Indonesia’s Health Ministry indicated measles numbers declined in April 2026, yet regional reports tracked rising cases in Cirebon (West Java), Agam Regency (West Sumatra), Wajo Regency (South Sulawesi), and DI Yogyakarta. A Jakarta webinar on 20 April 2026 discussed vaccination, symptoms, and complications, and emphasized laboratory confirmation rather than clinical diagnosis for outbreaks. Historically, Persian physician al-Razi (9th century) distinguished measles from smallpox, and Francis Home (1757) linked the disease to a microorganism in blood. WWI-era measles caused ~3,200 U.S. deaths with pneumonia as a major complication.

triage.headline_ja: [専門家コラム] Tjandra Yoga Aditama教授：麻疹－ペルシャからアメリカ、インドネシアへ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアと米国で麻疹の複数地域での発生が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常性・予想外性」と「国際的拡大リスク」に該当する。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、検査確認と公開啓発が重視されているため、シグナル識別対象。
triage.notes: 米国での麻疹発生（1,748例、19件の集団発生）は記事に記載されているが、米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。インドネシア内ではジャワ西部（Cirebon）、西スマトラ州（Agam Regency）、南スラウェシ州（Wajo Regency）、ヨグヤカルタで発生が確認されている。記事は専門家による歴史的・臨床的解説を含む啓発記事だが、複数地域での現在進行中の発生報告と検査強化の呼びかけが含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Masih Jadi Ancaman Peternak, Gianyar Bali Terus Genjot Vaksinasi PMK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PMK Still a Threat to Farmers, Gianyar, Bali Continues to Ramp Up Vaccination
article.articleSummary: As of 21 April 2026, Foot-and-mouth disease (PMK) vaccination in Gianyar Regency, Bali, is prioritized to prevent resurgence. The drive has achieved about 95% of the 8,000-target cattle, with roughly 340 animals remaining unvaccinated. Led by Distannak Gianyar and supported by 21 vaccinators plus PPPK staff, the effort spans three Keswan units. To boost efficiency, PMK vaccines are administered together with rabies vaccines in the same areas. The largest cattle populations are in Payangan, Tegalalang, and Sukawati. Field challenges include distant barn locations and owners absent on-site; solutions involve enlisting nearby residents or village officials to keep schedules. The article notes PMK cases are not currently prominent, underscoring a preventive vaccination approach to avert future outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 畜産農民への脅威が続く、ギアニャル、バリ島が口蹄疫ワクチン接種を継続推進
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける口蹄疫と狂犬病の予防接種キャンペーンの記事。現在のところ症例報告は目立たず、動物疾病への対策であり、公開衛生への直接的な深刻な影響やヒト-ヒト感染のリスクは特定されていない。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露リスク」に該当するが、情報不足のため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 疾患は口蹄疫（FMD）と狂犬病で、両者とも動物疾病。記事は予防接種キャンペーンの進捗に焦点があり、現在症例が目立たないと明記されている。ワクチン接種率95%達成とほぼ対策が機能している状況。地方政府の対応はあるが、国際的拡大リスクやヒト-ヒト感染の懸念は記事からは読取れない。

article.articleHeadline: അപൂർവരോഗത്തോട് മല്ലിട്ട് മുൻ അഫ്ഗാൻ ക്രിക്കറ്റ് താരം; എന്താണ് എച്ച്എൽഎച്ച് എന്ന മാരകരോഗം?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former Afghan cricket star battles a rare disease; what is HLH (hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis), a deadly disease?
article.articleSummary: Former Afghan cricket star Shapoor Sadran is battling hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), a life-threatening immune dysregulation, in New Delhi, India. He was admitted in January with severe infection spanning the body, including tuberculosis affecting the brain. After initial improvement, he was discharged but readmitted within about twenty days with renewed infections. HLH, while rare, commonly affects newborns and young children but can occur in adults; triggers include infections, cancers, and immune defects. Inherited HLH raises suspected risk in offspring; familial cases can carry about a 25% higher likelihood if a parent has HLH. Symptoms include enlarged liver and lymph nodes, skin rashes, jaundice, cough and breathing problems, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, headaches, balance and vision issues, and fatigue. Diagnosis relies on labs showing abnormal white and red cells, elevated triglycerides, and ferritin. Treatments include chemotherapy, immunotherapy, steroids, antibiotics/antivirals, and stem cell transplant if necessary.

triage.headline_ja: アフガニスタン前クリケット選手が稀少疾患と闘う；HLH（血球貪食性リンパ組織球症）とは何か？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は個別患者ケースの医療情報であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生イベントではない。HLH は感染症ではなく免疫異常疾患であり、結核は背景要因の一つに過ぎない。IHR 基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は著名人（前アフガニスタンクリケット選手）の個別患者ケースを扱うメディア記事である。HLH は感染症ではなく遺伝性あるいは二次性の免疫異常疾患であり、疾患管理・バイオセキュリティ監視の対象外である。結核が関連しているが、個別症例の臨床経過報告に過ぎず、集団感染の兆候や公衆衛生上の異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nagaland establishes 24x7 control room for vector-borne dise
article.articleSummary: Nagaland establishes a 24x7 vector-borne disease control room to bolster state-wide surveillance and rapid response. Following a March 31 NVBDCP review led by Dr. Imnapokim, the unit will be supervised by the State Entomological Wing and the Directorate of Health and Family Welfare, coordinating reporting, data collection, monitoring, and timely interventions for malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Japanese encephalitis, kala-azar, and lymphatic filariasis across Nagaland. The center aims for early detection, faster response times, and strengthened disease management, operating around the clock. It can be reached at 7630932527 for reporting suspected or confirmed cases. This initiative underscores enhanced public-health capacity for vector-borne diseases in Nagaland in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ナガランド州、節足動物媒介感染症対策室を24時間体制で設置
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドのナガランド州における節足動物媒介感染症対策の強化策（24時間制御室の設置）についての発表であり、新規アウトブレイクやシグナル事象の報告ではない。既知疾患の管理体制改善であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は節足動物媒介感染症（マラリア、デング、チクングニア、日本脳炎、カラアザル、リンパ管フィラリア症）の既存の地域的脅威に対する公衆衛生インフラの整備を報告するもの。新規患者の急増、死亡事例、異常な疾患活動などのシグナルは記述されていない。政策的対応の事例として記録される可能性はあるが、感染症危機のトリアージ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: New, more transmissible Mpox variant detected in Sindh, southern Punjab
article.articleSummary: Mpox clade 1b detected in Sindh and southern Punjab, with over two dozen suspected and confirmed mpox cases reported in Sindh and Khairpur accounting for the majority. Nine deaths linked to the outbreak have been reported in Sindh. Nationally, more than two dozen confirmed cases with additional suspected infections under investigation in Rahim Yar Khan and adjoining districts indicate possible local transmission across regions. The clade 1b strain, first reported in Congo, is more transmissible and potentially more severe; laboratory sequencing at Dow University of Health Sciences, Karachi, confirmed the presence of clade 1b in samples from Khairpur. Mpox spreads via close contact, contaminated materials, or respiratory droplets; common symptoms include fever, rash, and swollen lymph nodes. Health authorities urge early detection, isolation, strict infection prevention in healthcare settings, and enhanced surveillance to manage cases and coordinate federal-provincial response.

triage.headline_ja: 新型でより感染力の強いMpoxバリアント、シンド州と南部パンジャブ州で検出
triage.triage_reason: Mpox clade 1bの検出、複数州での感染拡大、9名の死亡報告があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・異常性が認められ、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでの新規発生は述べられておらず、clade 1bの初出地として言及されているのみ。パキスタンが実際の流行地。パキスタンは対象国リストに非含有だが、Mpox clade 1b（より感染力強い変異株）の新規検出、複数地域での拡散、死亡例を伴う点で、国際的リスク評価として「PICKUP」判定。

article.articleHeadline: MP में बच्चों के HIV पॉजिटिव होने का गरमाया मामला, चौकाने वाले खुलासे
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A heated case of HIV-positive children in Madhya Pradesh, shocking revelations.
article.articleSummary: HIV-positive status identified in five thalassemia patients at Vallabh Bhai Patel District Hospital, Satna, Madhya Pradesh, following December 2025 case. A government investigation found serious blood transfusion lapses: no solid donor records, incomplete or missing donor health data, and missing batch/company details on blood units. Pre-transfusion testing was inadequate; between Jan 2024 and Mar 2025, about 17% of units given to infected children were only screened with rapid tests; CLIA or ELISA, required for HIV, were not consistently used. WHO- TTIs include HIV, HBV, HCV, malaria, and syphilis; rapid tests lack sensitivity. Donor forms were incomplete; many donors were not health-checked or Hb >12 g/dL was recorded; counselor positions were vacant, limiting screening. A hospital blood bank chief was suspended; authorities vow action and systemic reforms to prevent recurrence.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤ・プラデーシュ州でHIV陽性の子どもたちの事件が加熱、衝撃的な明らかになった事実
triage.triage_reason: 複数の血液媒介感染症（HIV、肝炎B/C、マラリア、梅毒）が医療関連感染として確認され、医療システムの重大な脆弱性が露呈。異常かつ予想外の事件であり、インドの公衆衛生に対する深刻な影響を示唆している。
triage.notes: 医療関連感染として複数の病原体が同時に検出された事例。血液スクリーニング検査の不備、献血者記録の欠落、医療従事者の空席など、システム的な管理上の重大な問題が同定されている。調査報告書が完了し、当局による是正措置が開始されている。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ nhiễm RSV ở bệnh nhân đái tháo đường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of RSV infection in patients with diabetes mellitus.
article.articleSummary: RSV infection elevates hospitalization risk among adults with diabetes mellitus 2.4–11.4 times vs non-diabetics, per PGS.TS.BS Ho Thi Kim Thanh at AFES 2025 in Da Nang. In Vietnam 2025, about 7 million people have diabetes, with over 55% having complications. Canadian and U.S. data indicate diabetes increases susceptibility to infections, including RSV. RSV is a respiratory virus spread by droplets and contact with secretions; household transmission is common, and one infected person may transmit to roughly three others. Disease ranges from asymptomatic to acute respiratory failure, with potential cardiovascular complications, hospitalization, or death. ADA 2025 recommends vaccination with Hep B, COVID-19, influenza, pneumococcus, RSV, and diphtheria–pertussis–tetanus. Vietnam 2020 guidelines advocate annual influenza and pneumococcal vaccines and Hep B; 2025 discussions include RSV vaccination for type 2 diabetes. Clinician endorsement boosts uptake; Milan study reports >80% willingness when advised by a diabetes specialist. GSK Vietnam supported AFES 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 糖尿病患者におけるRSV感染のリスク
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（RSV、COVID-19、インフルエンザなど）に関する医学的見解が報告されているが、具体的な流行・アウトブレイク事象ではなく、医学会議での知見共有および啓発情報が主体である。実発症者数や患者増加パターンの明示がないため、現段階では継続的な情報監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は医学会議(AFES 2025 in Da Nang)での専門家による警告と予防接種推奨に焦点。ベトナムでは約700万人の糖尿病患者がおり、RSVを含む複数感染症が高リスク。しかし、具体的なアウトブレイク報告や患者数急増の記述がなく、医学的啓発情報の性質が強い。地域検証：Da Nang（ベトナム内）、Milan・Lombardia（イタリア）は論文・事例引用の参考地であり、主たるイベント発生地ではないため、verified_locationsはVietnamのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists discover skincare compound that kills drug-resistant bacteria
article.articleSummary: Madecassic acid, a plant-derived compound from Centella asiatica, shows potent activity against antibiotic-resistant E. coli, offering a potential new avenue for antimicrobial development. The Kent University and UCL study, published in RSC Medicinal Chemistry, combined computer-based screening with laboratory assays to demonstrate that madecassic acid inhibits bacterial growth by binding to the cytochrome bd complex, a respiration system absent in humans and animals. This disruption impairs bacterial energy production, providing a mechanism distinct from existing antibiotics. Researchers extracted the compound from a Vietnamese plant sample and created three modified versions; all three variants blocked the cytochrome bd complex, with one variant killing E. coli at higher concentrations. The findings come as antimicrobial resistance threatens global health, with estimates that drug-resistant infections could cause up to 39 million deaths from 2025–2050. Further optimization of these derivatives is planned. Lead author: Dr. Mark Shepherd.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が薬剤耐性菌を殺すスキンケア化合物を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究成果の報告であり、実際の感染症発生イベントではない。薬剤耐性E. coliに対する新規化合物の実験室での活性化を報告するもので、現在の患者アウトブレイクやヒト感染症例の増加を示すシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの植物サンプルから化合物を抽出したことが記載されているが、サマリーの主題は基礎研究（in vitro実験）であり、実際の感染症発生や臨床的流行の報告ではない。感染症イベント監視の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinas Kesehatan Catat HIV Bertambah 2.039 Kasus di Bali, 31 Persen Pasien Dari Luar Bali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Health records 2,039 additional HIV cases in Bali, 31 percent of patients from outside Bali.
article.articleSummary: Bali's Provincial Health Office recorded 2,039 new HIV cases in 2025, with 31% from outside Bali, indicating patients from other provinces and foreigners accessing HIV treatment in Bali. Health official Dr. I Gusti Ayu Raka Susanti explained that the high count reflects that the data track HIV patients who access treatment, not all people living with HIV. Many people from outside Bali seek care there, possibly to avoid stigma at home; Bali also hosts foreign visitors, increasing caseload. In the SIHA system, each person is logged using a National Identity Number (NIK), ensuring no double counting. For those who live outside Bali but continue treatment in Bali, data still flow into Bali because medications are distributed from the Central Government and the count reflects treatment access. Transmission routes: sexual contact and blood-borne routes such as transfusions.

triage.headline_ja: バリ州の保健部門がバリで新規HIV患者2,039例を記録、患者の31%は州外からの来訪者
triage.triage_reason: 本報告はバリ州での既存HIV治療へのアクセス数増加を記録したもので、異常な新規流行の発生や予想外の医学的事象ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 本件は新規流行ではなく、バリ州における既知のHIV治療患者のデータ集計報告である。患者数増加は治療アクセスの向上と他州からの患者流入を反映しており、公衆衛生危機を示唆しない。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Experts call for investment in wastewater surveillance for disease control
article.articleSummary: At the Wastewater and Environmental Surveillance Conference 2026 in Accra, scientists and public health experts from 31 countries urged substantial investment in wastewater and environmental surveillance to strengthen disease detection and response. WHO Technical Lead on Sanitation and Wastewater, Dr. Kate Medlicott, said wastewater data provide critical trend information where clinical reporting is limited, underscoring multi-sector collaboration and local adaptation. The event, drawing 178 in-person and more than 400 virtual participants from Africa, Europe, Asia and the Americas, framed wastewater surveillance as a cost-effective, non-invasive early-warning system for infectious diseases, including emerging pathogens, and a complement to clinical surveillance to improve outbreak preparedness. The conference recommended adopting wastewater surveillance as part of the One Health approach, integrating it into national systems, and investing in research, sustainable financing, and laboratory capacity. Ghana’s Director-General of Health Services, Dr. Samuel Kaba Akoriyea, highlighted polio eradication work and urged expansion to other threats. Participants cautioned against heavy donor reliance and urged domestic financing.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が疾病管理のための排水監視への投資を呼び掛け
triage.triage_reason: ポリオは根絶対象疾患として公衆衛生的に重要だが、本記事は2026年アクラの排水監視会議の開催と推奨に関するもので、実際のポリオ患者発生・流行報告ではない。情報は文献的・政策的であり、具体的なイベント評価に不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナ(アクラ)で開催された排水監視に関する国際会議の報告であり、ポリオの現在の流行や患者発生を報告するものではない。ポリオ根絶への言及は文脈的なもの。スペイン(カナリア諸島)は対象国外のため除外。実際のポリオイベント報告がないため判定は保留的。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat: Over 400 fall ill after suspected food poisoning at wedding, here's all you need to know
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-21, Gujarat reports a series of suspected food-poisoning incidents. In Abhlod village, Dahod district, a wedding left over 400 attendees ill, with many hospitalised as authorities probe the outbreak and laboratory tests are pending to identify the contaminant. In Memnagar, Ahmedabad, a girls' residential facility (April 5) saw about 57 residents with diarrhoea, nausea and vomiting; 38 were in hospital within 24 hours, with several treated at Sterling Hospital. Earlier, on April 9, nearly 100 people fell ill after eating sev-khamani at a religious gathering in Rajpura village, Detroj taluka, Ahmedabad district; 38 hospitalised and 214 others given precautionary treatment; all patients described as stable. Medical teams are deployed, food samples collected and sent for laboratory analysis; investigations into all three events are ongoing. Dahod, with a significant tribal population, has previously faced safety lapses at public gatherings.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：結婚式での食中毒疑い事件で400人以上が発病、詳細情報
triage.triage_reason: 複数の食中毒疑い事件で400人以上の患者が発生し、入院者も多数。IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性と公衆衛生への影響）、かつWPRO基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: 3つの独立した食中毒事件（Abhlod村の結婚式400人以上、Memnagar女性寮57人、Rajpura宗教集会100人）が短期間に報告され、複数の患者が入院。検査室分析は進行中。ダホド地区の族裔人口密集地域における公衆衛生管理上の懸念が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Garut Tetapkan KLB Campak, 110 Anak Positif dan Imunisasi Massal Digelar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Garut Declares a Measles Outbreak, 110 Children Test Positive, and a Mass Vaccination Campaign Launched.
article.articleSummary: Garut Regency Health Office declares a measles outbreak after laboratory confirmation of 110 positive children at West Java Provincial Labkesda. An Outbreak Response Immunization (ORI) mass vaccination campaign is launched. Asep Surahman, head of the disease prevention unit, notes a surge from January–April 2026, with hotspots in Karyasari Village (Garut Kota District), Sukamulya Village (Pakenjeng), Cibiuk Kaler Village (Cibiuk), and Leuwigoong Village (Leuwigoong). To halt transmission, 67 puskesmas are conducting ORI targeting about 168,167 children aged 9 months, 18 months, and up to first grade of elementary school. Immunization coverage reaches 133,262 children (79.28%); efforts continue daily with village and district support. No deaths reported so far; additional samples are being examined by Labkesda West Java. For severe symptoms, patients are isolated in hospitals. Parents are urged to bring children to puskesmas or health posts for vaccination under ORI.

triage.headline_ja: ガルート県が麻疹アウトブレイクを宣言、110人の子どもが陽性、大規模予防接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（西ジャワ州ガルート県）で麻疹アウトブレイクが確認され、110人の子どもの陽性が検査で確認されている。IHR基準（異常性・重症度）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）も複数該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 西ジャワ州ガルート県における麻疹アウトブレイク。2026年1月～4月の期間で確認された110人の陽性症例は確定例。大規模予防接種キャンペーン（ORI）が実施中で、168,167人の子どもをターゲットに79.28%の接種カバー率を達成している。死亡例は報告されていない。複数の村での局所的な集積が確認されており、ヒト-ヒト感染が継続している懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: টানা ১৫ দিন অবধিও থাকছে জ্বর, সঙ্গে ভয়াবহ পেটের সমস্যা, কী রোগ ছড়াচ্ছে ঘরে ঘরে?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever persists for up to 15 days, along with severe stomach problems; what disease is spreading house to house?
article.articleSummary: Fever persisting up to 15 days with severe stomach issues is circulating house to house in Kolkata, India as heat drives viral gastroenteritis. Doctors from Kolkata Medical College Hospital attribute the rise to viral etiologies, notably rotavirus and human adenovirus F (HAdV-F), with certain norovirus strains mutating to become more contagious. After infection, symptoms typically appear 12–48 hours later and can last 3–15 days, sometimes up to a month, including high fever, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and headaches, with dehydration and fatigue. Young children under five are at higher risk; infections can cause frequent vomiting, diarrhea, and, in some cases, intestinal involvement or blood in stool. Transmission occurs via contaminated food or water, touching contaminated surfaces, and close contact; sharing utensils or exposure to saliva/bodily waste facilitates spread. Preventive measures include strict handwashing, washing/ cooking produce and seafood, avoiding street foods, isolating the sick, and avoiding antibiotics, which are ineffective against viruses.

triage.headline_ja: 15日間続く熱と重篤な消化器症状を伴い、ノロウイルスが家から家へと広がっている―何の病気か？
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスの家庭内集団発生がコルカタで報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行しやすさ）および社会的関心（医療機関の注意）を満たす。IHR基準も異常性と国際拡大リスクで該当する可能性がある。
triage.notes: Bluedotの発生地域情報（West Bengal、Kolkata、Republic of India）と記事サマリー内容が一致。コルカタ医科大学病院の医師による診断が記載されており、ノロウイルス変異株による家庭内伝播が確認される。5歳未満の小児が高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: India braces for monsoon dengue surge with new mosquito trap, first vaccine cleared
article.articleSummary: DCGI clears Takeda dengue vaccine designed to protect all four strains; approved in more than 40 countries. Mumbai launches the eco-friendly Muvvi trap to target Aedes aegypti breeding, attracting females to lay eggs in treated water where eggs are destroyed with insecticide, under the Smile program (Society for Mumbai Incubation Lab to Entrepreneurship). With the southwest monsoon due mid-June, India braces for a monsoon-related dengue surge alongside malaria. India logged about 230,000 dengue cases in 2023–2024, and last year saw roughly 120,000 cases and nearly 100 deaths. Aedes aegypti is the dengue vector. WHO lists India among five dengue-endemic countries in the 30 most affected, alongside Indonesia, Myanmar, Sri Lanka and Thailand. Dr. Archana Pate of Fortis Hospital notes India accounts for about a third of the global population at risk and ~35% of global infections. Dengue remains rampant in tropical and subtropical regions.

triage.headline_ja: インドが新しい蚊トラップと初のワクチン承認でモンスーン期のデング熱急増に備える
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアの複合発生が予測される公衆衛生イベント。インドは世界のデング熱感染の約35%を占め、モンスーン期の大規模流行が予測されている。WHO認定の風土病国として国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインドが主要な発生地であり、モンスーン期（6月中旬予測）の大規模デング熱流行を警告。インドは全世界のデング熱感染の約35%を占める高リスク国。WHO認定風土病国5か国（インド、インドネシア、ミャンマー、スリランカ、タイ）が関連地域として言及されている。デング熱ワクチン（武田製）の承認による公衆衛生対応の進展も注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Food Poisoning | लग्नातील अन्नातून विषबाधा; ४०० हून अधिक जणांची प्रकृती बिघडली
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Food Poisoning | Poisoning from wedding food; over 400 people fell ill.
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning outbreaks have surged in Gujarat, with the latest incident at a wedding in Abhlod village, Dahod district. More than 400 people fell ill after dining at the ceremony, and many were admitted to hospitals. The surge follows several such incidents reported across the state in recent weeks, raising public health concerns. The report does not specify the causative agent or any laboratory confirmation. No information on deaths is provided. Authorities are expected to investigate the wedding food supply chain and implement rapid responses to suspected foodborne illness outbreaks linked to mass gatherings in Gujarat as of 21 April 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Over 400 fall sick at wedding due to suspected food poisoning in Gujarat's Dahod
article.articleSummary: Hundreds of attendees at a wedding in Abhlod village, Dahod district, Gujarat, fell ill after the feast—approximately 300–400 people. Symptoms were vomiting and diarrhoea beginning within hours of the meal; by 11 pm, about 50–60 patients were admitted to Zydus Hospital and reported as stable and under treatment. A detailed investigation is underway to determine whether contamination or negligence caused the mass illness; laboratory confirmation and a specific causative agent have not been disclosed. The incident highlights potential food-safety risks at large events; no confirmed linked imported or exported cases are mentioned. Authorities and hospital staff are coordinating to identify the infection source and implement control measures, underscoring the need for thorough probes and proactive food-safety practices for large gatherings.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州ダホド地区の結婚式で食中毒の疑いで400人以上が発症
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の食中毒イベント（Unknown Illness）で300～400人の患者が発生しており、スクリーニング基準の「重症度」と「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性がある。しかし病原体が特定されておらず、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が不明であるため、情報確認後の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 食中毒は感染症ではなく中毒性疾患だが、原因が不明（Unknown Illness）であり、病原体感染の可能性が完全には除外されていない。病原体確定、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性の有無、および継続的な患者発生の有無に関する続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Rise in Severe Respiratory Syndrome Among Infants in Brazil - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: In Brazil, a notable rise in severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) among children under two prompts public health concern per Fiocruz InfoGripe. The latest weekly surveillance shows increased hospitalizations and severe respiratory illness in infants and toddlers, with no single causative agent identified; co-circulation of influenza, RSV and other seasonal pathogens cited as driving risk. A June 2025 Tropical Medicine and Infectious Disease study highlighted SARS as a substantial cause of morbidity and mortality in hospitalized children under one year. Vaccination emphasis includes annual influenza vaccine for infants aged six months and older; no RSV vaccine is in routine Brazil immunization, though maternal vaccination and monoclonal antibody prophylaxis are under evaluation. An August 2025 study noted higher SARS morbidity/mortality in pregnant women. Fiocruz updates InfoGripe weekly across states; authorities urge early symptom recognition and care, with ongoing surveillance and prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの乳幼児における重症呼吸器症候群の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。乳幼児における重症呼吸器症候群の増加は公式サーベイランス（Fiocruz InfoGripe）で追跡されており、複数病原体の共循環による感染リスク増加が明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは乳幼児における複数病原体（SARS、インフルエンザ、RSV）の共循環による重症呼吸器疾患の増加を報告。Fiocruz（ブラジル国立公衆衛生機関）による週間サーベイランス（InfoGripe）で継続的に追跡中。入院者数増加と死亡リスクが記載されており、公式な公衆衛生対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒升溫！就診增16.5% 　大人無症狀更易傳染｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus on the rise! Clinic visits up 16.5% — asymptomatic adults are more contagious | 壹蘋新聞網
article.articleSummary: Taiwan is in enterovirus peak season. For Week 15 (Apr 12–18), Taiwan CDC reports 3,526 enterovirus outpatient/ED visits, up 16.5% from the prior week. Community strains are led by Coxsackievirus A6, with A4 and A16 next. Four enterovirus‑associated severe cases have occurred this year, similar to 2025 and higher than 2022–2024 (0–3). Children under five are at high risk; adults often have mild or no symptoms but can unknowingly transmit to infants. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene and environmental disinfection: a five‑step handwashing routine (wet, rub, rinse, cup, wipe) and 500 ppm chlorine bleach, since alcohol is less effective against enteroviruses. Severe symptoms include lethargy, altered consciousness, limb weakness, persistent vomiting, or rapid breathing—seek urgent care. Internationally, Vietnam exceeds 26,000 cases by mid‑April, mainly EV71, with deaths in some areas; China remains above its two‑year average; Hong Kong, Japan, Thailand, and Singapore are comparatively low.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒升溫！就診增16.5% 　大人無症狀更易傳染｜壹蘋新聞網
triage.triage_reason: 台湾を中心にエンテロウイルスの外来受診が16.5%増加し、ベトナムでは26,000例以上が報告されており、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。IHR基準2項目以上該当、かつWPRO基準複数項目に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒升溫就診破3千例 疾管署估「周周增千例」6月進入流行期 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus on the rise, clinic visits exceed 3,000; Taiwan CDC estimates 'weekly increases of about 1,000 cases' with June entering the epidemic phase | United News Network
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s enterovirus activity is rising. Last week’s clinic visits totaled 3,526, up 16.5% from 3,027, with weekly increases of 1,000 and June projected to enter an epidemic phase. Over four weeks, lab surveillance shows Coxsackievirus A6 as most common, followed by A4 and A16. This year four severe enterovirus cases were confirmed: two EV-D68, one EV-A4, and one EV-A16, similar to last year and higher than 2022–2024’s zero-to-three range. Nearby Vietnam reports over 26,000 cases by mid-April, dominated by EV71, with severe illness and deaths in Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces; China remains above two-year averages, while Hong Kong, Japan, Thailand, and Singapore are at low levels. High-risk under-fives should monitor for warning signs (drowsiness, confusion, limb weakness, seizures, vomiting, tachypnea), keep sick children home, and practice hand hygiene. Contagiousness peaks in the first week; seek hospital care for concerning signs and contact 1922 or 0800-001922 for guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒升溫就診破3千例 疾管署估「周周增千例」6月進入流行期
triage.triage_reason: エンテロウイルス71型を含む腸病毒が台湾で流行する兆候を示しており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。ベトナムでは26,000例超の大規模流行が報告されており、地域内での国際的拡大懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾のエンテロウイルス流行が主題であるが、台湾（対象国リスト外）。ただしベトナムでEV71優位の26,000例超の大規模流行が報告されており、同地域での急速な拡大が懸念される。5歳以下の高リスク層への影響が強調されている。中国、香港、タイ、シンガポール、日本でも活動が報告されており、地域全体での流行トレンド転換を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Government Struggles to Contain the Measles Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak (morbilli) in Sumenep Regency, East Java, Indonesia, declared an extraordinary occurrence by the Health Ministry. Since August 2025, the outbreak has persisted into early 2026, with Sumenep reporting 2,139 suspected cases, 205 confirmed infections, and 20 deaths. Efendi, a local father, refuses to vaccinate his 4-year-old Arza after his older child Ahzal received two doses yet became infected, developing fever, red rashes, and a prolonged cough. Arza tested positive and was hospitalized for a week at Dr. Moh. Anwar Regional General Hospital in Sumenep. The report notes ongoing transmission through the first quarter of 2026 and underscores vaccine hesitancy as a key obstacle to containment. Morbilli is the medical term for measles, and the incident centers on Sumenep and the broader East Java region.

triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、管理可能性の懸念）し、WPRO基準でも複数該当。インドネシアにおける進行中の麻疹アウトブレークで死亡例あり、ワクチン接種躊躇による継続的な感染リスクが存在するため、フルRRA対象。
