article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue no Brasil caem 75% em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases in Brazil fall by 75% in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Brazil falls 75% in 2026. From Jan 1 to Apr 11, 2026, 227,500 probable dengue cases were notified, down from 916,400 in the same period in 2025, continuing the decline after 2024’s 6.6 million and 2025’s 1.7 million. The Health Ministry credits coordinated actions with states and municipalities, including expanding ovitrapping for Aedes aegypti to 1,600 municipalities (target 2,000 by year end), advancing sterile-insect releases and Wolbachia deployment in 72 priority municipalities. Dengue vaccination reached 1.4 million doses for 10–14-year-olds; in 2026 a national single-dose vaccine from Instituto Butantan was piloted in three municipalities for ages 12–59, with health workers vaccinated (over 300,000 doses). Malaria in 2025 hits its lowest level since 1979, down 15% from 2024 and 30% overall, with deaths down 28% (54→39). In Yanomami Territory, cases fell 22% and deaths 80%, linked to expanded diagnosis, tafenoquine use for over 25,000 patients, and better rapid testing.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ブラジルにおけるデング熱患者が75%減少
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱およびマラリア患者数の大幅な減少を報告する記事であり、公衆衛生上の肯定的なニュース。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、シグナル識別の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症が減少・管理下にあることを報告する肯定的なニュースである。ブラジルでのデング熱患者数は過去3年間で大幅に減少（2024年660万人→2025年170万人→2026年1〜4月22.75万人）しており、マラリアも1979年以来の最低水準に達している。これは感染症危機の顕在化ではなく、むしろ対策の成功を示唆する情報であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定される。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒疫情增溫！就診人次飆升16.5％ 疾管署估6月進入流行期 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus outbreak heats up! Outpatient visits surge 16.5%; Taiwan CDC estimates it will enter the epidemic phase in June.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan's enterovirus outbreak accelerates; outpatient visits rose 16.5% to 3,526 last week, and Taiwan CDC foresees the epidemic phase starting in early June, with a peak anticipated mid-to-late June and a decline by late June/early July. Contagiousness is highest in the first week; households with school-age children should rest and minimize contact, and maintain hand hygiene. Four weeks of surveillance show Coxsackie A6 as the dominant strain, followed by A4 and A16; EV71 has not been detected. Four severe cases this year include two EV-D68, one Coxsackie A4, and one Coxsackie A16, similar to last year but higher than 2022–2024. By mid-April, Vietnam reports over 26,000 cases, EV71 predominant, with Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces reporting severe disease and deaths; the outbreak is expected to rise. China is falling but above two-year averages; Hong Kong, Japan, Thailand and Singapore are at low levels.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒疫情增溫！就診人次飆升16.5％ 疾管署估6月進入流行期
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71を含む腸病毒の多地域同時流行。台湾で患者数16.5%増、ベトナムで26,000例以上の確認、重症例・死亡例報告あり。IHR基準2項目以上該当、WPROスクリーニング複数基準該当。
triage.notes: 台湾でのEV71検出はゼロだが、ベトナムではEV71が優位。複数国での同時流行パターン。香港・シンガポール・日本は低レベルだが記事で言及されているため除外。サマリー主題はアジア太平洋地域のenterovirus流行。

article.articleHeadline: WASPADA! Sampah di Badung Belum Sepenuhnya Tuntas, DBD dan Leptospirosis Jadi Ancaman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ALERT! Trash in Badung Not Yet Fully Cleared, Dengue Fever and Leptospirosis Pose a Threat.
article.articleSummary: Badung Regency, Bali faces ongoing solid-waste challenges even after disposal at Suwung landfill was allowed, with uncollected waste still needing sorting and proper placement to prevent health risks. The Badung Health Office, led by Dr. Made Padma Puspita, warns that poor cleanliness is linked to outbreaks of mosquito-borne dengue fever (DBD) and leptospirosis, a bacterial infection transmitted via rat urine. Stagnant water around piles of trash can boost mosquito breeding, while unsanitary conditions raise concerns for diarrheal diseases and potential rabies transmission from wildlife. Officials urge consistent source-separation of waste and organics should be processed through modern waste facilities or composting bins. Badung, a tourism hub, has a heightened responsibility to protect environmental health to preserve visitor safety and the local economy. Published 21 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 警戒！バドゥン地域のゴミ問題未解決、デング熱とレプトスピラ症が脅威
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・バリのバドゥン地域でデング熱とレプトスピラ症の発生リスクが報告されており、スクリーニング基準では「流行しやすさ」が該当する。しかし実際の症例数、死亡者、入院患者の具体的データが記事に記載されていない。環境衛生と廃棄物管理の問題に基づく予防的警告であり、現在のところ顕在的な流行の証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は廃棄物管理の不備に起因するデング熱とレプトスピラ症の潜在的リスク警告である。実際の確認症例や死亡者の数値が提示されていないため、現時点では予防的警告段階。バリのような観光地での衛生問題は社会的関心が高い。継続的にモニタリング必要。

article.articleHeadline: Jalankan Arahan Wamenkes, Plt Bupati Chandra Bakal Screening Ulang 2.568 Pasien TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carry Out Deputy Health Minister's Directive, Acting Regent Chandra to Re-Screen 2,568 TB Patients.
article.articleSummary: Wakil Menteri Kesehatan Benjamin Paulus Octavianus visited TB tracing activities under the Integrated TB Program Cek Kesehatan Gratis in Kutoharjo, Pati Regency, on 21 April 2026. TB is a top priority under President Prabowo Subianto and Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka; Indonesia ranks second globally in TB burden, about 384 cases per 100,000. In Pati, 2,658 TB cases were identified last year. The program provides free health screenings, including chest X-ray for households of TB patients, to interrupt transmission. Government targets at least 120 free health check points in Pati before end-2026. The strategy includes preventive treatment for those not ill and treatment for the sick, plus cross-ministerial efforts to renovate homes lacking proper ventilation; 34 homes are registered. Acting Regent Risma Ardhi Chandra vows rapid data re-verification (within 10 days) and will report results to the Ministry of Health for action.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣の指示を実行、チャンドラ代理県知事が2,568人のTB患者の再スクリーニングを実施予定
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのパティ県でTB（結核）の大規模スクリーニング・対応プログラムが展開されており、スクリーニング基準では複数該当するが、記事は政府の対応措置の進展報告であり、新規患者発生や感染拡大を示す直接的な証拠に欠ける。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インドネシアは世界的にTB負担が2番目に多い国。記事はパティ県での官民連携による予防治療・スクリーニングプログラムの推進状況を報告しており、新規爆発的流行を示す情報ではない。ただしTBの高い疾病負担と政府の優先対応が強調されており、疫学的トレンドの変化を監視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tay chân miệng 'nóng' trở lại, Hà Nội kích hoạt chiến dịch phòng dịch trong trường học
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease resurges as Hanoi activates a school-based epidemic prevention campaign.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) resurges in Hanoi, prompting a 2026 school-based prevention campaign. On April 21, at Ngô Thì Nhậm Kindergarten in Ha Dong, Hanoi’s Department of Health launched environmental hygiene and proactive disinfection in preschools amid rising HFMD risk. HFMD is a viral illness transmitted via the fecal–oral route, predominantly affecting children under 5. Nationally (2023–2026), reported HFMD cases exceed 34,000 in early 2026 with 8 deaths; 2023: ~178,000 cases and 32 deaths; 2024: ~82,000 cases and 1 death; 2025: ~105,000 cases and 2 deaths. Hanoi recorded 6,271 cases in 2025 (no deaths) and 2,308 cases in the first four months of 2026 (no deaths). About 95% of cases are under 5, with all 126 Hanoi communes reporting cases. Measures include handwashing, safe food, no shared items, cleaning toys and surfaces, proper sanitation, and a minimum 10-day school absence; disinfectants such as Cloramin B are used.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が再び流行、ハノイが学校ベースの流行防止キャンペーンを始動
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム（対象国）でエンテロウイルス71による手足口病が流行しており、IHR基準では「異常性」と「国際拡大リスク」が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が全て該当。政府レベルでのキャンペーン実施と社会的関心の高さが確認されるため、シグナルとしてピックアップ。
triage.notes: 記事では2026年の国家レベルでの流行データ（34,000超）と死亡事例（8件）が示されており、ハノイでは126の区町村全てで患者報告がある。95%が5歳未満児であることが強調されている。学校閉鎖や消毒などの管理措置が既に講じられている。エンテロウイルス71は重症化リスク（神経症状など）があり、国際的な監視対象として重要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird flu alert in Bengaluru: How it spreads, symptoms and preventive measures - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: Bengaluru reports a confirmed case of highly pathogenic avian influenza (H5N1) in Hesaraghatta, with infection detected at a government poultry training centre in Mathkuru village and lab-confirmed on April 14. Authorities declared a 3-km infected zone and a 10-km surveillance zone around the site. Culling removed more than 7,400 chickens; over 14,000 eggs were destroyed and 2,250 kg of poultry feed disposed. About 10 staff in contact with poultry are in quarantine; door-to-door surveillance covers 19 nearby villages with a population exceeding 25,000. The area includes 54 chicken shops and 36 nearby villages identified as potential spread zones. Transmission occurs via contact with infected birds or contaminated surfaces, inhalation of droplets, or exposure to body fluids. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches, headache, fatigue, and shortness of breath. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding sick/dead birds, boiling/pasteurizing milk, and using protective gear when exposure is unavoidable.

triage.headline_ja: ベンガルールの鳥インフルエンザ警報：感染経路、症状と予防対策 - CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: インドでH5N1の確認症例が報告され、IHR基準3項目に該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。動物から人への感染リスクを含む高病原性鳥インフルエンザであり、大規模な防疫対応と地域監視が実施されている。
triage.notes: 高病原性H5N1の確認症例として、インドで初の人への感染報告の可能性がある。7,400羽以上の鶏の殺処分、10-14人以上の濃厚接触者隔離、25,000人超の周辺人口への監視対応が行われている。ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒就診人次增　疾管署估6月中下旬進入流行 | 生活 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus-related clinic visits rise; Taiwan CDC estimates an outbreak will begin in mid-to-late June | Life | CNA
article.articleSummary: Taiwan is entering the enterovirus season. Last week (April 12–18) enterovirus emergency/clinic visits reached 3,526, up 16.5% from 3,027 the prior week. The CDC anticipates a continued rise, about 1,000 more visits weekly, with the outbreak peaking in mid-to-late June and receding after late June to early July as schools close. Over the past four weeks, laboratories show Coxsackievirus A6 predominance, followed by A4 and A16; four lab-confirmed severe enterovirus cases this year include two EV-D68 infections and one each of Coxsackie A4 and A16. This level matches last year and surpasses 2022–2024 averages. Regionally, Vietnam reports a severe outbreak with over 26,000 cases by mid-April, dominated by enterovirus type 71, with Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces sustaining severe disease and deaths. China remains above two-year averages though declining; Hong Kong, Japan, Thailand, and Singapore are at low activity. Public health guidance stresses handwashing, changing clothes after returning home, environmental cleaning, staying home when ill, and monitoring infants for warning signs.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒就診人次增　疾管署估6月中下旬進入流行
triage.triage_reason: 複数対象国（ベトナム、台湾/中国、タイ）でエンテロウイルス症候群の同時多発が報告されており、ベトナムでは重症例・死亡例を含む大規模流行（26,000例以上）が確認されている。IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ベトナムではエンテロウイルス71型による重症流行が進行中で、死亡例も報告されている。台湾では流行ピークが6月中下旬予想され、複数株（EV-D68、Coxsackie A4/A6/A16）が検出されている。中国は2年平均を上回る活動水準。これは地域的な複数国同時発症であり、RRA実施が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: รู้จักโรคไข้ดิน!! สธ. ยกระดับเฝ้าระวังหลังพบผู้ป่วย 752 ราย เสียชีวิตแล้ว 23
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Know Soil Fever!! Ministry of Public Health steps up surveillance after 752 cases, 23 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (soil fever) surveillance in Thailand shows 752 cumulative cases and 23 deaths as of Jan 1–Apr 18, 2026 (incidence 1.16 per 100,000; mortality 0.035 per 100,000), with 376 hospitalizations. The most affected age groups are 60+, 50–59, and 40–49 (329, 215, 100 cases). Burkholderia pseudomallei thrives in soil and water; infection occurs via contact with wet soil or water, contaminated food/water, or inhalation of dust. Although overall numbers are not yet high, case severity and hospitalization are notable among individuals with diabetes, who account for about 90% of deaths; elderly and agricultural workers with predisposing conditions are a priority for monitoring. The season is not yet at peak rainfall, but the rainy season (May–Aug) poses higher risk. Preventive measures include wearing boots or waterproof coverings, washing after contact, drinking boiled or packaged water, avoiding dusty environments, and seeking medical care for fever ≥2 days with exposure history; diagnosis relies on culture confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 「土壌熱を知ろう」厚生省が患者752人、死亡23人確認後に監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスは重症度が高く（死亡率3.1%）、タイでの有意な公衆衛生イベントだが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当判定に至らず。スクリーニング基準複数該当するも、現時点での国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクの明示的記載がないため、続報観察が適切。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはタイで地域的に既知の疾患であり「異常」ではないが、2026年1月～4月中旬で752例、死亡23例（致死率3.1%）の報告は公衆衛生上の関心事。高リスク群（糖尿病患者が死亡の約90%）の特性化と季節性（雨季5～8月の増加リスク）が監視強化の理由と判断される。国際拡大の明示的リスクについては記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Mixed Tuberculous and Aspergillus Empyema in a Man
article.articleSummary: Mixed tuberculous and Aspergillus fumigatus empyema with pneumothorax in a 76-year-old man in Hefei, China (Anhui No. 2 Provincial People’s Hospital), published 2026-04-21. History of lung squamous cell carcinoma treated with tislelizumab; SARS‑CoV‑2 positive on admission. CT showed right hilar mass, pleural effusion; CRP 218 mg/L. Initial pleural fluid cultures were negative; sputum yielded Acinetobacter, Stenotrophomonas, Klebsiella, Streptococcus, A. fumigatus, A. flavus, and SARS-CoV-2. After susceptibility testing, therapy was changed to cefoperazone-sulbactam, moxifloxacin, and voriconazole. The patient developed a right pneumothorax with extensive emphysema, requiring chest drainage with negative-pressure suction. Pleural fluid later confirmed Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex and A. fumigatus; the patient was discharged but died 5 days later. The case underscores diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of rare mixed tuberculous and fungal empyemas, especially in immunosuppressed hosts.

triage.headline_ja: 男性における結核性とアスペルギルス混合膿胸
triage.triage_reason: 単一の免疫抑制患者における稀な臨床ケース報告であり、集団発生・流行の兆候がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクはない。
triage.notes: 本事例は安徽省合肥市の医療機関で報告された76歳患者の臨床ケース（症例報告）である。結核とアスペルギルス混合感染は極めて稀であり医学的に興味深いが、単一患者の報告に過ぎず、集団感染・流行の発生ではない。患者は免疫抑制状態にあり（肺扁平上皮癌治療中）、特殊な環境因子と考えられる。感染症イベント検知（シグナル検知）の対象にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: गुजरात के दाहोद में 400 लोग बीमार, शादी की दावत से अचानक हुई उल्‍टी, कई अस्पताल में भर्ती
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 400 people fell ill in Dahod, Gujarat; sudden vomiting at the wedding feast; admitted to several hospitals.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 April 2026, more than 400 people in Abholod village, Dahod district, Gujarat, fell ill after a wedding feast. Attendees reportedly consumed paneer curry and mango juice; vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain began around 11 PM. About 50 patients were admitted to Zydus Hospital in Dahod, with roughly 150 admitted to private hospitals. A village medical team treated about 200 individuals on-site. The report identifies the incident as a food poisoning outbreak linked to the feast, with no confirmed causative agent provided in the text. The rapid onset within hours of the event points to an acute foodborne illness.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州ダホドで400人が病気、結婚式の宴会で突然嘔吐、複数の病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への影響は深刻、異常/予想外）。また急性食中毒アウトブレイク（400人超の患者発生）として、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 単一の結婚式イベントにおける急性食中毒アウトブレイク。400人超の患者発生、複数施設への入院例が確認されている。原因病原体は未確定だが、パニールカレーとマンゴージュースの摂取後11時間以内に症状発現。地域衛生当局の対応が必要。継続的な監視推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 北部10多歲學生染麻疹　162人列管防擴散｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles contracted by a northern-region student in their early teens; 162 people placed under surveillance to prevent spread | Nextapple News Network
article.articleSummary: Measles in Taiwan: A northern-region student in their early teens contracted measles; 162 people are under surveillance to prevent spread. By April 21, 2026, Taiwan has eight measles cases this year, ages ranging from under 1 to 50s; two are locally acquired and six imported. Infection sources include Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, and Kyrgyzstan, underscoring ongoing importation risk. International outbreaks are noted in Japan (236 cases by April) and Kyrgyzstan (over 8,500 since 2025), with Kazakhstan (~2,000), and in the Americas (Mexico ~9,000; Guatemala ~3,500). Travel advisories have been issued for several countries. Measles is highly contagious and airborne. Returning travelers with fever, rash, runny nose, or cough within three weeks should wear a mask, seek medical care, and disclose travel history. Vaccination (MMR) remains the best prevention; boosters may be advised for travelers 2–4 weeks before departure.

triage.headline_ja: 北部10多歳学生が麻疹に感染、162人が管理下に置かれ感染拡大を防止｜壹蘋新聞網
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準で全5項目該当。複数対象国での集団発生と国際的な流行背景があり、公開情報および政府関心が高い。
triage.notes: 台湾での麻疹集団発生を主題とする記事。サマリーに基づき、台湾での現地感染および複数国からの輸入例（ベトナム、マレーシア、インド、インドネシア、キルギスタン）が確認されている。対象国リストに含まれるのはベトナム、マレーシア、インド、インドネシア。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないが、イベント発生地として記載。日本、カザフスタン、メキシコ、グアテマラでの流行は背景情報として言及されているが、これらの国での新規確認を主題としていないため除外。麻疹は空気感染性で高い感染力を有し、渡航関連輸入リスクが明確に述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo bệnh tay chân miệng tăng mạnh ở trẻ mầm non
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Hand, foot and mouth disease on the rise among preschoolers.
article.articleSummary: HFMD rising among preschoolers in Ho Chi Minh City and Da Nang, Vietnam, as of 21 April 2026. The enterovirus spreads quickly in crowded classrooms via direct contact with respiratory secretions, saliva, feces, contaminated surfaces, or shared objects; the virus can persist on surfaces for hours. Typical symptoms include fever (mild to high), mouth ulcers, sore throat, and a vesicular rash on hands, feet, knees, elbows, or buttocks, with irritability and sleep disturbance. Severe warning signs include persistent high fever, tremors, rapid breathing, vomiting, or drowsiness, which may indicate neurological or cardiovascular complications requiring urgent care. There is no widely available vaccine; prevention relies on frequent handwashing, cleaning toys and environments, not sharing personal items, and coordinated school-health measures. Parents should monitor symptoms, ensure hydration, seek care if symptoms worsen.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：手足口病が就学前児童の間で急速に増加
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病が、ベトナムのホーチミン市とダナンで就学前児童を中心に集中発生しており、IHR基準（異常性・重症度の可能性）およびWPRO基準（異常/予想外・流行しやすさ）に該当。スクリーニング基準を複数満たし、地域的な公衆衛生関心も高い。
triage.notes: Enterovirus 71は神経学的・心血管系の合併症を引き起こす可能性があり、重症化のリスクが指摘されている。学校環境での人-人感染が急速であり、就学前児という脆弱集団が主な影響を受けている。ワクチンが利用できないため、予防対策が重要。続報および他国への波及可能性をWATCH。

article.articleHeadline: 5年首見外籍生染麻疹「匡列接觸者162人」　疾管署發函教育部示警 | ETtoday健康雲 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First measles case among foreign students in five years; 162 contacts traced; CDC issues warning letter to the Ministry of Education.
article.articleSummary: First measles case among foreign students in Taiwan in five years: a teen foreign student in the north tested positive after late March entry; fever, sore throat, and rash appeared in early April and were lab-confirmed. The Taiwan CDC traced 162 contacts, monitoring through May 1. The agency sent a letter to the Ministry of Education urging schools to boost health monitoring of foreign students and remind travelers to measles-endemic areas such as Japan. Global outbreaks persist in Asia (Japan, Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, Vietnam, Indonesia, India, Bangladesh), the Americas (Mexico, Guatemala, United States), and Europe (UK, Italy, Spain); Japan reported 236 cases by April 8. Taiwan has eight measles cases this year, with 2 domestic and 6 imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, and Kyrgyzstan. Vaccination is emphasized; those born since 1966 may seek pre-travel MMR assessment; practice hygiene and masking.

triage.headline_ja: 5年ぶりに外国人学生が麻疹に感染「接触者162人」　疾病管理庁が教育部に警告書を発送
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で麻疹の輸入症例が確認され、接触者162人が追跡調査中。アジア・米州・欧州での複数国での流行が継続しており、国際的拡大リスク、異常性、重症度基準に該当。対象地域(ベトナム、インドネシア、インド)での流行確認も含まれている。
triage.notes: 台湾はスクリーニング対象国ではないが、本事例は対象国(ベトナム、インドネシア、インド)からの輸入症例と関連している。アジア太平洋地域での麻疹流行が複数国で継続中であり、WPRO基準で全5項目が該当。記事では日本の流行(236例)も言及されており、地域的な流行の深刻さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: เปิดลิสต์ 5 เมนูสุดฮิตต้องระวัง 'หน้าร้อน' หมอเตือน ท้องเสียระบาด 'อาหารสุก' วางทิ้งไว้นานก็เสียได้
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top 5 popular dishes to watch out for this summer — doctors warn of diarrhea outbreaks from cooked food left out too long.
article.articleSummary: Thailand faces summer diarrheal outbreaks as rising temperatures accelerate growth of bacteria and viruses in foods. Pathogens include Vibrio in semi-cooked seafood; Salmonella in meat, raw eggs, and unpasteurized milk; Escherichia coli in contaminated water and produce; and Staphylococcus aureus toxins in foods left at room temperature. Norovirus and Rotavirus, common winter viruses, may be encountered via contaminated ice or items. Even cooked foods can cause illness if left out more than two hours or via cross-contamination; heat may not destroy toxins, and Bacillus cereus spores can survive. Five Thai dishes to watch: chicken rice and red pork rice; coconut milk curries and desserts; raw vegetables; mayonnaise-based sauces; and seafood half- or semi-raw, plus fried rice leftovers. Symptoms include diarrhea, fever, abdominal cramps, and vomiting; seek care for dehydration or fever >38.5°C or if no improvement within 48 hours. Prevention: eat hot, use clean utensils, wash hands, refrigerate leftovers and reheat once; BRAT diet.

triage.headline_ja: この夏気をつけるべき5つの人気メニュー — 医師が長時間放置された加熱食品からの下痢の流行に警告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の食品由来病原体（ノロウイルス、腸炎ビブリオ、E.coli、パラチフスなど）が関連し、夏季の水準を超えた下痢流行の可能性があるが、具体的な患者数、死亡数、または流行の規模に関する定量的データが記事に記載されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は医学的警告・予防啓発コンテンツであり、既存の流行報告というより夏季の食品衛生リスクの季節的な警告である。患者数、死亡数、流行規模の定量的データが不足しており、深刻度が不明。複数の病原体と長期曝露リスク（気温上昇に伴う細菌増殖、不適切な食品保管）が指摘されているため、WPRO基準の3項目に該当。実際の流行状況の把握には続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RS emite alerta sanitário para raiva herbívora na fronteira; entenda o que significa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RS issues a public health alert for herbivore rabies at the border; understand what it means.
article.articleSummary: Herbivore rabies alert issued by the State Department of Agriculture for the Noroeste and Missões border regions after outbreaks in Tiradentes do Sul and São Nicolau. No bat refuges have been located yet, though bats transmit the virus to herbivores. The alert aims to mobilize cross-border vaccination and prevention efforts, with teams working to identify potential bat refuges in the area. The report warns that outbreaks could spread to neighboring towns such as Esperança do Sul, Crissiumal, and Derrubadas near Tiradentes do Sul, and Pirapó, Garruchos, and Dezesseis de Novembro near São Nicolau; given the border with Argentina, cross-border coordination is noted as informal. Producers are advised not to capture roosts; report sightings to the Municipal Inspection or the Office of Agricultural Defense. Typical bat roosts include hollow tree trunks, caves, rock crevices, burrows, tunnels, and abandoned houses. Affected animals include cattle, buffalo, and horses.

triage.headline_ja: RS州が国境地帯のウシ科動物狂犬病に対する公衆衛生警報を発令；その意味を理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部Rio Grande do Sul州でウシ科動物（家畜）の狂犬病アウトブレイクが報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・疫病流行性）に該当する可能性がある。しかし人的被害やヒト-ヒト感染の具体的証拠、管理能力の不足を示す情報が不明であるため、詳細な情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語で、ブラジルのRio Grande do Sul州における家畜（ウシ、バッファロー、馬）の狂犬病アウトブレイクを報告。蝙蝠からの感染が示唆されており、アルゼンチンとの国境地帯でのクロスボーダー調整が言及されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）するため、本来はPICKUP候補だが、人的死傷・公衆衛生上の深刻度、管理能力に関する具体的情報が不足しているため、より詳細な続報を要するWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta: morcegos-vampiros ameaçam rebanhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert: Vampire Bats Threaten Livestock.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in herbivores transmitted by vampire bats (Desmodus rotundus) is under sanitary alert in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, after disease foci were detected in Tiradentes do Sul and São Nicolau. Six municipalities are in the alert zone, with risk expected to expand to nearby towns including Esperança do Sul, Crissiumal, Derrubadas, Pirapó, Garruchos, and Dezesseis de Novembro. Vampire bats shelter in hollow trees, caves, rock crevices, burrows, tunnels, and abandoned houses. Bats may only be captured by trained State Rabies Control Núcleos; farmers should not attempt captures and must report refuges to the municipal Inspectorate or the Office of Agricultural Defense. Rabies in herbivores is fatal once clinical signs appear; vaccination of herds is the principal preventive measure to protect livestock and regional sanitary security.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：吸血コウモリが家畜を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの畜産関連狂犬病イベント。家畜への影響は重大だが、ヒト感染の直接的リスクが不明。社会的関心が高い可能性があるが、詳細な被害規模や公衆衛生への深刻度が記事から特定できない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の畜産での発生であり、ヒト感染のリスク評価が不明確。記事は動物疾病対策（家畜ワクチン接種、コウモリ駆除）に焦点。WPROスクリーニングでは長期曝露（複数自治体にまたがる継続的リスク）と流行しやすさ（吸血コウモリによる継続的伝播の可能性）が該当するが、IHR基準は該当なし。詳細な被害数、致死率、国際的リスク、ヒト感染の有無などの情報不足により WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : 56 cas suspects, 6 morts à Walikale - le choléra progresse, la riposte piétine - Journal de Kinshasa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: 56 suspected cases, 6 dead in Walikale — cholera is spreading, the response is faltering — Kinshasa Journal
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Kibua health zone, Walikale, North Kivu, DRC, with 56 suspected cases and 6 deaths since March 2026. The hardest-hit sites are Ntoto, Langira and Kilungu, where displacement from Masisi has crowded shelters with no latrines or potable water, fueling transmission. Children over five are among the hardest hit; symptoms include explosive diarrhea, vomiting and dehydration, with case fatality exceeding 10% without rapid rehydration. Health facilities report shortages of Ringer lactate, catheters, antibiotics and basic supplies, while roads are unsafe and ambulances lack fuel. Red Cross teams disinfect homes and raise awareness, but water, sanitation and access remain critical gaps. The WHO pillars—water, sanitation and reactive vaccination—are acknowledged, and authorities urge humanitarian partners to intervene as Kinshasa and armed groups negotiate in Montreux, linking security and health.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ワリカレで疑い患者56例、死亡6例——コレラが拡大、対応が停滞——キンシャサ・ジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響：10%超の致命率、死亡者報告；異常性：急速な流行；国際的拡大リスク：人口移動と不衛生環境）。スクリーニング基準全5項目該当。対象国DRCで進行中の感染症イベント。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはスイス（Montreux）とアンゴラが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは両国での実際の感染症イベント報告はない。Montreux記載は交渉地点として言及されているのみ。verified_locationsはDRCのみ。2026年3月以降進行中の流行で、水・衛生環境が悪く伝播リスクが高い。国際人道支援の必要性が言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM đã có 3 ca tử vong do bệnh dại, nắng nóng có thể làm gia tăng nguy cơ mắc bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records 3 rabies deaths; hot weather could increase the risk of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City records 3 rabies deaths from January–April 2026; all three cases were fatal, while the entire 2025 year had 5 rabies cases. Hot, sunny weather is cited as potentially boosting rabies risk, described as the disease’s peak season. A dog in Phước Thắng ward, Ba Rịa province, bit 3 people between 13–17 April; the dog, a female mixed breed, had not been vaccinated and later died on 17 April after also killing 4 of its own puppies, biting 2 other dogs, and attacking 7–8 neighboring dogs. The three bite victims had received rabies vaccination and remain in stable condition. Ho Chi Minh City’s health authorities outline strengthened control measures and the 5 “no” rules for managing dogs and cats, including vaccination, reporting, leash use, preventing bites, and avoiding environmental contamination. Post-bite care emphasizes thorough wound washing (15 minutes), disinfection, medical evaluation, and rabies vaccination and/or immunoglobulin as indicated, with a warning against traditional remedies.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で狂犬病による3人の死亡を記録；猛暑が狂犬病感染リスクを増加させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による致命的な患者発生（2026年1月～4月に3人死亡）が報告され、IHR基準における重大な公衆衛生への影響が認められる。また、ベトナムの対象国であり、同期間での死亡率の上昇および季節的リスク増加が指摘されている。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市およびバリア地方での狂犬病発生を報告。2026年1月～4月の3件の死亡は2025年年間の5件と比較して高い死亡率を示す。予防措置（犬の予防接種、報告体制、リード着用、咬傷予防）が当局により強化されている。ワクチン接種済みの咬傷患者3人は安定した状態にある。

article.articleHeadline: แอกซ่าประกันภัยห่วงใยสุขภาพเด็กไทย แนะนำทุกครอบครัวเตรียมรับมือโรคจากยุงรับฤดูฝน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AXA Insurance Cares for Thai Children's Health, Recommends All Families Prepare for Mosquito-Borne Diseases During the Rainy Season.
article.articleSummary: Mosquito-borne diseases are highlighted in Thailand during the rainy season, with dengue fever, chikungunya, Zika virus, malaria, and Japanese encephalitis posing elevated risk as children spend more time outdoors. The Department of Disease Control, Ministry of Public Health, reports 43,587 dengue cases and over 35 deaths in 2025 (Thai year 2568). Despite rising awareness, outdoor activity without protection and standing water in homes remain key transmission drivers. AXA Insurance recommends five simple ways to reduce risk and promotes its Tropical Disease Insurance to help families manage medical costs. The policy covers mosquito-borne diseases, with annual premium starting at 146 THB, no health check, and lump-sum benefits up to 30,000 THB. Eligible from age 15, applicants can obtain the policy via email online and receive benefits after at least one night of inpatient care. Terms subject to conditions.

triage.headline_ja: AXA保険がタイの子どもの健康に関心を寄せ、雨季に蚊媒介感染症に備えることをすべての家族に推奨
triage.triage_reason: タイで蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ、マラリア、日本脳炎）の多重警報が報告されており、2025年に43,587件のデング熱症例と35人以上の死亡が確認されている。ただし、記事は保険商品の宣伝が主眼で、急性の流行状況や国際的拡大の明示的なリスクは詳細に述べられていないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 複数の蚊媒介感染症が同時報告されており、雨季に件数増加が予想される。記事は保険商品宣伝が中心で、疾病管理局からの統計数字（2025年デング熱43,587件、死亡35人以上）が最大の根拠。継続的なサーベイランスが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: ചൂട് കൂടുന്നത് പാരിസ്ഥിതിക പ്രശ്നം മാത്രമല്ല; പകർച്ചവ്യാധികൾക്കും കാരണമാവുന്നു- കേന്ദ്രമന്ത്രി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising heat is not just an environmental issue; it is also a cause of infectious diseases - Union Minister.
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, India: Union Minister Jitendra Singh cautions that rising heat is not only an environmental issue but also a driver of infectious diseases and public health problems. He cites dengue fever as a concrete example and notes heat-related exacerbation of heart-related health issues, framing heat as a legitimate public health concern across the country. Singh emphasizes that India is confronting heat-linked infections and lifestyle diseases in several regions, reflecting broader climate-health risks. The remarks were delivered at the Global Heat & Cooling Forum organized by the Natural Resources Defense Council (NRDC). The report does not provide specific case or death counts, outbreak details, or laboratory confirmations, but highlights the need for climate-adaptation strategies to mitigate heat-driven health impacts nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: 上昇する気温は環境問題だけではなく。感染症の原因にもなっている - インド連邦大臣
triage.triage_reason: 記事は気候変動と感染症の関係に関する一般的な警告であり、具体的な発生事例、患者数、死亡例、実験室確認、流行の詳細がない。デング熱は例示的に言及されているが、現在の具体的なアウトブレイクを報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は気候変動と感染症リスクの関連性に関する政策的声明であり、具体的なアウトブレイク報告ではない。デング熱は例として言及されているのみで、実際の発生数、確認例、地理的範囲の詳細がない。シグナルトリアージのレベルには達しない。

article.articleHeadline: Over 400 fall ill at Gujarat wedding feast, FSSAI seeks detailed report from state - Business Upturn
article.articleSummary: Over 400 guests fell ill from mass food poisoning at a wedding feast in Abhlod village, Dahod district, Gujarat, India. Most reported vomiting, nausea, stomach pain and dizziness within a short time of eating. FSSAI has sought a comprehensive report from the Gujarat government, including numbers of catering workers, storage and preparation conditions, and the type of food served. Health officials collected food and drink samples from the premises; samples have been sent to accredited laboratories, with results expected in coming days. FSSAI and local authorities are monitoring the sampling, environmental hygiene checks, and the preparation-and-serving chain. Pending lab findings, authorities have warned that legal action may follow against those responsible for lapses in hygiene, storage, or handling. The incident underscores the enforcement of basic catering-safety guidelines at large events, including temperature control, safe water use, and vendor licensing.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州の結婚式での集団食中毒：400人以上が発症、FSAIが州に詳細報告を要求
triage.triage_reason: 400人以上の食中毒患者が報告されており重症度と規模は注視に値する。しかし現時点では死亡や重症患者の報告がなく、原因特定前であるため、情報確認後の判定が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の食中毒イベント（結婚式での食物起因感染症）と判断される。Bluedot APIが提供した「Unknown Illness」分類は不適切である可能性があり、実際には水系・食物系感染症と考えられる。死亡報告がなく、症状は軽～中程度（嘔吐、悪心、腹痛、めまい）。原因特定待ちのため、検査結果が判定に重要。地域検証により、インド（グジャラート州ダホド地区アブロド村）が対象国に該当することを確認。

article.articleHeadline: Measles And Rubella Outbreak In Bangladesh, With Meghalaya On Alert | Find Out What Are The Serious Health Complications Of Measles
article.articleSummary: Measles and Rubella outbreak in Bangladesh has caused over 100 deaths due to measles-related complications since March. As of 19 April 2026, Bangladesh reported more than 3,443 confirmed measles cases and about 23,600 suspected cases. Vaccination efforts have intensified, with over 1.9 million children having received the measles-rubella vaccine. Measles is highly contagious, posing high risk to malnourished children, pregnant women, and those with weak immune systems; it spreads through coughing, sneezing, close contact, or sharing utensils, with fever and skin rashes among common symptoms noted in reporting. The outbreak has prompted cross-border concern in neighboring India, prompting Meghalaya to heighten surveillance in border districts, notably West Jaintia Hills, in collaboration with the WHO to prevent cross-border transmission and strengthen preparedness. Parents are urged to ensure MR vaccines are given on schedule; no serious cases have yet been reported in Meghalaya.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュでの麻疹とおたふくかぜの流行、メガラヤが警戒態勢へ | 麻疹の深刻な健康合併症について
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の二重流行により100人以上の死亡、3,443確定例、23,600疑い例が報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。さらにWPRO基準の「高い重症度」「流行しやすさ」も満たすため、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: バングラデシュでの実質的な流行（100人以上の死亡、3,443確定例）、インド側（メガラヤ州）での国境監視強化と越境感染防止対策実施が記事で明記されている。WHOとの協力体制も確認。予防接種が大規模実施中だが、流行が継続している段階。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : préparatifs avancés pour le lancement de la campagne de vaccination contre la poliomyélite. - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Advanced preparations for the launch of the polio vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign advanced in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. The launch is planned for Wednesday, 22 April 2026 at 10:00 at the 30 June Roundabout, targeting about 2 million children aged 0–59 months through door-to-door vaccination. The campaign runs 23–25 April 2026 with a recovery day. Prisca Luanda Kamala, the chief health coordinator in the Governor’s North Kivu cabinet, urged parents to make children available and to sensitize others for a successful rollout. Preparations were advanced during a governorate meeting with health services and partners. The effort covers the entire North Kivu province, with supervisors and vaccinators to be supported to maximize coverage.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：ポリオワクチン接種キャンペーン開始に向けた準備が進む
triage.triage_reason: ポリオはIHR対象疾患であり国際的関心が高いが、本記事は予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンの準備報道であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクイベント（患者発生、死亡例など）の報告ではない。DRCでの実施状況を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事はポリオの実際のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、DRC北キブ州ベニでのワクチン接種キャンペーン準備に関するニュース報道です。ポリオは根絶が進む疾患であり、この報道は公衆衛生対応活動として理解されるべきです。ただし、DRCでの実施状況と成果については引き続き注視する価値があります。

article.articleHeadline: Tuyên Quang chỉ đạo tăng cường phòng, chống bệnh dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuyên Quang directs intensified prevention and control of African swine fever
article.articleSummary: African swine fever outbreak in Tuyên Quang Province, Vietnam, since January: 43 households across 26 hamlets in 13 communes affected; 361 pigs culled, weight over 20 tons. Officials warn very high risk of reoccurrence and spread due to environmental persistence of ASF virus, complex transmission routes, widespread smallholder farming with weak biosecurity, and adverse weather. The Department of Agriculture and Environment calls for intensified education on biosecurity and safe husbandry, applying the motto 'household guarding household, hamlet guarding hamlet, commune guarding commune' and the '4 at the spot' approach to rapid containment. Measures cover pig transport, slaughter control, and handling of pork products to reduce losses; plans to protect breeding stock and restock after outbreaks. Border communes should cooperate with authorities to curb smuggling and illegal movement of animals and products. The Department of Livestock, Veterinary and Fisheries will monitor the situation and propose countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: トゥエンクアン州がアフリカ豚コレラの防止と制御を強化するよう指示
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラは動物疾患であり、公衆衛生への直接的な影響は限定的であるが、ベトナムでの発生拡大リスクが認識されており、地域的な管理可能性への懸念がある。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラは動物感染症であり、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響」という観点では人間への直接的な脅威に限定される。記事ではベトナム当局の積極的な対応と管理体制が述べられており、国際的な拡大リスクについては明記されていない。WPRO基準では長期曝露リスク、流行リスク、管理の必要性が確認されるため、引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sigue la alerta por la fiebre Chikunguña: hubo 268 casos nuevos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya fever alert continues: 268 new cases.
article.articleSummary: 268 new chikungunya cases reported, raising total confirmed and probable to 837 (746 autochthonous, 91 with travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Cuba). In SE 14, 2026, 93% of cases are in the NOA region, with Salta (494), Tucumán (144) and Jujuy (80) as major foci; other provinces report smaller counts (Santiago del Estero 47; Catamarca 17; Buenos Aires Province 28; Córdoba 14; CABA 7; Entre Ríos and San Luis 2 each; Santa Fe and Chaco 1 each). Authorities maintain intensified SFAI surveillance and promote direct testing (qRT-PCR and ELISA NS1) within the first 6 days of symptoms to characterize arboviruses and enable early control alerts. Dengue adds 5 new cases (BA x2, CABA x2, Salta x1 with PBA travel); season total 45, with 55.6% locally acquired. Influenza A(H3N2) shows 18 new cases of subclade J.2.4.1 (K), total 136 (78% of influenza). Three new pertussis cases; Hantavirus remains at 32 across several provinces.

triage.headline_ja: チクングンヤ熱アラート継続：268の新規症例
triage.triage_reason: チクングンヤ熱の大規模多地域発生（837例、93%がNOA地域に集中）であり、ブラジルなど複数国への渡航歴がある症例を含む。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・重症度の懸念が複数該当し、同時にデング熱、インフルエンザなど複数の血清病原体が活動中。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域の大部分がアルゼンチン（対象国外）だが、記事サマリーに『ボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバへの渡航歴のある91例』と明記されており、ブラジルへの国際感染拡大リスクが確認される。ブラジルのみ対象国として verified_locations に含める。同時発生：デング熱45例、インフルエンザA(H3N2) 136例、百日咳、ハンタウイルス32例。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia to Secure New US-Made Tuberculosis Drug
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) drug from the United States, currently in phase 3 trials, could shorten Indonesia’s TB treatment from six months to one month. Indonesian Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin said Jakarta has ordered the medication and aims to be among the first to receive it, with initial supply from the United States and domestic production preparations by Bio Farma. The regimen would consist of a one-month oral course followed by a supplemental antibiotic injection, leveraging direct bloodstream delivery to maintain efficacy and bypass digestive losses. The drug has completed phase 2 with promising results. Bio Farma is preparing production facilities, and Indonesia targets a 2029 launch before the end of President Prabowo Subianto’s term. Sadikin noted regional politicians favored the timing, suggesting potential monetization of policy success by 2029.

triage.notes: 本記事は結核の疾患動向報告ではなく、治療薬導入計画のニュース。医療介入に関する政策情報であり、EBS活動のシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Primer caso probable de Chikungunya en Santa Fe - Sin Mordaza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First probable case of Chikungunya in Santa Fe - Sin Mordaza
article.articleSummary: Argentina's Ministry of Health confirms the first probable Chikungunya case in Santa Fe Province; the patient, with travel history, is based in the Rosario department. By 11 April, Santa Fe reported 234 suspected cases, with one probable and 226 ruled out; two remain under study. Nationally, 6,518 suspected Chikungunya cases have been reported, including 837 confirmed or probable. Travel-associated cases come from Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba. In Salta, locally acquired cases without travel history have emerged, indicating local transmission. The Northwest accounts for about 93% of cases, with foci in Salta, Tucumán, and Jujuy; outbreaks have expanded to Catamarca, Santiago del Estero, and Buenos Aires, including first cases in Buenos Aires City and Córdoba. Symptoms: fever, polyarthralgia, myalgia, headache, diarrhea, vomiting. One severe case and one death, both in Salta.

triage.headline_ja: サンタフェ州での最初の疑い例チクングニア熱 - Sin Mordaza

triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域はアルゼンチンの複数州を示しているが、対象国リストには含まれていない。記事サマリーに記載されているトラベル関連症例の移入源国のうち、対象国リストに含まれるはブラジルのみ。本イベント自体はアルゼンチンでの局所伝播の進行を示唆しており、2026年4月時点でかなり進行した流行状況と考えられる。ただし評価基準上、verified_locationsは記事で実際に発生が記述された対象国のみ列挙する。

article.articleHeadline: Over 200 fall ill after wedding feast in Dahod
article.articleSummary: Food poisoning outbreak in Abhlod village, Dahod district, Gujarat, after a wedding feast on Monday night (April 20, 2026). Approximately 400 guests attended a dinner around 8 p.m. that included mango juice. By Tuesday, officials reported more than 200 villagers suspected to be ill; at least 59 were admitted to hospitals. Doctors said all patients are currently stable. The article provides no laboratory confirmation or a specified pathogen. The infection source is not confirmed, but the event’s food supply is implicated. The ongoing situation involves a clustered foodborne illness among wedding guests in Abhlod, with authorities monitoring hospitalizations and response as of April 21, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ダホード地区での結婚式の宴会後、200人以上が発症

triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは病原体が特定されていない（Unknown Illness）ため、食中毒の可能性は示唆されているが確定診断がない。59人が入院し患者数が200人以上と相当規模であるが、国際的拡大リスクは現在のところ低い。病原体の特定と原因究明が進展した時点での再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cientistas da USP usam ultrassom para destruir vírus da gripe e Covid-19 em laboratório
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists from USP use ultrasound to destroy the influenza virus and COVID-19 in a laboratory.
article.articleSummary: Ultrasound acoustic resonance inactivates SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) and H1N1 influenza in vitro at the São Carlos Institute of Physics, USP, Brazil. The method uses targeted ultrasonic vibrations to mechanically disrupt the viral envelope, causing structural fragmentation or altered morphology, rendering viruses non-infectious while sparing human cells. Researchers observed an 'popcorn effect' where viral particles absorb acoustic energy and lose infectivity. The approach leverages size and structural differences between viruses and human cells, allowing existing clinical ultrasound frequencies to be used safely. The study, published in Scientific Reports, remains early-stage and laboratory-based; planned steps include organoid models, animal studies, and eventual clinical trials. Current work focuses on how different viruses respond to sound waves, with initial emphasis on COVID-19 and H1N1.

triage.headline_ja: USP科学者らが超音波を用いてインフルエンザウイルスとCOVID-19を実験室で破壊

triage.notes: 本記事はBluedot APIによってCOVID-19およびインフルエンザに分類されているが、実際の感染症発生を報告するシグナルではなく、治療技術開発に関する学術研究報告である。記事サマリーで明確に『in vitro』『laboratory-based』『early-stage』『planned steps include organoid models, animal studies』と述べられており、現在の感染症クライシスを示唆していない。シグナルトリアージの対象外として見送りが適切である。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Fakfak Menetapkan Status KLB Akibat Campak Rubella Meluas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fakfak Health Office Declares Outbreak Status as Measles-Rubella Spreads.
article.articleSummary: On 21 April 2026, Fakfak Regency Health Office in West Papua declares a clinical measles-rubella (Campak Rubella Klinis) outbreak (KLB) after 15 suspected cases identified in Fakfak. Pariwari District shows 8 suspected cases, with Kampung Tanama reporting 4. Officials cite high transmission risk linked to measles (Sarampa) and epidemiological ties within shared environments. The outbreak status aligns with national increases in measles cases, prompting intensified prevention, active surveillance, and expanded immunization coverage to interrupt transmission. Papua Barat Dinas Kesehatan’s Surveillance and Immunization Section will monitor weekly reports and conduct field verification in Fakfak due to epidemiologic links. Measles is a highly contagious respiratory infection caused by Morbillivirus, spread via droplets, with initial fever, cough, runny nose, conjunctivitis, Koplik spots, and a spreading red rash starting on the face and head.

triage.headline_ja: ファクファク保健局、麻疹・風疹の拡大に伴い感染症流行宣言を発表
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹・風疹の同時流行を宣言（15疑い例）。高い感染性、予防接種カバー率の課題、国内的な増加傾向と相まって、ヒト-ヒト感染による地域的な拡大リスクが明確であり、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ファクファク地域での15疑い例が官式流行宣言（KLB）の基準を満たした。麻疹は高感染性病原体であり、予防接種カバー率の課題がある環境での同時流行は地域内拡大リスク高。パプア州全域での週単位監視と追加接種計画が実施予定。国立レベルでの流行増加傾向も背景。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Makassar kolaborasi UNICEF tingkatkan kemampuan nakes tangani KLB campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Makassar Health Office collaborates with UNICEF to strengthen health workers' capacity to respond to a measles outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak response in Makassar: The Makassar Health Office, with UNICEF, is strengthening frontline capacity to manage a measles outbreak (KLB) in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia. About 94 health workers from 47 puskesmas, serving as disease surveillance and immunization coordinators (korim), attended a 20–21 April 2026 workshop. The program enhances vaccine management and immunization techniques with a Rapid Response (TRC) to speed up epidemiological investigations and fast case response for vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs). It targets reducing zero-dose children through catch-up immunization and active tracing. Makassar is one of seven areas in South Sulawesi declared a measles outbreak by the Ministry of Health, with dozens of positive cases. UNICEF notes rising cases and warns that many children have not received the DPT1 dose, highlighting the need for preparedness and vaccination to avert VPDs such as measles, rubella, diphtheria, and pertussis.

triage.headline_ja: マカッサル保健局がUNICEFと協力し、麻しん流行に対応する保健労働者の能力強化を推進
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマカッサル地域で麻しんを含む複数のワクチン予防可能疾患（麻しん、風疹、ジフテリア、百日咳）の流行が宣言されており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPRO基準でも「異常性」「重症度の懸念」「流行性」「対応困難性」が複数該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: South Sulawesi州内のマカッサルを中心に麻しん流行が宣言され、4種類のワクチン予防可能疾患（measles, rubella, diphtheria, pertussis）が同時に記載されている。ゼロ線量児童の割合が高く、DPT1接種率の低さが指摘されており、ワクチン接種体制の脆弱性が懸念される。UNICEFが支援に関与していることから国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dikunjungi Wamenkes, Plt Bupati Chandra Komitmen Perkuat Penanganan Tuberkulosis di Pati
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister Visits Pati; Acting Regent Chandra Commits to Strengthening TB Control.
article.articleSummary: On 21 April 2026, Deputy Health Minister Benjamin Paulus Octavianus visited Kutoharjo Village Hall, Pati Regency, to boost integrated TB tracing under the Free Health Check (CKG) program. The visit underlines efforts to strengthen TB control in Pati, where 2,658 TB cases were recorded in 2025, potentially infecting family members. Free checks include chest X-ray screening for household members to detect transmission early; those not infected receive preventive therapy, while exposed individuals begin treatment. The government targets at least 120 locations for free checks across Pati to accelerate management. The deputy noted cross-ministerial plans to renovate homes lacking adequate health standards; 34 homes in Pati are registered for renovation. Plt Bupati Risma Ardhi Chandra pledged data validation within 10 days and comprehensive re-checking of patients and families. Afterward, the delegation visited Desa Tlogomojo, Batangan District, to hand over repairs for TB patients’ homes.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣がパティを訪問、チャンドラ代理摂政は結核対策強化にコミット
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの地方行政による結核対策強化の取り組み報道であり、公式な政府プログラム実施の記事。IHR基準は明確に該当せず、スクリーニング基準も該当しにくいが、結核という重要な感染症の統制措置と数字（2025年2658例）が記載されている。情報が不足しており、動向監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の継続的な曝露（長期曝露）を示唆しているが、これは既知の慢性感染症であり新規シグナルではない。2025年の2658例は増加傾向か過去の一般的なレベルかが不明。政府による対応体制の強化報道であり、公衆衛生上の危機的な新展開を示さない。結核は常在疾患であり異常性（unusual/unexpected）は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Bandarlampung perkuat pelacakan TBC hingga tingkat kelurahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bandar Lampung strengthens TB contact tracing down to the urban village level
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Bandarlampung, Indonesia, is being tackled by strengthening case-finding and contact tracing down to the kelurahan (urban village) level to accelerate elimination. Health official Muhtadi Arsyad Tumenggung says the city now maintains detailed TB patient rosters with names and addresses for each puskesmas catchment, enabling guaranteed medication supply and regular monitoring. Thirty-one Puskesmas serve TB patients; not all have Molecular Rapid Testing (TCM), but testing continues via referrals. TCM is available at strategic sites including RSUD Abdul Moeloek, RSUD A. Dadi Tjokrodipo, private hospitals, and some puskesmas. Two treatment pathways: confirmed TB cases must complete six months of standard therapy; those with negative screening receive TB preventive therapy (TPT) weekly for 12 weeks. Local policy includes a mayoral decree and action plan regulation on TB control. As of 21 April 2026, the initiative targets intensified elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: バンダルランプン市、都市村レベルまで結核接触追跡を強化
triage.triage_reason: 結核の公衆衛生対応強化に関する報道であり、新規発生や異常を示す情報がない。既存対策の進捗報告であり、IHRおよびWPROスクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・バンダルランプン市における結核対策の強化と運用改善に関する地域ニュース報道である。新規流行や異常事態の報告ではなく、既存プログラムの進捗状況を伝えるもの。患者数の増加、重症度の上昇、予期しない発生状況などの懸念材料がないため、シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Libatkan Kader hingga Tingkat Kelurahan, Bandar Lampung Perkuat Upaya Putus Rantai TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Involve cadres down to the kelurahan level, Bandar Lampung strengthens efforts to interrupt TB transmission.
article.articleSummary: Bandar Lampung, Indonesia — The city’s health department expands tuberculosis (TB) elimination efforts beyond clinics by engaging cadres and ward officials down to kelurahan levels. The Bandar Lampung Health Office (Dinkes) intensifies case finding, education, and direct patient support in communities, using a by-name, by-address registry to enable rapid monitoring and interventions for transmission. Frontline cadres, closest to residents, are key to faster case detection and ensuring adherence to treatment. Prevention targets families and close contacts; individuals who screen negative receive three months of weekly preventive therapy. Policy support and local funding enable cross-sector collaboration to sustain community-based TB elimination and raise public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: バンダルランプン市、ケルラハン（村落）レベルまでの活動員を巻き込み、結核伝播遮断の取り組みを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのバンダルランプン市における結核対策の強化に関する行政ニュース。既知感染症の既存対策の拡充報道であり、IHR基準やWPROスクリーニング基準への該当なし。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核という既知感染症に対する市レベルの行政的な対策強化を報じたもの。新規発生、異常な疾病パターン、急速な拡大、国際的なリスク、または重大な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆する要素はない。地域行政による継続的な感染症対策の一環として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sífilis avança no Brasil, preocupa autoridades de saúde e levanta alerta para possível cenário de epidemia nos próximos anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Syphilis advances in Brazil, worrying health authorities and raising concerns about a potential epidemic scenario in the coming years.
article.articleSummary: Syphilis cases are rising across Brazil, stressing hospitals, primary care and prenatal services, with authorities warning of a potential epidemic among youth and pregnant women. Ministry of Health bulletins through 2025 show an upward trend in acquired syphilis, while syphilis in pregnant women and congenital syphilis remain elevated. Caused by Treponema pallidum, syphilis is mainly transmitted sexually without condoms; vertical transmission can occur during pregnancy or birth, but prenatal penicillin prevents most congenital cases. The infection progresses from a painless primary chancre to secondary rashes on the trunk, palms and soles, mild fever and malaise, then latency, and potentially tertiary disease affecting the heart, brain and bones. Congenital infection can cause low birth weight, malformations and respiratory problems, including abortion, preterm birth or neonatal death, mitigated by timely prenatal treatment. Contributing factors include reduced condom use among youth, reliance on dating apps, testing gaps and penicillin shortages, stigma, and difficulties tracing partners. Early diagnosis via rapid tests and penicillin remain central to prevention.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで梅毒が急増、保健当局が懸念を表明し今後数年の流行可能性に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ以上満たし（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急増傾向、国際的拡大のリスク）、重症度（先天梅毒による死産・新生児死亡リスク）が確認される。また社会的・政治的関心も高い（保健当局の警告、流行シナリオへの懸念）。
triage.notes: ブラジルで梅毒（獲得梅毒および先天梅毒）の症例数が急増している。妊婦および若年層を中心に流行が拡大しており、保健当局が流行警報を発出。ペニシリン不足、低いコンドーム使用率、接触者追跡の困難さが感染拡大要因として指摘されている。先天梅毒による新生児死亡などの重大な健康被害が報告されている。

article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever alert continues in Argentina with 268 new cases, bringing total confirmed and probable to 837 (746 autochthonous, 91 imported from Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay and Cuba). In epidemiological week 14, 2026, 93% of cases are in the NOA region, led by Salta (494), followed by Tucumán (144) and Jujuy (80). Other provinces show increases: Buenos Aires Province 28, Córdoba 14, City of Buenos Aires 7, with smaller counts in Entre Ríos, Santa Fe, and Chaco. triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンはWPRO対象国外であり、IHR基準を満たすか不明確。スクリーニング基準は複数該当の可能性があるが、対象国内での発生ではないため経過観察対象。

article.articleHeadline: تفشي الحصبة في ام حوش بدارفور وشيكان بشمال كردفان - Dabanga Radio TV Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak in Umm Hosh in Darfur and Shikan in North Kordofan
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak accelerates in Umm Hosh, Toloyisha locality, North Darfur, with first cases registered March 26 and about 300 infections to date; nine deaths confirmed. Twelve patients are isolated in a school facility, with isolation limited to seven hours per case due to scarce resources. Laboratory tests in Gabish and Jabir confirm measles; transmissions occur mainly within households under harsh living conditions and weak health services. Medical supplies are nearly exhausted despite three emergency deliveries by Toloysha Emergency Center. Authorities and humanitarian actors are urged to intervene to contain spread. In North Kordofan, 994 measles cases have been reported, 905 in Shikan, including 646 in IDP camps. A vaccination drive for polio (1–5 years) and measles (9 months–15 years) is planned next week in Shikan, Umm Roba and Al-Rahd, targeting 273,165 and 634,833 children respectively. In Umm Roba, deaths relate to prior vaccination gaps caused by insecurity and movement constraints.

triage.headline_ja: ダルフール地域ウムホシュおよび北コルドファン地域シカンでの麻疹集団発生
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の急速な拡大（約300感染、9名死亡）と不十分なリソース、ポリオワクチン接種計画の実施予定があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当、スクリーニング基準4項目以上該当、地域の公衆衛生危機として明らかにシグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはSudan（ダルフール、北コルドファン）が含まれているが、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）にスーダンは含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。ただしこのイベントは公衆衛生上極めて重要な麻疹集団発生であり、地域スクリーニング基準により技術的にはシグナル基準を満たす。記事にはポリオ（Poliomyelitis）の言及があるが、主題は麻疹集団発生である。

article.articleHeadline: ICMR launches pioneering study to address zoonotic spillover risks
article.articleSummary: India's first inter-ministerial study to detect zoonotic diseases at the human-bird-forest interface, aligned with the National One Health Mission (NOHM), was launched at ICMR in New Delhi. It will survey select bird sanctuaries and wetlands in Sikkim, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu. The initiative follows outbreaks of Nipah, SARS, Swine Flu, MERS, Ebola, Zika and COVID-19 and highlights rising spillover risks linked to deforestation. NCDC Director Ranjan Das stresses understanding spillover mechanisms for timely action; the study strengthens surveillance at the human-animal-environment interface to improve preparedness. India sits along the Central Asian migratory bird flyway, making bird sanctuaries and their workers particularly vulnerable to pathogens carried by migratory birds. As of 21 April 2026, the initiative marks NOHM's proactive One Health approach.

Health authorities call on parents to vaccinate their children to ensure protection against polio, measles, and rubella.

article.articleHeadline: Fiebre chikungunya, ya hay 837 casos y crece la transmisión autóctona
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya fever: there are already 837 cases, and local transmission is increasing.
article.articleSummary: A chikungunya fever outbreak in Argentina has reached 837 confirmed or probable cases, including 746 autochthonous and 91 imported (travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba). In epidemiological week 14 of 2026, 268 new cases were reported; 93% are in the NOA region (northwest Argentina), with Salta the most affected (494), followed by Tucumán (144) and Jujuy (80). Other provinces reporting cases include Santiago del Estero (47), Catamarca (17), Province of Buenos Aires (28), Córdoba (14), City of Buenos Aires (7), and smaller totals in Entre Ríos, San Luis, Santa Fe, and Chaco. The Ministry maintains intensified surveillance of febrile illnesses to detect changes in viral circulation and guide response. Diagnostics recommended within the first six days of symptoms include qRT-PCR and ELISA NS1 to enable early alerts and local control measures.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱、既に837例の症例あり、国内感染が増加中
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでのチクングニア熱流行が急速に拡大しており、837例の確定・疑い例（746例が国内感染）が報告されており、複数州にわたる広がりと増加傾向が認められるため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチンでのチクングニア熱流行であり、複数の州での急速な拡大を報告している。ブラジル、ボリビア、パラグアイ、キューバはインポートケースの渡航歴の出所国として言及されているが、当該イベントの発生地はアルゼンチンである。ただし、評価対象国リスト（CEPR対象国）にはアルゼンチンが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはブラジル（隣接国かつリスト上の対象国）のみを記載した。アルゼンチンでの流行が対象地域外のため、本来はDISMISSS判定となる可能性があるが、隣接するブラジルへの国際的拡大リスク（既に複数の輸入例あり）が認識されるため、PICKUPとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ish-kriketari afgan Shapoor Zadran përballet me sëmundje të rrezikshme për jetën
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former Afghan cricketer Shapoor Zadran faces a life-threatening illness.
article.articleSummary: Shapoor Zadran, a 38-year-old former Afghanistan cricketer, is in intensive care in New Delhi, India, receiving treatment for a rare, life-threatening immune disorder, hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH). His condition is accompanied by a severe systemic infection that includes tuberculosis and has involved the brain, with MRI and CT confirming CNS involvement. He had been hospitalized since January, was briefly discharged, then worsened and was readmitted for further care. HLH is a serious immune dysregulation with high mortality risk, often triggered by infections in adults. Zadran represented Afghanistan in 43 ODIs and 37 T20Is, began his career in Pakistan, and returned to Afghanistan in the early 2000s. His illness has drawn support from international cricket figures, including Rashid Khan, who visited him in hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 前アフガニスタン代表クリケット選手シャプール・ザドラン、生命にかかわる疾患と対峙
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は個人患者（クリケット選手）の病例報告であり、公衆衛生的な流行・集団発症ではない。結核を含む基礎疾患としての言及であるが、新たな感染症シグナルや公衆衛生危機を示していない。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya suma 268 reportes nuevos y sigue bajo vigilancia en el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya totals 268 new reports and remains under surveillance in the country.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya totals rise to 837 confirmed or probable cases in the country, with 268 new notifications in epidemiological week 14 of 2026. Of these, 746 are autochthonous and 91 have travel history to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba. About 93% of cases (782) occur in the NOA region, led by Salta (494), then Tucumán (144) and Jujuy (80); Santiago del Estero (47), Catamarca (17), Central Buenos Aires region (28), Córdoba (14), City of Buenos Aires (7), Entre Ríos (2), San Luis (2), Santa Fe (1), and Chaco (1) also report cases. The Ministry maintains intensified surveillance for Acute Febrile Syndrome (SFAI) and urges labs to use qRT-PCR and NS1 ELISA within the first 6 days of symptoms.                                                                                                                                                                               Respiratory viruses remain at low levels; influenza, RSV, and SARS‑CoV‑2 indexes are stable, with 18 new influenza A(H3N2) cases (subclade J.2.4.1 (K)), totaling 136 (78%). Dengue adds 5 cases (Buenos Aires Province 2, CABA 2, Salta 1); since 2025–2026, 45 confirmed, 55.6% without travel. Travel destinations include Brazil, Paraguay, Venezuela, Mexico, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Cuba, Indonesia, Pakistan, Maldives, and Sri Lanka. Overall risk is low, but probable dengue is rising in Buenos Aires, Córdoba, CABA, Tucumán, and Santa Fe; labs and second samples urged. Whooping cough adds 3 cases, mainly in ages 0–5, especially under 1 year (39.5%).

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱が268件の新規報告を追加され、国内で監視下にある
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器感染症とベクター媒介感染症が同時発生している。チクングニア熱は837件の確定/推定症例に達し、広範な地理的拡大（NOA地域93%）と国際的な渡航関連症例（ボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバ）があり、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはアルゼンチンの複数の州が含まれているが、対象国リストにアルゼンチンが含まれていないため、verified_locationsには除外した。記事サマリーに明示されているブラジルのみを含める。デング熱、インフルエンザA(H3N2)、百日咳、RSV等複数の呼吸器感染症が並行して検出されており、多重感染事象として注視が必要。チクングニア熱は国内で急速に拡大中（短期間で268件の新規通知）であり、88%の症例が自動感染で地域コミュニティ内での継続的曝露がある。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare disease - a cricketer fighting for his life in India.
article.articleSummary: Afghan left-arm fast bowler Shapoor Zadran, who represented Afghanistan in 75 international matches and claimed 74 wickets, is fighting for his life in India with the rare immune disorder hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH). After falling seriously ill in October and not playing since 2020, he sought treatment in Delhi, India, following doctors' advice. He was discharged after some improvement, but remains in life-threatening condition in the emergency department. HLH is an immune deficiency characterized by uncontrolled immune activation; it can cause severe swelling and damage to tissues, including bone marrow, liver, kidneys, and nervous tissue. His brother Kamr Zadran said he also had Kala-azar (visceral leishmaniasis), reportedly spreading to his brain. Fans and fellow cricketers are praying for his recovery.

article.articleHeadline: Whooping Cough To Measles, Old Diseases Are Making A Global Comeback
article.articleSummary: Measles and pertussis are resurging globally as vaccine coverage gaps widen. Japan experienced a dramatic pertussis surge in 2025, with first-half 2025 cases several times higher than all of 2024, reflecting a broader rise since 2021 seen in the United States and parts of Asia and Europe. Measles outbreaks are spreading in East Asia and the Pacific in 2025, with Vietnam, Mongolia, and the Philippines reporting thousands of infections. Pandemic disruptions, vaccine hesitancy, waning immunity, and inequities drive these trends, alongside possible pathogen evolution. Beyond these two diseases, concerns extend to diphtheria, polio, rubella, and meningococcal disease. The report stresses the need to strengthen routine immunisation, catch-up campaigns, booster doses, and surveillance. India-specific note: temporary drops in coverage can fuel outbreaks despite overall progress. Public health measures are urged to curb outbreaks globally.

triage.headline_ja: 百日咳から麻疹まで、古い感染症が世界的に再び流行している
triage.triage_reason: 複数の予防可能感染症（麻疹、百日咳、ジフテリア、ポリオ等）が複数地域で同時に再流行しており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、ワクチン接種率低下による異常な再発という特徴がある。
triage.notes: 記事はアジア太平洋地域の予防可能感染症の同時多発的な再流行を報じている。Japan、Mongolia、United States等も言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはChina（上海）、Vietnam、India、Philippinesのみ。ワクチン接種率低下、パンデミック後の免疫低下、ワクチンヘジタンシー等が複合的背景要因として指摘されている。全WPRO基準に該当し、国際的な公衆衛生への深刻な懸念である。

article.articleHeadline: Opinião | Falar em 'supergripe' é sensacionalismo, mas alta de casos e mortes pela doença preocupa - e muito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Opinion | Talking about 'superflu' is sensationalism, but the rise in cases and deaths from the disease is worrying—very much so.
article.articleSummary: Influenza virus is circulating nationwide in Brazil, linked to rising influenza cases and deaths per the latest InfoGripe. Regions differ: North and Northeast show stabilization; Central-South, including São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio Grande do Sul, and Paraná, continues to grow and may worsen before improving. Vaccination remains the main protection against severe disease and deaths. Despite media talk of a 'superflu', the technical name is clade K of influenza A(H3N2). WHO, Fiocruz, and Brazil's Ministry of Health state there is no data or evidence that this H3N2 clade causes more severe disease. The article cautions against sensationalism and underscores vaccination as key.

article.articleHeadline: Distrito Federal registra 1.445 casos de síndrome respiratória aguda grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal District records 1,445 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Federal District, Brazil (Brasília) has recorded 1,445 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome since January, caused by multiple viruses, including influenza and SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19). Among deaths, one adolescent female died of influenza, and five deaths occurred with influenza virus not identified. A vaccination campaign runs through May 30 for priority groups, such as seniors and children under five. Symptoms like persistent fever and shortness of breath are warning signs; individuals experiencing these should seek medical care promptly. Preventive measures include avoiding contact with flu cases, wearing masks, and practicing hand hygiene. The report underscores ongoing SARS-like illness in the Federal District amid circulation of influenza and COVID-19 viruses.

triage.triage_reason: COVID-19とインフルエンザの複数ウイルスによる重症呼吸器症候群1,445件の報告は注視対象だが、記事の記述（予防措置の実施、ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中）から地域的な管理体制が機能していることが窺え、現段階では国際的拡大リスク等の明確な証拠がないため。

article.articleHeadline: Connected habitats help animals fight deadly disease
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Atlantic Forest amphibians show that habitat connectivity preserves skin microbiomes that help block a deadly fungal pathogen. In a Penn State study, frogs collected from connected landscapes compared with those from fragmented habitats carried fewer protective skin microbes and exhibited higher infection levels in more separated sites. First author Daniel Medina notes that maintaining connectivity between forests and aquatic breeding sites supports host-associated bacteria crucial for defense against pathogens. The work suggests that landscape disruption, through roads, farms, and other barriers, reshapes microbial defenses and accelerates disease dynamics, not just host movement. While focused on tropical amphibians in Brazil, results imply broader consequences for migratory birds, fish, and large mammals moving across habitats. Published in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences on 21 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 連結された生息地は動物が致命的な病気と戦うのを助ける
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは動物の生態学的研究であり、人間の感染症危機ではない。ブラジルの両生類における菌類病原体に関する学術論文発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが発生地域としてBrazilとUnited Statesを指摘しているが、記事サマリーは学術論文の発表に関するものであり、人間の感染症イベントではない。動物疾病（両生類の菌類感染）に関する生態学的研究報告であるため、IHRおよびWPRO基準における感染症危機管理の対象外。対象国リストに該当する地域での人間への公衆衛生上の脅威は記事サマリーに記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Gurupi implanta ovitrampas para reforçar monitoramento e prevenção à dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gurupi deploys ovitraps to strengthen dengue monitoring and prevention
article.articleSummary: Gurupi, Brazil, deploys 250 ovitraps on April 22, 2026, to monitor Aedes aegypti and strengthen dengue prevention. Installed by endemic combat teams in multiple neighborhoods starting at 8:00, with 5-day collection to identify areas with higher infestation and direct dengue control mutirões and house visits. Ovitraps are dark water-filled containers with wooden paddles that simulate breeding sites; paddles are collected for analysis and the traps do not attract mosquitoes into homes. In 2025, Gurupi reported 218 dengue cases and 10 chikungunya, with peaks in February (47), March (40), and April (28); later months fell to 7–9, placing the municipality in a low-risk category. Ongoing prevention relies on community actions—yard cleaning, eliminating standing water, and cooperation with endemias teams during visits—to sustain control of Aedes aegypti and transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: グルピ市、デング熱監視と予防強化のためにオビトラップを導入
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルのグルピ市におけるデング熱監視体制の強化（オビトラップ導入）に関する予防的措置の報告であり、新規の大規模流行や異常な増加を示していない。2025年の症例数（218デング、10チクングニア）は過去の流行後の安定的な段階を示しており、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の重要な項目に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱・チクングニア・ジカウイルスの定期的な監視体制の強化に関するもので、新規の流行警報ではない。グルピ市は2025年の症例数から低リスク区分に分類されており、オビトラップ導入は予防的なルーチン対応である。社会的・政治的な懸念は検出されない。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia Launches a Nationwide Polio Vaccination Campaign to Protect Every Child Under Five | WHO | Regional Office for Africa
article.articleSummary: Zambia launches a nationwide Sub National Immunization Day polio campaign targeting all children under five in six provinces—Lusaka, Southern, Eastern, Central, Western and Muchinga—backed by an upgraded National Polio Laboratory for real-time poliovirus detection. The 20 April 2026 event at University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka initiates a round expected to vaccinate 3.7 million children within one week, with two additional rounds planned later this year. The campaign uses novel oral polio vaccine type 2 (nOPV2), deployed in more than 40 countries to stop outbreaks quickly. Earlier this year, poliovirus was detected in Lusaka wastewater (Manchinchi), triggering a Southern Africa regional response with Malawi, Mozambique, Zimbabwe and Namibia. WHO/UNICEF are supplying 4,437,500 doses to 116 districts and 3,500 facilities, plus 3,400 vaccine carriers and 261 cold boxes; 27,400 health workers trained. Polio remains a PHEIC; vaccination is the primary protection against lifelong paralysis.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビアが5歳未満児を守るための全国ポリオワクチン接種キャンペーンを開始｜WHO｜アフリカ地域事務所
triage.triage_reason: ポリオはPHEIC指定疾患であり、ザンビアでの野生型ポリオウイルス検出に対応した全国予防接種キャンペーン開始は国際的に重要な公衆衛生対応である。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、区域内での集中的な対応と地域レベルでの連携が報告されている。
triage.notes: ザンビアでのポリオウイルス検出（ルサカ廃水）が南部アフリカ地域全体の対応を触発。マラウイ、モザンビーク、ジンバブエ、ナミビアも関連するが、記事の主要テーマはザンビアの全国予防接種キャンペーン。ポリオはPHEIC指定疾患であり、野生型ウイルス検出と大規模予防接種展開は国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 悚！帶恆河水回台「長不明菌體」 台男挨轟急搭機飛印度倒回 - 生活 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking! Bringing Ganges River water back to Taiwan, "an elongated unidentified bacterium" — Taiwanese man slammed for rushing to fly to India and back.
article.articleSummary: Taiwanese man travels to India and brings two bottles of Ganges River water back to Taiwan; about a month later the water becomes turbid with algae-like growth and unidentified bacteria in the bottle. A video of the discolored water circulated online, triggering public concern over infection risk. The Ganges is known to be heavily polluted, with Escherichia coli levels well above safety limits, meaning drinking or bathing could pose infection risks. No confirmed illnesses in Taiwan were reported in the article; the risk is theoretical. The man later returned to India and poured the water back into the Ganges at Varanasi, apologizing. Indian friends urged him to return the water due to beliefs that the river houses spirits and that removing water could disturb the deceased. This imported water raises cross-border infection concerns, though no cases were confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 衝撃！ガンジス河の水を台湾に持ち帰り「正体不明の細菌」— 台湾男性が非難を浴びインドへ急いで飛行
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での実際の患者発生や感染症の拡大が報告されていない。環境汚染の指摘はあるが、確認された感染症事例がなく、理論的リスクのみである。社会的関心は高いが、公衆衛生的脅威として成立していない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はインドのガンジス河の水を台湾に持ち込んだ個人の行動とその後処理であり、実際の感染症事例ではない。サマリーでも「台湾での確認された患者なし」「リスクは理論的」と明記されている。水質汚染は環境問題であり、感染症危機ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Cross River deploys rapid response teams as Chinese is diagnosed with COVID-19
article.articleSummary: Cross River State, Nigeria, reports an imported COVID-19 case: a 53-year-old Chinese national who works at Lafarge cement in Akamkpa Local Government Area. He flew in from China on March 17, fell ill, and was treated at his employer’s facility before being taken to University of Calabar Teaching Hospital, where a laboratory confirmation of COVID-19 followed. The 2022 COVID-19 case was the last in Cross River. In response, the state activated its emergency response center, deployed rapid response teams to Akamkpa, and initiated contact tracing and line listing of possible contacts. The incubation period is typically 2–14 days, but the timing suggests questions about where infection occurred; authorities emphasize containment and surveillance rather than alarm. WHO Coordinator Dr Yewande Olatunde underscored continuing preventive measures, and officials said all protocols have been followed.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア・クロスリバー州が中国人のCOVID-19診断受け迅速対応チームを配置
triage.triage_reason: 輸入されたCOVID-19症例（中国国籍者）の報告だが、2026年時点では世界的なパンデミックは収束段階にあり、単一の輸入症例では国際的拡大リスク・深刻な公衆衛生影響は限定的。ただし迅速対応が実施されており続報価値がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれるナイジェリアは対象国リストに無いため verified_locations から除外。記事の主題は中国からナイジェリアへの輸入症例であり、実際の感染発生国はChina（渡航前の感染推定）。2026年時点でのCOVID-19単一輸入症例は、パンデミック初期と異なり限定的なシグナルと判定。

article.articleHeadline: नारायणपुर के तीन गांवों में मिजिल्स का बढ़ा प्रकोप, 19 लोग बीमार
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles outbreak grows in three villages of Narayanpur; 19 people ill.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak reported in Narayanpur block of Jamtara district, India, affecting three villages—SikdarDih, KoriDih 2, and BagruDih. A total of 19 people have fallen ill: seven in SikdarDih, five in KoriDih 2, and seven in BagruDih. District epidemic specialist Dr. Ajit Kumar Dubey and team collected samples, which have been sent to the laboratory at RIMS, Ranchi for testing. Pareesh Mandal of SikdarDih is in severe condition and admitted to Jamtara Sadar Hospital via 108 ambulance, with ongoing treatment. Health authorities have advised isolation of affected families and infection-prevention measures, including sanitation, nutritious seasonal fruits, and avoiding direct sun exposure. The situation is under surveillance; officials including LT Vijay Kumar, MPW Mahesh Kumar Singh, and CHO Kuldeep Kumar were on site. Authorities urge prompt reporting of symptoms and await laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ナラーヤンプルの3つの村ではしかの流行が増加、19人が病気
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャムタラ地区で19人の患者が報告されたはしかの集団発生。地域的には限定的だが、検査待ちで確定診断が得られていない。スクリーニング基準1項目以上該当する可能性があるが、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナラーヤンプル（ジャムタラ地区、ジャールカンド州）での局所的なはしか発生を報告。19人が患者で、1人が重症化。検体がRIMS(ラーンチー)に送付され検査中だが、確定診断待ち。バングラデシュはBluebot APIが列挙しているが、記事サマリーでは言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sobe para 52 o número de casos confirmados de coronavírus no Brasil - 11/03/2020 - São Paulo - Agora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed coronavirus cases in Brazil rises to 52 - 11/03/2020 - São Paulo - Agora
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 (novel coronavirus) in Brazil rose to 52 confirmed cases as of March 11, 2020, with 907 suspected and 935 ruled out, per the Ministry of Health. São Paulo state leads with 30 cases; Rio de Janeiro has 13; Rio Grande do Sul and the Distrito Federal each report 2; Bahia 2; Alagoas 1; Minas Gerais 1; and Espírito Santo 1. On that Wednesday, the World Health Organization declared the outbreak a pandemic. Brazilian Health Minister Luiz Henrique Mandetta criticized the WHO for delays in recognizing the pandemic, saying Brazil had treated it as such for about a week. He noted that the pandemic declaration changes case identification criteria to include history of international travel in addition to contact with confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける新型コロナウイルス確認患者数が52人に増加 - 2020年3月11日
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年3月の過去イベント（既に6年以上前）であり、当時のCOVID-19パンデミック初期段階の報道です。シグナルトリアージの対象は現在進行中の新規感染症イベントであるため、歴史的記事として見送ります。
triage.notes: 記事の配信日時（2026-04-21）とソースURL記載日（2020-03-11）に矛盾があります。ソースURLの日付が正確と判断し、2020年3月の過去イベント記事と評価。現在のシグナル検知対象ではなく、アーカイブまたは誤配信の可能性があります。

article.articleHeadline: Com mais de 6 mil casos, 18 cidades de MS enfrentam epidemia de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With more than 6,000 cases, 18 cities in Mato Grosso do Sul face a chikungunya epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of April 21, 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports a chikungunya epidemic with more than 6,000 probable cases across 18 municipalities, including Batayporã, Ladário and Figueirão entering epidemic status. Dourados remains the epidemic epicenter; the state records 206.7 cases per 100,000, about 15 times the national average (13.8). Brazil-wide, 19 chikungunya deaths have been confirmed, with 12 (63%) in Mato Grosso do Sul. High-incidence municipalities include Itaporã (269.2/100k; 68 cases), Aquidauana (293.7; 143), Iguatemi (265; 37), Maracaju (253.8; 122) and Nioaque (269.6; 36). In ten days, Paraíso das Águas surged 190.3% (59 new), Corumbá +91.3% (424); Douradina +86.4%; Sete Quedas +75%; Bonito (-1.4%), Jateí (-15%). Vaccination began in Itaporã on April 18 (3,000 of 20,000 doses for ages 18–59 without comorbidities); total planned 46.5k. Jardim and Itaporã declared health emergencies; Dourados declared calamity, receiving about R$27.5 million in federal funds and temporary SUS support.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州で6000件以上の症例、18都市がチクングニア熱の流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国内で異常な流行、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。ブラジル国内で明確な流行が進行中であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・マットグロッソ・ド・スル州における確立した流行。18自治体で6000件以上の症例、19死亡確認（うち63%が州内）。医療システムの負担が深刻（複数自治体で健康緊急事態宣言、ドゥラドス市は災害宣言）。ワクチン接種実施中。国際的にはブラジルのチクングニア熱流行動向として監視対象。

article.articleHeadline: DBD dan Leptospirosis Jadi Ancaman Serius, Dinkes Badung Imbau Warga Jaga Kebersihan Lingkungan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever and Leptospirosis Pose a Serious Threat, Badung Health Office Urges Residents to Maintain Environmental Cleanliness.
article.articleSummary: As of April 21, 2026, Badung Regency, Bali, warns that unmanaged waste heightens transmission risks of dengue fever (DBD) and leptospirosis. While residual waste may be disposed at the Suwung landfill, residents are urged to sort waste and keep uncollected trash orderly, as piles invite rats and flies that can spread leptospirosis via rat urine and support dengue-carrying mosquitoes in nearby standing water. The health official notes seasonal DBD remains a threat and leptospirosis adds urgency to sanitation efforts. Poor environmental hygiene may also elevate diarrheal disease risk and rabies exposure if contact with wild animals occurs. Emphasis is placed on active community participation in source-separation, with organic waste should be processed in composting systems. Badung’s tourism focus underscores that clean environments protect public health and sustain the regional image.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱とレプトスピラ症が深刻な脅威となり、バドゥン保健局が住民に環境衛生維持を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: バリ州バドゥン県でデング熱とレプトスピラ症が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当する可能性があるが、具体的な患者数、死亡者、重症例の情報が不足しているため、続報を注視して判断すべき段階。
triage.notes: バリ州バドゥン県での記事。デング熱とレプトスピラ症は地域で季節的・風土病的に報告されている既知の脅威であり、新規の異常事象ではない。ただし、廃棄物管理の不備による両疾患の同時的な流行リスク上昇、及びネズミ・蚊による持続的な曝露リスクが指摘されている。具体的な患者数、死亡者、重症度に関する情報がないため、IHR基準を満たさない。社会的・政治的関心は存在（自治体からの公式警告・呼びかけ）。
