article.articleHeadline: Sigue la alerta por la fiebre chikungunya: 47 nuevos casos en Santiago del Estero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya fever alert continues: 47 new cases in Santiago del Estero.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya fever continues to surge in Argentina, with 837 confirmed or probable cases reported to date, including 746 autochthonous and 91 imported from Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba. In the latest weekly bulletin (SE 14, 2026), 268 new positives were recorded, 93% of cases concentrated in the Northwest, with Salta bearing the highest burden (494), followed by Tucumán (144) and Jujuy (80). Santiago del Estero reports 47 cases; Catamarca 17; the Centro region shows Buenos Aires Province with 28, Córdoba 14, Buenos Aires City 7, and smaller counts in Entre Ríos (2), San Luis (2), Santa Fe (1), and Chaco (1). The Ministry maintains intensified Acute Febrile Syndrome surveillance and urges early diagnostics with qRT-PCR and ELISA in patients with recent symptoms, as Aedes aegypti–transmitted chikungunya causes high fever and severe joint pains; vector control through elimination of breeding sites is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱警報が継続：サンティアゴ・デル・エステロ州で47の新規症例
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおけるチクングニア熱の大規模かつ急速な拡大（837確認/疑い例、週268新規症例）を示す異常事象であり、国境を越えた輸入症例と広域流行を特徴とするため、IHR基準2項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。フルRRAに進む必要あり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアルゼンチン（対象国リストに含まれない）の複数州が含まれていますが、verified_locationsは対象国リスト（CEPR EBS対象国）に基づき抽出されます。記事サマリーでは、ボリビア、ブラジル、パラグアイ、キューバからの輸入症例が言及されており、ブラジルのみが対象国リストに該当します。アルゼンチンは対象国でないため除外となっていますが、この評価は全体的なシグナル判定（PICKUP）には影響しません。

article.articleHeadline: PERIKSA Tempat Hiburan Malam, Cek VCT & Screening TBC Rutin, 18 Kasus ODHA Ditemukan di Gilimanuk!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Inspect Nightlife Venues, Check VCT & Routine TB Screening, 18 PLHIV Cases Found in Gilimanuk!
article.articleSummary: Nightlife venues in Gilimanuk, Kelurahan Gilimanuk, Melaya District, Jembrana Regency, Bali, were screened on April 20, 2026, to curb HIV/AIDS and Tuberculosis (TB) transmission. In a routine six-month cycle, at least 11 workers underwent health checks, including HIV testing via blood and TB screening via sputum. As of April 2026, there are 18 people living with HIV/AIDS (ODHA/PLHIV) in Gilimanuk, up from 16 earlier this year; all are reportedly healthy and on treatment. The screening effort, led by the Gilimanuk Subdistrict and Puskesmas 2 Melaya, also serves to document non-permanent residents, with seven individuals lacking a SKPN (Non-Permanent Resident Certificate) who were advised to obtain one. Authorities emphasize regular VCT and TB screening among workers to reduce transmission and monitor disease burden.

triage.headline_ja: ギリマヌクで夜間娯楽施設を検査、VCT検査とTB定期スクリーニング実施、18件のODHA（HIV/AIDS患者）ケースを発見！
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（バリ州ギリマヌク）において、HIV/AIDSと結核の定期的な公衆衛生スクリーニングが実施されており、18例のPLHIV（HIV陽性者）が報告されている。しかし、これは定期的なサーベイランス活動であり、新規発生集団による急性の危機的状況ではなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は定期的な公衆衛生スクリーニング活動を報告しており、新規感染症クラスターの発生を示す兆候ではない。ギリマヌク地区での夜間娯楽施設労働者に対する継続的なHIV/TB監視プログラムの一環。患者数の増加（16例から18例）は軽微であり、当局の対応管理下にあると報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Καστοριά: Νεκρός κύκνος από γρίπη των πτηνών
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kastoria: Dead swan from avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Dead swan on Lake Kastoria in Greece has been confirmed to carry highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1), prompting a first-degree quarantine around the site. The virus, first detected in China in 1996 and later spreading to Europe, was identified in the deceased swan collected on 9 April. Christos Anastasakis, Director of the Veterinary Service of Kastoria, notes the subtype H5N1 is highly pathogenic, capable of causing severe damage to the host. Safety measures extend to a 2 km radius and include a ban on uncontrolled poultry farming outside restricted areas. Across Europe, Bulgaria has reported several cases, and between November 2025 and February 2026, 32 countries reported high levels of avian influenza in wild birds and poultry, linked to migratory movements and warmer weather conditions that favor its spread.

triage.headline_ja: カストリア：鳥インフルエンザによる白鳥の死亡
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの人獣共通感染症確認。ヨーロッパ広域流行中（32カ国で2025年11月〜2026年2月に報告）で国際的拡大リスク高く、公衆衛生への影響が深刻。IHR基準3つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、イベントの主舞台はギリシャ（カストリア湖の白鳥発見）およびブルガリア（複数の症例報告）であるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていない。対象国としてはChina（1996年に初検出と記載）のみが該当。H5N1は高病原性で、ヨーロッパ全域での広域流行が確認されており、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、国際的拡大のリスクが高い。2km圏内の検疫措置が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: What Is Lujo Virus And Why Is It So Deadly?
article.articleSummary: Lujo virus hemorrhagic fever (LUHF) is a zoonotic arenavirus causing a highly lethal human disease. The only documented outbreak occurred in 2008, affecting five people in Zambia and South Africa, with four deaths (case fatality rate 80%). The first patient, a 36-year-old travel agent from Lusaka, developed mild symptoms before traveling to South Africa; she died 13 days after symptom onset. A paramedic and a nurse who cared for her died, and two further cases—one hospital cleaner and another nurse—survived. LUHF's symptoms begin 7–13 days post-infection: fever, headache, muscle pain, followed by rash, facial/neck swelling, diarrhea, sore throat; bleeding is not typical. Transmission is possible human-to-human, especially late in infection; rodents (Mastomys natalensis and African pygmy mouse Mus minutoides) are implicated as reservoirs. In 2024, structural studies showed Lujo virus uses neuropilin-2 to enter cells, informing potential drug/vaccine targets.

triage.headline_ja: ルージョウウイルスとは何か、そしてなぜそれほど致命的なのか？
triage.triage_reason: 歴史的な2008年のアウトブレイク（終結）に関する教育的な記事であり、現在進行中のイベントではない。ただし、ルージョウウイルスの危険性に関する社会的関心があり、ザンビアが対象国に含まれるため経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 本記事は2008年の既に終結したルージョウウイルスアウトブレイクの歴史的情報と科学的知見（2024年の構造研究）に関する解説記事。現在進行中の感染症イベントではなく、疾患の教育啓発が主目的。ザンビアとは記事に明記されているため verified_locations に含めた。南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Em Brasília, Nelsinho busca reforço urgente para Dourados em meio à crise da chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Brasília, Nelsinho seeks urgent reinforcements for Dourados amid the chikungunya crisis.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya crisis in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), Brazil prompts urgent federal reinforcements. Senator Nelsinho Trad presses Health Minister Alexandre Padilha to secure emergency resources, advanced technologies, and operational support. The government commits to deploying new Aedes aegypti control technologies, including Fiocruz-developed solutions, and to include Dourados in chikungunya vaccine trials. Dourados began receiving 43,500 vaccine doses to be administered in coming days. A 90‑day public calamity decree is in effect. In MS, more than 6,100 probable chikungunya cases are reported, with a 64.9% test positivity and hospital bed occupancy around 110%, signaling risk of system collapse. Dourados records eight chikungunya deaths; Jardim 2; Bonito 1; Fátima do Sul 1, totaling 12 deaths in the state by mid-April. The outbreak features widespread Aedes aegypti infestation—67% of MS municipalities at vector alert—calling for intensified mosquito control and vigilant symptom monitoring, especially for the elderly and infants.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジリアでネルシーニョはチクングニア危機の中、ドウラードスへの緊急支援を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目（重症度・長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当。ブラジル対象地域でのチクングニア危機は明確なシグナルである。
triage.notes: マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドウラードスにおけるチクングニア集団発生。確認死亡者12名、6,100件以上の確定例、64.9%の検査陽性率、病院ベッド占有率110%（システム崩壊リスク）。90日間の公災令発令中。Aedes aegypti媒介蚊の67%の自治体が警戒レベルに達しており、ワクチン接種キャンペーンと蚊制御対策が進行中。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Menyikapi Situasi Campak di Indonesia, Kewaspadaan dan Imunisasi Lengkap Jadi Kunci
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Addressing the Measles Situation in Indonesia, Vigilance and Complete Immunization Are the Keys.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces a measles upsurge in early 2026, with more than 8,000 suspected measles cases and 21 extraordinary events across 17 districts/cities in 11 provinces, some laboratory-confirmed. Measles is highly contagious, spreading via respiratory droplets and contaminated surfaces, posing serious risk to children and malnourished individuals. Common initial symptoms resemble flu—fever, runny nose, cough, muscle pain, fatigue—followed by a spreading red rash. Complications can include pneumonia, encephalitis, and death. Prevention hinges on complete measles immunization according to schedule, along with hygiene, nutrition, and adequate rest. Parents should provide supportive care and seek timely medical attention if a child worsens. Control requires coordinated action: primary care centers (Puskesmas) and health facilities for vaccination, early detection, and reporting, with hospitals handling severe cases; pharmaceutical producers and government ensuring vaccine and logistics supply. Emphasis on routine vaccination, rapid outbreak response, surveillance, and clear public messaging to counter misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアの麻疹状況への対応、警戒と完全予防接種が鍵
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹は急速に増加し、8,000件以上の疑い患者と21の異常事象が11州17地区に拡大。高い感染性、重篤な合併症（肺炎、脳炎、死亡）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、および国家的な対応調整が必要な状況からIHR基準2つ以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数に合致する。
triage.notes: 2026年初頭の麻疹流行により8,000件以上の疑い患者が11州17地区に散在。症例確認済み、複数の合併症（肺炎、脳炎、死亡含む）報告。高い伝播性、脆弱性の高い集団への影響、および調整された国家対応の必要性が強く示唆される。フルRRAが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Preocupación por el brote de chikungunya: Santiago del Estero ya registra 47 contagios confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over the chikungunya outbreak: Santiago del Estero already has 47 confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak persists in Argentina, with Santiago del Estero reporting 47 confirmed cases, part of a national total of 837 infections after 268 new cases. The NOA region remains the epicenter, housing 782 cases (93% of national total), led by Salta (494), followed by Tucumán and Jujuy; Santiago del Estero now shows active circulation. Most cases are autochthonous (746) while the remainder involve recent travel to Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, or Cuba, enabling initial virus entry into northern provinces. National Health Ministry maintains intensified surveillance for acute undifferentiated febrile syndrome and urges early diagnostic methods to detect shifts in circulation and bolster outbreak response. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti and presents with high fever and intense joint pain; prevention focuses on eliminating mosquito breeding sites in homes and urban areas.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱の流行への懸念：サンティアゴ・デル・エステロ州で既に47件の感染が確認
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおけるチクングニア熱の多地域流行であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「公衆衛生への影響」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常性」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」に複数該当し、国家規模の監視体制が強化されていることから、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはアルゼンチン、キューバ、ボリビア、パラグアイが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。サマリー内でブラジルへの渡航歴が言及されている。アルゼンチンはWPRO対象外だが、対象国南米代表としてのブラジルとの流行関連性があるため、ブラジル側の監視価値あり。記事は2026年4月21日のため、将来日付が含まれていることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Nord-Ubangi : lancement à Gbadolite de la campagne de vaccination contre la rougeole | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Nord-Ubangi: Launch of the measles vaccination campaign in Gbadolite | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination campaign launched in Gbadolite, Nord-Ubangi Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, on April 20, 2026, targeting children from birth to 14 years. The event took place in the Fondation neighborhood with attendance of political-administrative authorities, health officials, and community actors. Organized with support from the Expanded Immunization Program (PEV) and health sector partners, the campaign aims to strengthen protection against measles, a highly contagious disease that can cause serious complications. Health authorities commend medical staff and technical/financial partners and urge parents to vaccinate their children to prevent resurgence. The initiative seeks broad vaccination coverage across the province to durably reduce risks from measles and other vaccine-preventable diseases. No case counts or laboratory confirmations are reported; the focus is on outbreak prevention and expanding routine immunization.

triage.headline_ja: 北ウバンギ州：ガバドリテでの麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で麻疹ワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始された報告。既知の予防策の実施であり、新規発生症例の報告や異常な疫学的状況は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Le test de Widal contre la typhoïde toujours utilisé, pourtant peu fiable | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Widal test for typhoid fever is still used, yet unreliable.
article.articleSummary: Widal test widely used in Lubumbashi and the Democratic Republic of Congo to diagnose typhoid fever, yet it is considered obsolete and unreliable by WHO. Its widespread use risks false positives, leading to misdiagnosis, inappropriate antibiotics, and delayed correct treatment. Example: Mme Mbuyu tested positive and was treated; retesting remained positive, prompting a change in antibiotics. Dr. Anatole Nyembwe notes it is prescribed because the area is endemic, tests are quick and cheap. The test detects antibodies against Salmonella, which can persist after past infections, making interpretation difficult and potentially causing overtreatment. In Lubumbashi, other typhoid diagnostics (blood cultures, rapid tests) are often unavailable or expensive. Widal costs under $5, while alternative tests run $20–$40. Persistent habits and limited lab training reinforce routine use. Recommendations: inform patients about necessity, avoid over-prescribing tests, and resist treating typhoid without solid evidence.

triage.headline_ja: 腸チフスに対するWidal検査は依然として使用されているが、信頼性に乏しい
triage.triage_reason: チフスが風土病として存在する地域での診断方法に関する報道であり、異常や流行拡大を示す新規イベント情報ではない。医学的な診断精度の問題についての教育的記事と判断される。
triage.notes: 本記事は風土病地域でのWidal検査の診断精度に関する問題提起であり、新規流行イベントではない。DRCはBluedot APIで識別されているが、記事内容は診断方法の信頼性についての一般的な情報提供であり、シグナルトリアージの対象となるイベント（新規発生、流行拡大、異常な発生パターン）ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 外籍生染麻疹 5年首例 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International student contracts measles; first case in five years.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports one imported measles case in a northern foreign male student who entered in late March; he developed fever, conjunctivitis, and rash in early April. Lab confirmation makes this the first measles case among foreign students in nearly five years. The CDC has notified the Ministry of Education to strengthen vaccination messaging and health monitoring for foreign students. 162 close contacts have been identified and will be monitored through May 1. Infectious period was April 7–12; footprints included Shilin Restaurant, Yangmingshan McDonald’s, nearby convenience stores, and Culture University cafeteria; all sites disinfected. Exposed individuals should self-monitor. Taiwan has eight measles cases this year (ages <1 to 50s): six imported from Vietnam, Malaysia, the United States, India, Indonesia, Kyrgyzstan; two domestic linked to clusters. Japan reports 236 measles cases by April 8, concentrated in Tokyo and Kagoshima; travelers should consider pre-travel vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 外籍生が麻疹に感染、5年ぶり初例
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での輸入麻疹1例は限定的だが、地域内での多数輸入例・日本での236例報告と合わせ、西太平洋地域での麻疹活動増加を示唆。情報が散在的であり、より詳細な流行状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Aurangabad News : अलर्ट! टीबी संक्रमण के हाई रिस्क जोन में जिले के 463 गांव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aurangabad News: Alert! 463 villages in the district are in high-risk zones for tuberculosis infection.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) infection risk is highlighted in Aurangabad district, India, with 463 villages designated as high-risk. A 100-day TB screening and awareness campaign has been launched under district TB elimination efforts to identify TB patients, ensure treatment, and curb transmission. The drive prioritizes areas with greater infection risk, with intensified screening and education conducted in Aurangabad Sadar and surrounding high-risk villages. The program emphasizes early detection, linkage to care, and community outreach as essential steps toward reducing TB incidence as part of ongoing public health measures. No case counts are provided in the piece; emphasis remains on screening, awareness, and ensuring treatment to advance TB elimination goals.

triage.headline_ja: オーランガバード・ニュース：警戒！郡内の463村が結核感染の高リスク地域に指定
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の定着疾患であり、個別の高リスク地域キャンペーンは異常ではない。症例数、死亡、または国際的な懸念の兆候がなく、スクリーニング・認識向上キャンペーンは予防的管理措置である。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の既知の地域的管理取り組みを記述しており、新たな流行やアウトブレイクではない。症例数、重症度、死亡率などの具体的なデータが記載されていない。463村の高リスク指定は公衆衛生対応の強化を示唆しているが、異常性または予期しない事象の証拠は限定的である。情報不足のため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Central : 2,3 millions d'enfants ciblés par une campagne de vaccination contre la rougeole et la rubéole - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kongo Central: 2.3 million children targeted by a measles and rubella vaccination campaign - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Measles and rubella vaccination targeted 2,335,114 children aged 6 months to 14 years in Kongo Central, southwestern Democratic Republic of Congo, to boost immunity; concurrently, 959,427 children aged 0-59 months will receive four oral polio vaccine drops (two doses of bivalent OPV and two doses of NVPO2) as part of the poliomyelitis outbreak response. The campaign runs April 21–25, 2026, with a catch-up day on April 26 across 31 health zones. Launch attendees included Matadi's mayor and provincial health officials, with technical and financial support from WHO, UNICEF, Gavi, and the European Union. Provincial Health Minister Ovide Yobila urged parents to vaccinate without hesitation and called on community and religious leaders to relay awareness messages and counter rumors, mobilize resources, and ensure professional health service delivery. The effort aims to strengthen vaccination coverage and broader public health interventions to protect children in the province.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ中央州：麻疹とおたふく風邪ワクチン接種キャンペーンで230万人の子どもが対象
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防接種キャンペーンの実施報告であり、麻疹・風疹・ポリオの発生を報告するものではない。発生状況の深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクのいずれも示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、本イベントはDRC・コンゴ中央州における麻疹・風疹・ポリオの予防接種キャンペーン（2026年4月21-26日）の実施報告である。「poliomyelitis outbreak response」の記載があるが、これはポリオ根絶キャンペーンの文脈であり、現在の発生状況を報告するものではない。感染症発生の報告ではなく、公衆衛生対策の実施報告に過ぎないため、トリアージから除外する。

article.articleHeadline: Goiás soma 115 mortes por Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave (SRAG) | Jornal O Grito
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiás reports 115 deaths from Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) | Jornal O Grito.
article.articleSummary: Goiás reports 115 deaths from Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) linked to viruses including adenovirus, rhinovirus, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and influenza. Rhinovirus currently circulating at high levels; influenza cases are rising. The highly transmissible influenza A H3N2 subclade K has been identified in Caldas Novas, Anápolis and Itumbiara, signaling potential rapid spread across the state. In the Brazilian Federal District (DF), health authorities (InfoGripe/Fiocruz) report 1,445 SRAG cases so far this year; rhinovirus, metapneumovirus and RSV account for about 56.8% of reports, influenza 3.5%, and COVID-19 2%, with other etiologies under laboratory investigation. The SES-DF confirmed six cases of Gripe K (H3N2 subclade K); one 17-year-old adolescent died. Preventive measures emphasize influenza vaccination, hand hygiene, avoiding crowded or closed spaces, and masking when symptomatic; individuals with flu-like symptoms should seek care if symptoms worsen, especially the elderly and children.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州、重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）による115人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の多重病原体流行）。WPROスクリーニング基準3つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）。115人の死亡、H3N2 K系統の急速拡散リスク、複数州での確認が認められる。
triage.notes: ブラジルのゴイアス州における複数病原体（RSV、ライノウイルス、インフルエンザA H3N2 K系統、メタニューモウイルス）による重症呼吸器疾患の多発事例。H3N2 K系統は高い伝播性を示し、複数自治体での確認および死亡例（17歳の青年含む）が報告されている。連邦地区では既に1,445例のSRAG症例が報告されており、多州への急速拡散のリスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Enterovirus-related hospital visits rise 16.5% - Taipei Times
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports enterovirus hospital visits up 16.5% to 3,526 (April 12–Saturday prior). Coxsackievirus A6 is the most common circulating, followed by A4 and A16; four severe enterovirus cases have occurred this year—two EV-D68, one A4, one A16—with one death. Nearby Vietnam has reported more than 26,000 cases and eight deaths this year, with about 99% of cases in children 10 or younger. Adults may be asymptomatic but can transmit to children; caregivers are urged to practice soap-and-water handwashing, regular toy disinfection with diluted bleach, and good general hygiene. Enterovirus activity is expected to rise into an epidemic period in early June, peaking in late June. Two local mpox cases last week involved unvaccinated men; 12 mpox cases this year, including an imported case, with about 80% unvaccinated. A new measles case in a foreign student prompted monitoring of 162 close contacts; 312 facilities offer government-funded mpox vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: 腸管ウイルス関連の入院患者数が16.5%増加 - 台北タイムズ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で腸管ウイルス感染が流行期に向けて増加中（16.5%増）であり、ベトナムでも26,000例以上の報告と死亡例があることから、地域的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認識される。また麻疹とMpoxの同時報告もあり、複合的な感染症リスク状況が示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの分析：台湾は記事の発行国・配信媒体（Taipei Times）であり、記事内容の主題は台湾のデータを中心としているが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ベトナムは記事に明示的に言及され（26,000例以上、8死亡）、対象国リストに含まれるため included。腸管ウイルスは流行期に向かっており、小児への影響が大きく、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高い。EV-D68を含む複数の腸管ウイルスの流行、ならびにMpoxと麻疹の同時報告により複合感染症状況が形成されている。

article.articleHeadline: Prolonged drought and associated social unrest on the Tibetan Plateau played a role in the emergence and spread of the Third Plague Pandemic - Communications Earth & Environment
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis-driven Third Plague Pandemic claimed over 15 million lives. The onset and establishment occurred during a prolonged drought on the southeastern Tibetan Plateau from the 1850s to the 1880s, linking environmental stress to spillover from natural reservoirs into human populations. Using 35 moisture-sensitive tree-ring chronologies, researchers reconstructed hydroclimate variability back to 1564 CE, showing a drought that coincided with plague emergence. The hydroclimate anomaly accompanied famine, conflict, and plague, contributing to 2.41 million deaths during the Panthay Rebellion. Troops, refugees, and opium traders accelerated the spread of the plague to and from Hong Kong, shaping its global dissemination. The findings emphasize climate-related conflict as a driver of plague risk in a warming, interconnected world.

triage.headline_ja: チベット高原における延長干ばつと関連する社会不安が第三次ペスト大流行の出現と拡大に役割を果たした
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は1850年代～1880年代の歴史的なペスト大流行の再検証に関する学術論文であり、現在の進行中の感染症イベントではない。過去の疾病史と気候変動の関連を分析した科学的評論である。
triage.notes: 記事は第三次ペスト大流行（1850s-1880s）の歴史的分析であり、現在の感染症イベントではない。チベット高原とは香港での歴史的な疾病流通パターンについての学術研究である。シグナル対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Abril reforça alerta para a prevenção da meningite no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: April reinforces the warning for meningitis prevention in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: April underscores World Meningitis Day (April 24) and highlights meningitis as a persistent Brazil public health challenge, with thousands of cases reported annually. While viral and bacterial meningitis both occur, bacterial meningitis—though less common—is the most severe and demands immediate care. Authorities have noted fluctuations in case numbers and declines in vaccination coverage in recent years. Symptoms include high fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, sensitivity to light, and sometimes skin rashes; in young children, irritability, persistent crying, and feeding difficulties may appear. Early recognition and prompt medical evaluation markedly improve outcomes. Prevention remains central, with Brazil’s national vaccination schedule covering meningococcal, pneumococcal, and Haemophilus influenzae type b (Hib) vaccines. Complementary measures include hand hygiene, avoiding shared personal items, and reducing exposure in crowded, enclosed spaces. Public awareness and vaccination are emphasized as life-saving strategies.

triage.headline_ja: 4月ブラジルの髄膜炎予防警戒を強化
triage.triage_reason: Haemophilus influenzaeは重要な病原体だが、記事は啓発キャンペーンの内容に焦点があり、具体的なアウトブレイク情報（確定患者数、急増傾向、死亡例）が不明。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は4月24日の世界髄膜炎デーに関連した公衆衛生啓発キャンペーンであり、特定のアウトブレイク事例ではない。ブラジルは例年数千件の髄膜炎症例を報告しており、予防接種カバレッジの低下傾向が記されているが、現在の具体的な緊急事態を示す指標は記事から不明。継続的な監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Criciúma reforça vacinação contra gripe diante de alta de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Criciúma Strengthens Influenza Vaccination in the Face of Rising Cases
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination is being intensified in Criciúma as cases of respiratory syndromes rise. The Municipal Health Department warns that vaccination is key to prevent complications and slow virus circulation. In addition to immunization, experts urge continued hygiene practices—frequent handwashing, covering the mouth when coughing or sneezing, and avoiding crowds when symptomatic—to curb transmission. The campaign aims to protect the most vulnerable and prevent overload of the health system during periods of higher respiratory illness incidence. With influenza being the focal point, authorities emphasize avoiding hospital strain and reducing influenza-related morbidity through vaccination and personal hygiene in Criciúma, Brazil, as of 21 April 2026.

triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザ対応による予防接種キャンペーン。重症化、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクなし。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Epicentro' da Chikungunya no MS decreta situação de calamidade pública
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'Epicenter' of Chikungunya in Mato Grosso do Sul decrees a state of public calamity.
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, declared a public calamity due to a severe chikungunya epidemic, signaling an overwhelmed healthcare network with hospital bed occupancy around 110%. Decree 638, signed by Mayor Marçal Gonçalves Leite Filho, follows an emergency declared March 20. The municipality reports over 6,186 probable chikungunya cases and a test positivity near 65%, with capacity extrapolated and pressure extending beyond indigenous territories to general health services. The response permits extraordinary measures under Decree 587/2026, including administrative requisition of goods, emergency hiring, and entry into properties. Vaccination against chikungunya is planned to start Monday (25) targeting about 43,000 residents, using Valneva/Butantan vaccine approved by Anvisa in April 2025; exemptions apply (recent chikungunya, fever, or recent vaccination). As of Week 14, Mato Grosso do Sul records 12 chikungunya deaths (8 in Dourados), representing 63% of national fatalities (19). The urban death involved a 63-year-old man from Parque das Nações 2; outbreak originated in indigenous areas.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソドスル州のチクングニア熱の「震源地」が公衆衛生上の災害状態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ブラジルで急速に拡大するチクングニア熱アウトブレイク、医療崩壊状態（ベッド占有率110%）、高い死亡率（全国19死亡のうち12がマットグロッソドスル州）、ワクチン接種開始など対応措置が取られている。
triage.notes: マットグロッソドスル州ドゥアラドスを中心とする急速なチクングニア熱アウトブレイク。6,186例以上の確診・疑似症例、65%の検査陽性率、12死亡例（国全体の63%）を報告。医療システム崩壊状態（ベッド占有率110%）で公衆衛生上の災害状態を宣言。先住民地域から市民エリアへの急速な拡大。ワクチン接種プログラム開始予定（43,000人対象、Valneva/Butantan製）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat: Paneer, mango juice among samples sent for testing after 222 fall ill in Dahod (Ld)
article.articleSummary: Mass illness in Dahod district, Gujarat, linked to a wedding function in Abhlod village (Garbada taluka). Food served by caterer Dhanabhai Bharwad: paneer curry, puri, mango juice, and water from tanker and local sources. Samples from the dishes and beverages, plus producer samples, have been sent to the Food and Drug Laboratory in Vadodara; FSSAI staff assisting. 1,000–1,200 attendees consumed the meal; 222 reported symptoms (diarrhoea, vomiting, nausea, stomach pain) as of April 21, 2026. 184 discharged, 34 admitted; no deaths reported. Authorities have not confirmed the contamination source. The FDCA was informed; a detailed district report is expected in 1–2 days. The investigation is ongoing, with findings pending laboratory analysis; further administrative and legal action to follow based on results.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州：ダホド地区で222人が発症した後、パニール、マンゴジュースなどの試料が検査のため送付される
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の食品由来疾患で222人が発症し、34人が入院しているが、病原体が特定されておらず、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が不明確。食品検査結果待ちの段階であり、国内対応中のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 疾患がUnknown Illnessとして分類されており、症状は下痢・嘔吐・吐き気・腹痛であるが病原体が確定していない。食品由来の可能性が高いが、汚染源は確認されていない。検査結果（1-2日以内に報告予定）待ちの段階であり、確定診断後のフルRRA実施を視野に入れた経過観察が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Experts attribute rise in stomach infections to sudden spike in temperature
article.articleSummary: Rising temperatures in Chandigarh correlate with a surge in stomach infections causing fever, nausea, and diarrhoea. In the last ten days, GMSH-16 IPD logged 42 diarrhoea cases, with 226 OPD visits and 45 IPD admissions. Health officials attribute the spike to seasonal temperature changes that weaken immunity, facilitating the spread of viral illnesses such as influenza and parainfluenza, and tropical infections from contaminated water and unhygienic food, including gastroenteritis and typhoid fever. Dr Suman Singh urges hydration and sun protection. Dr Vikas Bhutani stresses water safety—boiled/filtered/RO water, avoid ice, and clean teeth with safe water—and advises against street food, cut fruits, raw salads, and stale foods. He also recommends refrigerating leftovers within 4–5 hours, a balanced diet, and adequate sleep. Dr Rakesh Kochhar cautions on shelf life and proper cooking, warning against consuming unrefrigerated foods, stale dairy, undercooked vegetables, and unverified water sources.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家は胃腸感染症の増加を気温の急上昇に起因すると指摘
triage.triage_reason: チャンディーガルで胃腸感染症（インフルエンザとチフス）の増加が報告されており、スクリーニング基準の異常性・重症度・管理可能性で複数該当するが、情報が限定的で国際的リスク評価が不明であるため。
triage.notes: チャンディーガル地域で過去10日間に226の外来患者訪問と45の入院患者が報告されており、気候変動に関連した季節的流行パターンと考えられる。国際的拡大リスクは現在のところ明確ではない。複数の公衆衛生専門家によるコメントと予防策の提示があり、当局の関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 'संजीविनी' के डॉक्टर ओमी याद हैं? ब्रेन वायरस ने बिगाड़ा हाल, फिर आई मौत की खबर - India TV Hindi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Do you remember Dr. Omi of 'Sanjeevini'? A viral encephalitis worsened the condition, then news of a death followed.
article.articleSummary: Delhi-born television actor Sanjit Bedi, renowned for playing Dr. Omi in the 2002 medical drama Sanjivani, rose to fame across shows like Kasautii Zindagi Ki and Kumkum/Kya Hoga Nimmo Ka. After moving to Mumbai to pursue modeling, he joined theatre, was spotted by the B4U channel, and became a VJ. He landed Sanjivani after auditioning, becoming a TV staple, though fans later lamented his sudden disappearance from the show. At 36, he contracted malaria, recovered, then developed shingles with red rashes, followed by a brain infection that led to encephalitis. He remained in a coma for about 18 months before dying in a hospital in 2015. His illness and passing stunned fans who remembered his breakout role on television.

triage.headline_ja: 「サンジーヴニ」の医師オミ役の俳優が脳ウイルスで死亡 - インド TV ヒンディー版
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2015年に亡くなった個人の芸能人訃報であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではありません。マラリアと脳炎はスクリーニング条件を満たしますが、公衆衛生上の現在のシグナルではなく、歴史的な個人医療ケースの報道です。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の現在のアウトブレイク・シグナルではなく、テレビ俳優の個人的な過去の医療履歴と死亡に関する訃報記事です。2015年の出来事を2026年に報道したものと考えられます。感染症監視システムのノイズであり、シグナルトリアージには該当しません。

article.articleHeadline: Kwilu : 1.337.239 enfants attendus à la campagne de vaccination intégrée contre la rougeole - rubéole et poliomyélite - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kwilu: 1,337,239 children expected at the integrated vaccination campaign against measles, rubella and polio - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Kwilu province in southwestern Democratic Republic of Congo launched an integrated vaccination campaign against measles, rubella, and polio in 24 health zones, including Bandundu, the provincial capital, targeting 1,337,239 children under five from April 21–26, 2026. The campaign combines oral polio vaccine (two drops) with measles–rubella vaccination (administered on the shoulder) for 3,254 children aged 6 months to 14 years, via a fixed-forward strategy. Past large outbreaks in 2019 and 2023 involved about 311,471–311,500 cases and 5,799–6,045 deaths, linked to weak vaccine coverage and delayed responses. By 2026 four poliomyelitis cases have been confirmed; all health zones report measles epidemics, with some in Kwilu. The plan includes a 9 months–14 years catch-up and introduction of the vaccines into routine immunization, replacing the measles vaccine. Officials stress vaccination as the only preventive measure and urge leaders to mobilize for free participation.

triage.headline_ja: クウィル州：麻しん・風しん・ポリオに対する統合予防接種キャンペーンで1,337,239人の子どもが対象
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ、麻しん、風しんの同時流行が確認され、過去の大流行（2019年・2023年で数千人の死亡）の背景がある。2026年時点で4例のポリオ確認症例があるが、現時点では国家主導の統合予防接種キャンペーン段階であり、情報不足のため段階的監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（対象国）のクウィル州での統合予防接種キャンペーンについて述べている。複数感染症（ポリオ、麻しん、風しん）の同時存在、過去の大規模流行歴（死亡数が数千人規模）、ポリオの確認症例が4例存在することから重症度基準を満たす。ただしこれは予防キャンペーンの報道であり、現在進行形の急速な流行拡大ではなく、情報不足により段階的観察が適切。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 people who attended a wedding ceremony in Gujarat fell ill; food samples were sent for testing.
article.articleSummary: Dahod district, Gujarat, saw a wedding in Abhlod village, Garbada taluka, where more than 200 attendees fell ill. Approximately 1,000–1,200 guests ate the catered meal; 222 developed acute gastrointestinal symptoms—diarrhea, vomiting, nausea, and abdominal pain. Food samples including paneer curry, puri, and mango juice, along with tanker and drinking water samples, were sent to the Vadodara Food and Drug Laboratory for testing; samples from paneer and mango juice producers were also collected to identify the source. The incident emerged Monday evening at a private function; civil hospital treated patients, with 184 discharged and 34 still hospitalized by Tuesday afternoon; others with mild symptoms were managed at local facilities. FSSAI officials are assisting on-site. The state government has sought a detailed district report; no confirmed infection source yet, and there have been no deaths.

triage.headline_ja: グジャラート州の結婚式で200人以上が発症、食事サンプルが検査に送られた
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑い（未確認病原体）による集団発生で222人の急性胃腸炎症状が報告され、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度の可能性）に複数該当する。ただし原因確定前であり、死亡なし、国内対応中のため、続報注視が適切。
triage.notes: 食中毒疑いの集団発生（222人が急性胃腸炎症状）。原因病原体は未確認（Unknown Illness）。検査中の段階で、現在までに死亡なし、入院34人も含め対応中。国内機関（FSSAI、州政府）が調査を進めており、外部支援は不要。IHR基準は1つのみ該当だが、WPROスクリーニング基準3つ該当により要監視。原因特定と患者数確定の続報が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Darurat Tuberkolosis, Indonesia Peringkat 2 Kasus TBC Tertinggi di Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Emergency: Indonesia Ranks Second in TB Cases Worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia faces a tuberculosis emergency, ranking second globally for TB cases behind India, with higher counts than China and the Philippines, per the WHO Global TB Report 2024. Ministry of Health data show 889,000 TB cases in Indonesia as of March 2026, driving accelerated control via expanded screening across regions. Under President Prabowo Subianto and Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka, TB eradication is a top government priority; the President instructed swift action. In Pati Regency, Central Java, 2,658 TB cases were recorded last year. In response, the government is conducting free health screenings, including chest X-rays for families of TB patients, to cut transmission, via the Tracing TB Integrated Program Cek Kesehatan Gratis (CKG). Pati’s government aims to re-verify data for 2,658 patients from last year within 10 calendar days, plus new cases this year, to enable rapid treatment and cure.

triage.headline_ja: 結核緊急事態、インドネシアは世界で2番目に結核症例が多い国
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核の大規模かつ深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（889,000症例、世界2位）と、政府の最優先事項としての位置付けがあり、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）および社会的・政治的関心（政府の高い関心）の複数が該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事は主にインドネシアの結核緊急事態に焦点を当てており、インドとフィリピンは比較対象として言及されるのみで、それらの国での新規発生イベントではない。パティ県中部ジャワでの具体的事例は、インドネシア全体の結核危機の文脈における地域的措置である。結核は慢性疾患であり急性アウトブレイク型ではないため、IHR基準では「予想外」には該当しないが、大規模かつ深刻な公衆衛生脅威としての管理可能性に課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: 《TAIPEI TIMES》 Enterovirus-related hospital visits rise 16.5％ - 焦點 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleSummary: Enterovirus infections in Taiwan rose 16.5% last week, with 3,526 hospital visits from Apr 12–18, 2026. Coxsackievirus A6 is the most common, followed by A4 and A16; four severe cases this year include two EV-D68, one CV-A4, one CV-A16, with one death. Nearby Vietnam reports more than 26,000 cases and eight deaths this year, while activity in other countries remains low. Adults can transmit to children; hygiene is stressed. Soap-and-water handwashing is recommended over alcohol-based sanitizers; advise balanced diet, adequate sleep, clean ventilated homes, and disinfecting toys with diluted bleach. Enterovirus activity is expected to peak in late June. Mpox has 12 cases in 2026 in Taiwan, including one imported case; two local cases last week in unvaccinated men aged 30s–40s; all 12 are men aged 25–50, about 80% unvaccinated; transmission linked to unsafe sex with online or venue partners; vaccination available at 312 government-funded facilities. Measles: a foreign student who arrived in late March; 162 close contacts monitored through Apr 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エンテロウイルス関連の外来受診数が16.5％増加
triage.triage_reason: Taiwan（対象国外）でのエンテロウイルス急増とVietnam（対象国）での2万6千例以上の症例報告により、IHR基準（異常性・重症度）を満たし、かつWPRO基準（長期曝露・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）で複数項目該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではTaiwan（対象国外）での詳細な流行状況が記述されているが、verified_locationsにはVietnamのみ含める。Vietnamでは2026年に2万6千例以上およ8死亡が報告されており、対象国リストに該当。Mpoxおよび麻疹も同時報告されているが、エンテロウイルス症候群が主要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados confirma 89 casos de chikungunya em 24 horas e total passa de 2,1 mil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados confirms 89 Chikungunya cases in 24 hours, and the total surpasses 2,100.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, accelerates. In the past 24 hours, 89 new confirmations, bringing total to 2,163; 2,819 cases are under investigation. Urban areas account for 69.5% of cases, indigenous reserves 30.5%; positivity is 61.4%. Eight deaths are confirmed with two more under investigation; seven victims were Indigenous. Forty-two patients are hospitalized with severe disease. Between February and April, cases shifted from reserves to the urban zone; March 22–28 saw 767 cases in reserves vs 149 outside; the following week 704 outside and 427 among Indigenous. The city declared a public health calamity; the federal government recognized an emergency, with over R$27.5 million in funding and a month-long SUS National Force deployment. Emergency decree enables rapid procurement, mobilization, evacuation, and expropriation in risk areas. MS leads Brazil in chikungunya with 206.7 per 100k; 6,046 probable MS cases (20.6% of national total) across 18 epidemic cities, including Batayporã, Ladário and Figueirão. Paraíso das Águas and Corumbá show notable increases. Data from Ministry of Health arboviroses panel as of April 10, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスが24時間で89件のチクングニア熱症例を確認、累計2,100件を超える
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州でチクングニア熱の大規模流行が進行中。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、死亡者8名、重症入院患者42名、公衆衛生上の重大な影響が確認される。地域の流行管理体制が構築されているものの、継続的な感染拡大と先住民族への集中的な影響がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月21日時点のデータ。ブラジル国内でのみ発生（国際的拡大のリスクは現在のところ記事では明記されていない）。先住民族コミュニティへの不均衡な影響が注目される。公衆衛生上の非常事態が宣言され、連邦政府支援が実施されている。ただし、ブラジルは対象国リスト（WPRO地域）に含まれていないため、AMRO地域の外部支援が必要な可能性はあるが、現段階では国内対応体制が整備されている。フルRRAが推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta por chikungunya: se reportan 268 casos nuevos en Argentina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya alert: 268 new cases reported in Argentina.
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports 268 new chikungunya cases in the past week, bringing 2026 totals to 837 confirmed/probable. Of cases, 746 are locally transmitted and 91 linked to travel from Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, and Cuba. About 93% occur in the Northwest, led by Salta (494), Tucumán (144), and Jujuy (80); other provinces include Santiago del Estero (47), Catamarca (17), Buenos Aires Province (28), Córdoba (14), and City of Buenos Aires (7). Diagnostic guidance emphasizes direct tests (qRT-PCR and ELISA NS1) within six days of symptom onset to confirm cases and distinguish arboviruses. Transmission is via Aedes aegypti; symptoms appear 3–7 days after infection and include fever >38°C, severe joint pain, myalgia, headache, nausea, fatigue, and rash, with potential prolonged arthralgia and pregnancy transmission risk. No vaccine or specific treatment; management is supportive. Vector control is essential; fumigation is context-dependent. Five new dengue cases bring total to 45 since 2025–2026 season (55.6% without travel history). Influenza A(H3N2) subclade J.2.4.1 adds 18 cases (136 total, 78% of detections).

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱警報：アルゼンチンで268例の新規患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱の急速な流行拡大（837確認例）、明らかな異常性、複数国からの輸入関連性、および地域的な重症度の観点からWPRO基準の複数項目に該当し、国際的な関心が高まる可能性があるため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはアルゼンチン、ボリビア、パラグアイ、キューバが含まれるが、対象国リストではBrazilのみが該当。記事はアルゼンチンが主題だが、対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。チクングニア熱は蚊媒介性感染症で、患者数急増（268/週）、地域的クラスター、複数国からの輸入例が特徴。診断・治療・ベクター対策に関する具体的ガイダンスが示されており、公開衛生上の関心は顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Health department makes preparations to tackle AES cases in Gaya
article.articleSummary: As of 21 April 2026, Gaya’s health department is preparing to tackle Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) and Japanese Encephalitis (JE). ANMMCH superintendent Dr K K Sinha reports 12 beds in the children’s ward have been earmarked for AES/JE treatment, with rehabilitation mechanisms in place. Authorities note a recent decline in encephalitis cases due to preventive measures, awareness drives, and mass immunisation of vulnerable groups. There are sufficient doctors and medicines for AES/JE management. Vector-borne disease officer Dr M Haque says block-level training programmes on AES control are underway, targeting health workers, schoolteachers, ASHA workers, social activists, and village-level providers. A pilot mass-immunisation project against AES launched in the district years ago has yielded encouraging results. Immunisation for children aged 9–12 months and 16–24 months is being conducted at scale. Preventive measures for heatstroke—coolers, air conditioners, and ice packs—are being provided at primary health centres.

triage.headline_ja: ガヤ地区の急性脳炎症候群（AES）対策に向けて衛生当局が準備を加速
triage.triage_reason: 記事は予防的準備と感染者数の減少を報じており、流行または危機的な公衆衛生上の影響を示していない。IHR基準の2つ以上の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は脳炎の既知の地域的問題に対する当局の準備態勢を報じている。最近の症例数の減少と予防措置の実施が報告されており、危機的な状況ではない。ただしAESとJEはベクター媒介性疾患として流行しやすい性質を持つため、WPRO基準で2項目該当。社会的・政治的関心は政府当局レベルに限定され、一般的な注目は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 上海一家奥乐齐超市销售的经典凯撒沙拉检出李斯特菌 国标要求"不得检出"_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Listeria monocytogenes detected in the classic Caesar salad sold at a Shanghai Aoleqi Supermarket; national standard requires 'not detectable'.
article.articleSummary: Listeria monocytogenes detected in a classic Caesar salad sold by Aoleqi Supermarket in Shanghai, triggering a national food-safety notification. The product, produced by Jiangsu Baikafe Food Co., Ltd., and sold through Aoleqi Commercial (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., Xu Hui Fifth Branch (Aoleqi Supermarket, Riyueguang Center store), failed to meet standard Q/SYBKF0006-2024, which requires Listeria monocytogenes to be not detectable; in this batch, the bacterium count did not comply. The State Administration for Market Regulation disclosed 42 batches of food under concern in a notice dated 2026-04-21. Listeria monocytogenes is a Gram-positive pathogen capable of growth at 4°C and is a major risk in refrigerated foods; infection occurs via contaminated food. Possible contamination sources include raw materials, packaging, production hygiene, or improper storage. The producer operates in Nantong, Jiangsu (Haimen District) and is wholly owned by Baijinfu Holdings; Aoleqi is a German retailer with over 50 Shanghai stores.

triage.headline_ja: 上海のアオルチスーパーで販売されたシーザーサラドからリステリア菌を検出、国家基準で「検出不可」を要求
triage.triage_reason: リステリア菌による食品汚染イベントであり、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」「長期曝露リスク」に該当する可能性があるが、情報不足（死亡者数、患者数、流行拡大の実態が不明）のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は食品安全通知に基づくリステリア菌検出イベント（2026年4月21日）を報告している。患者の疾病・死亡情報が記載されていないため、公衆衛生への影響の深刻度が不明。リステリア菌は4℃でも増殖可能な病原体であり、冷蔵食品流通による複数地域への曝露リスク（Jiangsu・Shanghai・Guangdong）があるが、実際の流行拡大や患者発生の有無が不明なため、WATCHレベルの判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: 3 more H9N2 avian flu cases confirmed in China
article.articleSummary: Three more H9N2 avian flu cases confirmed in mainland China, all in children under 6, per the Hong Kong CHP. Last week CHP reported two cases. The WHO’s latest avian flu report includes these three: Guangdong’s 5-year-old boy with onset February 23, who developed severe pneumonia, was hospitalized, and discharged; Yunnan’s 2-year-old girl with onset March 3 and mild symptoms; Jiangxi’s 2-year-old boy with onset March 20 and mild symptoms. Exposure histories: the older boy and the girl had poultry exposure; the 2-year-old’s family visited a market where poultry tested positive for H9. Since 2015, 162 human H9N2 infections have been reported to WHO in the Western Pacific Region, including two deaths (both in people with underlying conditions), with 159 cases in China. Last week’s CHP report noted two additional cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中国でH9N2鳥インフルエンザ3例が追加確認
triage.triage_reason: H9N2は人獣共通感染症で国際的関心が高い。複数の小児症例（うち1例は重症肺炎）、継続的な家禽曝露、WHO報告症例であり、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は中国本土のH9N2症例に焦点。香港CHP報告・WHO記録・WPR地域での2015年以降の162症例という文脈から、持続的な監視対象。3例とも小児（2～5歳）であり、うち1例は重症（肺炎で入院）。家禽曝露とH9陽性市場への接触が記録されている。過去データから2死亡例（基礎疾患あり）があり、人間への適応リスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue mobiliza aldeia indígena em Pontal do Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campaign against dengue fever mobilizes an indigenous village in Pontal do Paraná.
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention campaign mobilizes Guaviraty Indigenous Village in Shangri-lá, Pontal do Paraná, Brazil. Health teams conducted a vector-control effort against Aedes aegypti, organizing cleaning, educational activities, and risk-reduction actions. Following identification of risk points such as litter accumulation and standing water, a community mutirão brought residents together to remove materials that could serve as mosquito breeding sites. The practical work was complemented by guidance on sustaining prevention inside homes and around the community. At the village school, children aged 4 to 10 participated in dengue education using puppets to present risk-reduction concepts in an accessible way, encouraging them to relay information to their families. The initiative emphasizes ongoing household and environmental care to curb dengue transmission. As of 21 April 2026.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州ポンタル・ド・パラナのデング熱対策キャンペーンが先住民村を動員
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の予防キャンペーンと啓発活動の報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の危機を示唆していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル（対象国外）における予防活動の報道であり、本スクリーニングシステムの対象外。WPROの監視対象国には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Son Needed $250K Air Ambulance Home After Suffering Infection and Amputation During Brother's Overseas Wedding
article.articleSummary: Massachusetts man Andrew Wasil, 39, of Braintree, contracted a severe streptococcal infection in February in India while attending his brother's wedding near Mumbai. The illness rapidly progressed to septic shock with multiple organ complications, and doctors amputated both legs below the knees to save his life. He spent more than six weeks in an intensive care unit in India; by April 10 he was medically stable but not fully conscious. The family launched a GoFundMe to cover an air ambulance home to Boston for continued care, with an estimated cost of $248,000—not covered by insurance and required upfront. More than $200,000 was raised. The flight was booked for April 19 to bring him to Massachusetts. Doctors noted the infection spread to his lungs, with traces of cold and flu on admission; additional donations will support his ongoing medical needs.

triage.triage_reason: 個人の重症感染症ケースであり、集団発生やアウトブレイク、公衆衛生上の異常な状況ではない。インフルエンザの流行兆候もなく、公衆衛生への深刻な影響なし。

article.articleHeadline: A Toupeira " Seu pet ainda pode pegar raiva?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Mole: Can your pet still catch rabies?
article.articleSummary: Rabies (Lyssavirus) remains a highly lethal zoonosis affecting the central nervous system. In Brazil, wildlife reservoirs—especially bats—now pose the main risk to domestic dogs and cats, even in urban homes. Transmission is primarily via saliva and can occur through bites, contact with mucous membranes, or open wounds; scratches with saliva may also transmit the virus. After inoculation, the virus travels along nerves to the brain, causing an incubation of weeks to months before rapid, fatal neurological disease: behavioral changes, hypersalivation, dysphagia, disorientation, loss of motor coordination, progressive paralysis, and respiratory failure. There is no treatment once symptoms appear. Vaccination is the main preventive measure, protecting individuals and reducing viral circulation; boosters are required periodically throughout the animal’s life, including indoor pets.

article.articleHeadline: Seu pet ainda pode pegar raiva?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can your pet still catch rabies?
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a highly lethal viral zoonosis (Lyssavirus) affecting the central nervous system of mammals, with prevention as the only reliable defense. In Brazil, mass vaccination reduced dog-to-dog transmission in urban settings, but wildlife—especially bats—now serve as main viral reservoirs, keeping risk in urban and domestic environments. Transmission occurs primarily via saliva; bites are the best-known route, but saliva contacting mucous membranes or wounds, and even contaminated scratches, can cause infection. After inoculation, the virus travels via nerve fibers to the brain, yielding an incubation of weeks to months depending on viral load and proximity to the brain; once clinical signs appear, there is no treatment capable of reversing the disease, and progression is rapid. Early behavioral changes, agitation, and altered interactions precede dysphagia, hypersalivation, disorientation, ataxia, paralysis, and respiratory failure. Vaccination remains the main preventive tool for pets—including indoor animals—with periodic boosters to maintain immunity and reduce viral circulation.

The operation involved collaboration with municipal institutions, the Brigada Militar (military police), and the Municipality of Oratorio, strengthening interagency cooperation and community participation. By removing potential mosquito habitats, the effort aims to reduce vector proliferation and prevent outbreaks. The initiative emphasizes an inclusive health service model based on Integrated Health Care Networks, promoting healthier communities through proactive environmental cleaning and vector control.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue y riesgo de síndrome neurológico: Guillain-Barré y parálisis en aumento - Notiulti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and risk of neurological syndrome: Guillain-Barré and paralysis on the rise - Notiulti
article.articleSummary: As of 21 April 2026, a Fiocruz analysis from Brazil finds dengue infection may raise the risk of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) up to 17-fold, linking dengue to this rare but serious peripheral nervous system disorder that can cause tingling, limb weakness, and, in severe cases, respiratory failure. The study, based on Brazilian case analyses, notes a significant association between dengue and GBS, a relationship previously documented with viral infections such as Zika and chikungunya. With dengue outbreaks reported in multiple regions, health systems are monitoring for neurologic complications. GBS treatment includes intravenous immunoglobulins or plasmapheresis, with respiratory support and rehabilitation as needed. Public health authorities emphasize dengue prevention—eliminate mosquito breeding sites and use repellents—especially in areas with active transmission, and urge immediate medical care if neurological symptoms appear during or after a fever compatible with dengue.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue eleva risco de síndrome neurológica rara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue increases the risk of a rare neurological syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Dengue infection can be linked to rare yet potentially severe neurological complications, notably Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS). A Fiocruz study in Brazil analyzed more than 5,000 hospital admissions in the public SUS system during 2023–2024 and found that dengue infection carried a 16.7-fold higher risk of developing GBS within six weeks post-infection, with the steepest risk in the first two weeks. GBS presents as tingling, muscle weakness, pain and can progress to respiratory failure. Additional arboviral neurological presentations, including encephalitis, are thought to arise when immune responses attack the myelin sheath surrounding nerves. Despite severity, cases are rare and often respond well to early treatment. The findings emphasize dengue prevention, including vaccination, to reduce such complications, and highlight the need for clinical vigilance in Brazil’s public health framework.

article.articleHeadline: Casos de síndrome respiratória crescem; vacinação da gripe é antecipada - Diário do Grande ABC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of respiratory syndrome are rising; flu vaccination is brought forward - Diário do Grande ABC

Vaccination efforts are accelerated: influenza vaccination moved earlier for the winter season; maternal RSV vaccination (bronchiolitis vaccine) recommended for pregnant women from 28 weeks gestation to protect newborns. Influenza A cases continue to rise in São Paulo and other states; severe COVID-19 cases remain low. In the last four weeks, positive viral distribution was 32.2% influenza A, 2.4% influenza B, 26.3% RSV, 33% rhinovirus, and 5.5% SARS-CoV-2. InfoGripe data updated to April 11. In the Grande ABC region, São Bernardo do Campo administered 48% more vaccine doses in under 20 days of March campaign than last year; Mauá is intensifying active vaccination outreach, focusing on pregnant women, with other cities running campaigns through end-May in all primary health care units.

article.articleHeadline: Piura confirma cinco muertes por leptospirosis y alerta por variante agresiva detectada en pacientes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piura confirms five deaths from leptospirosis and issues an alert about an aggressive variant detected in patients.
article.articleSummary: Piura, Peru reports five deaths from leptospirosis with 117 suspected cases (up from 54 in March). Leptospira interrogans Varillal variant is described as highly aggressive, affecting not only rodents but also pigs and dogs; the latest death was in Santa Rosa, Morropón, with the individual a pig farmer in unsanitary conditions. Districts Sullana, Bellavista, Piura, Castilla, and Chulucanas have reported fatalities, most victims being women. Dengue activity in the region is lower than in prior years: 2,027 probable and 423 confirmed cases, with no deaths. Morropón province saw a >400% increase in cases last week, especially Las Palmas and areas near Chulucanas. Authorities attribute spikes to water-storage practices that favor Aedes aegypti breeding and note resistance to Diresa Piura teams conducting vector control and container cleaning.

article.articleHeadline: Pesquisa da USP usa ultrassom para destruir vírus da Covid e influenza A - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: University of São Paulo research uses ultrasound to destroy COVID-19 and influenza A viruses - Brazil Urgente
article.articleSummary: Researchers at the University of São Paulo (USP) in São Carlos, Brazil, report in Scientific Reports that high-frequency ultrasound can inactivate enveloped respiratory viruses in vitro, including SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) and H1N1 (influenza A), without harming human cells. Acoustic resonance induces morphological changes that rupture the viral envelope, preventing the virus from entering human cells. The study also notes ongoing in vitro testing on other enveloped pathogens such as dengue, chikungunya, and Zika virus. Although not yet clinically applicable, the approach is a promising, environmentally friendly antiviral strategy that avoids chemical antivirals and resistance. Efficacy depends on viral geometry, with spherical particles absorbing energy more effectively; non-spherical shapes could respond differently. The work was coordinated by Odemir Martinez Bruno and collaborators at USP/IFSC.

article.articleHeadline: Afrika: Impfstoffallianz meldet Erfolg im Kampf gegen Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: The Vaccine Alliance reports success in the fight against malaria.
article.articleSummary: Malaria vaccination progress in Africa: The Vaccine Alliance (Gavi) reports tangible gains in the fight against malaria. Early data from Kenya, Malawi, Ghana and Cameroon indicate notable reductions in severe malaria cases and hospitalizations. Since 2024, more than 50 million doses of malaria vaccine have been administered across 25 African countries. In Burkina Faso, intensified vaccination and complementary measures cut malaria cases from 2024 to 2025 by about 32%, with especially large declines among children under five; malaria deaths halved. Over the next five years, Gavi aims to fully vaccinate an additional 50 million children, a target that could save more than 180,000 lives. However, funding challenges loom, with potential immunization bottlenecks as the USA and other donors, including Germany, reduced support. Gavi, a public-private partnership, has helped immunize over 1.2 billion children since 2000, contributing to declines in child mortality in many poorer countries.

article.articleHeadline: Hospital de Porto Alegre registra bactéria, fecha UTI neonatal temporariamente e bebê prematuro extremo morre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Alegre hospital detects a bacterium, temporarily closes the neonatal ICU, and an extremely premature baby dies.
article.articleSummary: On 16 April 2026, a pan-resistant bacterium was detected in the neonatal ICU of Hospital Fêmina in Porto Alegre, prompting maximum containment: isolation of the affected area, restricted movements, a temporary shutdown for new admissions, and universal testing of all NICU patients. The WHO notes that pan-resistant bacteria resist all available antibiotics. Of 34 hospitalized neonates, four tested positive; one death occurred in an extremely premature infant at 26 weeks. The other three positive infants are stable, isolated, and cared for by a dedicated team, with no contact with other units. Other NICU patients are under continuous monitoring, and high-risk pregnancies are being redirected to other hospitals. Grupo Hospitalar Conceição alerted municipal and state health authorities and Sanitary Vigilance, implementing full isolation and testing protocols.
